  1. Breakpoint 1 — Schema Amputation & 300-Character Mid-Sentence Guillotine in DistilledEvaluation (@[backend_v2/models/domain/synthesis.py#L131-L180], @[backend_v2/models/dtos/atom_evaluation.py#L21-L40], @[backend_v2/settings.py] & @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/synthesis_payload_compressor.py#L198-L501]):
  2. Upstream @[backend_v2/models/dtos/atom_result.py#L82-L172] (AtomResultDTO) and @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/topological_evaluator.py#L56-L175] (lines 156–162) preserve depends_on_tda_ids: list[str], short_circuit_reason_tda_ids: list[str], is_inverse_evidence: bool, and contextual_override: bool.
  3. When SynthesisPayloadCompressor._clean_and_distill_payload (@[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/synthesis_payload_compressor.py#L198-L501], specifically lines 239–352 and 298–333) converts EvaluatedAtomDTO into DistilledEvaluation, it retains only five fields (specifically and exhaustively: atom_id, status, exact_quotes, semantic_reasoning, extensions). The causal dependency edges (depends_on_tda_ids), topological circuit-breaker origins (short_circuit_reason_tda_ids), and poison-pill inverse hits (is_inverse_evidence) are permanently erased.

  4. Worse still, ReasoningStepDTO (@[backend_v2/models/dtos/atom_evaluation.py#L21-L40]) orders Micro-CoT reasoning sequentially as step_1_identify_premise $\rightarrow$ step_2_scan_source $\rightarrow$ step_3_evaluate_anti_patterns $\rightarrow$ step_4_final_conclusion. Because @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/synthesis_payload_compressor.py#L198-L501] (lines 268–277 and 340–350) slices semantic_reasoning[: settings.max_synthesis_reasoning_length] and exact_quotes (q[: settings.max_synthesis_quote_length]) at 300 characters (@[backend_v2/settings.py], lines 286–288 and 296–298), the first 300 characters of semantic_reasoning capture only step_1_identify_premise and part of step_2_scan_source while guillotining off step_3_evaluate_anti_patterns (the anti-pattern violation) and step_4_final_conclusion (the rejection verdict), and evidence quotes are severed mid-sentence. Additionally, lines 265–266 and 336–338 drop evaluations whenever valid_quotes is empty and semantic_reasoning is absent, affecting short-circuited ExecutionStatus.N_A atoms whose evaluation_reasoning is None.

  5. Breakpoint 2 — "Token Shield" 40-Evaluation Cap & Mathematically Degenerate Deficit Stratification (@[backend_v2/settings.py] & @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/synthesis_payload_compressor.py#L109-L196]):

  6. In @[backend_v2/settings.py] (lines 283–285), max_synthesis_evaluations defaults to 40 ("Max evaluations for synthesis token shield"), causing _prune_and_stratify_evaluations (@[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/synthesis_payload_compressor.py#L109-L196]) to drop evaluations exceeding 40 per step even though line 122 already supports unbounded mode when limit == 0 (if limit == 0 or len(evals) <= limit: return list(evals)).
  7. Furthermore, when a positive limit > 0 is active, _prune_and_stratify_evaluations (lines 142–143) partitions only ExecutionStatus.PASSED and ExecutionStatus.FAILED while dropping ExecutionStatus.N_A, and sorts deficits using sort_key (@[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/synthesis_payload_compressor.py#L141-L144], key=lambda e: (-len(e.exact_quotes), e.atom_id)).

  8. However, @[backend_v2/models/dtos/atom_result.py#L138-L172] (validate_cognitive_vs_system_state, lines 151–160) enforces a strict mathematical invariant: whenever status == ExecutionStatus.FAILED or status == ExecutionStatus.N_A, source_quotes is forced to None (len(exact_quotes) == 0). Consequently, -len(e.exact_quotes) evaluates to 0 for 100% of failed and short-circuited atoms, truncating deficits in arbitrary alphabetical order of atom_id.

  9. Breakpoint 3 — Affirmative Bias, Unlinked N_A Short-Circuits, Contrastive Blindness & 5-Item / 300-Char Caps in MatrixExplanationService (@[backend_v2/settings.py], @[backend_v2/utils/ranked_round_robin.py#L13-L80] & @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/matrix_explanation_service.py#L169-L507]):

  10. When hit_status == ExecutionStatus.PASSED (lines 216–242 of @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/matrix_explanation_service.py#L169-L507]), assemble_matrices_to_explain extracts the claim label and supporting lexical quotes, but slices every quote at cleaned[:max_quote_len] (300 chars at lines 86 and 133) and caps total quotes per matrix at max_synthesis_quotes_per_matrix = 5 (@[backend_v2/settings.py], lines 289–291, passed to ranked_round_robin_select at lines 258–264).
  11. When hit_status == ExecutionStatus.FAILED (lines 243–252 of @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/matrix_explanation_service.py#L169-L507]), it appends only the bare localized claim title (tda_to_claim[tda_id]) into UNMET CRITERIA / DEFICITS: and caps the list at [:effective_max_unmet] (max_synthesis_unmet_criteria_per_matrix = 5 in @[backend_v2/settings.py], lines 292–295, sliced at line 270). It discards:
    • atom_res.evaluation_reasoning (the forensic reason why the evidence failed verification, including step_3_evaluate_anti_patterns and step_4_final_conclusion),
    • tda.contrastive_example (ContrastivePairDTO(acceptable=..., rejected=...) defined in @[backend_v2/models/domain/matrix.py#L94-L129]) and tda.anti_patterns (@[backend_v2/models/domain/matrix.py#L66-L77]),
    • tda.inverse_evidence (is_inverse_evidence poison hits where an active anti-pattern was detected),
    • ExecutionStatus.N_A short-circuited atoms (short_circuit_reason_tda_ids), which are completely ignored because the if/elif branch checks only ExecutionStatus.PASSED and ExecutionStatus.FAILED. Furthermore, because TopologicalEvaluator.evaluate_graph (@[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/topological_evaluator.py#L56-L175], lines 156–162) leaves evaluation_reasoning = None on ExecutionStatus.N_A atoms, explaining why a short-circuited claim was blocked requires transitively resolving both the upstream parent blocker's claim label AND the upstream parent blocker's evaluation_reasoning via short_circuit_reason_tda_ids.

  12. Furthermore, @[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_tasks.py#L351-L439] (create_row_explanations_task, lines 406–413) sends only MATRICES TO EXPLAIN:\n{matrices_json} to the LLM—without distilled_inputs or causal_diagnosis.

  13. Breakpoint 4 — MatrixReducer Token-Compression Drop of PASSED Atoms & Phase 1 In-DAG SynthesisEngine Disconnection (@[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/matrix_reducer.py#L127-L246] & @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/engines/synthesis_engine.py#L162-L398]):

  14. In MatrixReducer.reduce_matrix() (@[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/matrix_reducer.py#L127-L246], lines 198–206), Quorum explicitly drops boolean ExecutionStatus.PASSED atoms (if atom.status == ExecutionStatus.PASSED and not has_extracted_data: continue under the comment # Token-compression cascade: Drop unstarted/pending atoms and boolean PASSED atoms to save context window), and ReducedAtomDTO (@[backend_v2/models/dtos/atom_evaluation.py#L43-L82]) strips depends_on_tda_ids, short_circuit_reason_tda_ids, and is_inverse_evidence.

  15. Worse still, in lines 170–188 of @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/engines/synthesis_engine.py#L162-L398], SynthesisEngine.execute() never serializes matrix_reducer_output.reduced_atoms into user_message_parts. It injects only raw_extensions and global_atom_blackboard.to_markdown_synthesis_injection(), where global_atom_blackboard (@[backend_v2/models/domain/blackboard.py#L133-L184]) is populated during Phase 1B RAG preflight (@[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/rag_preflight_service.py#L134-L305], lines 276–305) before matrix evaluation, topological short-circuiting, or Toulmin falsification occurs.

  16. Breakpoint 5 — Opaque Node IDs, Task Isolation, Cognitive Tier Downgrade & Conflicting Length Budget Double-Injection in synthesis_worker.py & synthesis_tasks.py (@[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_worker.py#L95-L640] & @[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_tasks.py#L351-L439]):

  17. In lines 394–433 of @[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_worker.py#L95-L640], the worker builds causal_diagnosis_text from CausalTdaFusionResultDTO (@[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/dag_executor/causal_tda_fusion.py#L394-L494]), formatting raw node IDs (- Root Parent {diag.root_cause_parent_id} -> Failing Node {diag.failing_node_id}: {diag.explanation}) without resolving the human-readable PropositionNode.claim statements or WarrantEdge.relation_type (warrants, rebuts, supports) from causal_payload.graph.
  18. Even this raw string is passed exclusively to create_executive_summary_task (line 436 of @[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_worker.py#L95-L640]). create_matrix_sections_tasks, create_xai_highlights_task, and create_row_explanations_task (lines 440–473) receive zero causal diagnosis or Toulmin falsification context (FalsifiedClaimMatch from @[backend_v2/database/postgres/graph_adapter.py#L348-L432] and @[backend_v2/models/domain/proposition_graph.py#L344-L392]).

  19. Worse still, create_row_explanations_task (@[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_tasks.py#L351-L439], lines 370–375) ignores the worker's CognitiveTier.BALANCED client (@[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_worker.py#L95-L640], lines 328–333) and instantiates a downgraded CognitiveTier.FAST client, while lines 311–314 of @[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_worker.py#L95-L640] inject <global_length_constraint_chars>{active_profile_dto.synthesis_length_constraint}</global_length_constraint_chars> into base_dynamic_parts, colliding with each task's own <section_budget> tag (@[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_tasks.py#L58-L139] line 109, @[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_tasks.py#L142-L251] line 212, and @[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_tasks.py#L254-L348] line 313).

  20. Breakpoint 6 — Siloed SDUI Adapters & Disembodied SduiNACard Rendering (@[backend_v2/services/blueprint.py#L133-L732] & @[backend_v2/services/sdui/sdui_mapper_service.py#L92-L188]):

  21. BlueprintTransformer.build_report_dto (@[backend_v2/services/blueprint.py#L133-L732], lines 574–658 and 607–658) iterates over profile.target_block_order and invokes each SDUI adapter (@[backend_v2/services/sdui/adapters/]) over its own isolated data slice.
  22. SduiMapperService.map_report_to_sdui (@[backend_v2/services/sdui/sdui_mapper_service.py#L92-L188], lines 110–165 and 146–160) extracts SduiNACard entries via _extract_na_cards and appends them at the very bottom of inner_sdui_blocks, visually severed from the matrix row or causal graph node where the dependency chain broke.
  23. Furthermore, lines 584–592 of @[backend_v2/services/blueprint.py#L133-L732] contain an inline if type(content) is dict: check scanning execution.execution_trace for causal_result, bypassing typed envelope extraction.

docs.title: 1.2 The 5-Pillar Zero-Loss Epistemic Distillation Architecture
docs.text:
To achieve maximum analytical accuracy and preserve 100% of evaluated DAG intelligence (PASSED, FAILED, and N_A causal chains, complete 4-step Micro-CoT reasoning, verbatim evidence quotes, and full contrastive rubric boundaries) while keeping mechanical duplication stripped and preserving the 300,000-character (~75,000 token) Fail-Fast safety ceiling in @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/synthesis_distiller.py#L43-L115] (lines 46–49), this Epic enforces the 5-Pillar Zero-Loss Epistemic Distillation Architecture:

  1. Pillar 1 — Mechanical Duplication Stripping Only & Unbounded Evaluation Retention (max_synthesis_evaluations = 0):
  2. Retain mechanical noise stripping (_HEAVY_KEYS_TO_EXCLUDE: shuffled_atoms, hydrated_references, _step_metadata, and duplicate raw/verified quote copies) in @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/synthesis_payload_compressor.py#L198-L501].
  3. Set max_synthesis_evaluations = 0 (unbounded mode by default) in @[backend_v2/settings.py] (line 283) so _prune_and_stratify_evaluations (@[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/synthesis_payload_compressor.py#L109-L196], line 122) retains all evaluations without the artificial 40-evaluation "Token Shield" cap.
  4. Enforce zero-loss retention for ExecutionStatus.FAILED, ExecutionStatus.N_A, and is_inverse_evidence == True evaluations: bypass the empty-quote dropout gates at lines 265–266 and 336–338 of @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/synthesis_payload_compressor.py#L198-L501] whenever status in (ExecutionStatus.FAILED, ExecutionStatus.N_A) or is_inverse_evidence is True.
  5. In MatrixReducer.reduce_matrix() (@[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/matrix_reducer.py#L127-L246], lines 198–206), remove the if atom.status == ExecutionStatus.PASSED and not has_extracted_data: continue token-compression drop so all evaluated atoms (PASSED, FAILED, N_A, DLQ) survive in ReducedAtomDTO.
  6. Pillar 2 — Zero Mid-Sentence Character Slicing & SSOT Clipper Segregation in settings.py (strict_configuration_segregation):
  7. Set max_synthesis_reasoning_length = 0 and max_synthesis_quote_length = 0 (unbounded defaults) in @[backend_v2/settings.py] (lines 286–288 and 296–298).
  8. Update @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/synthesis_payload_compressor.py#L198-L501] (lines 268–277 and 340–350) and @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/matrix_explanation_service.py#L169-L507] (lines 86 and 133) so that character slicing ([:max_len]) is applied only when a positive bound (> 0) is explicitly configured. By default (0), all four steps of ReasoningStepDTO (@[backend_v2/models/dtos/atom_evaluation.py#L21-L40]: step_1_identify_premise, step_2_scan_source, step_3_evaluate_anti_patterns, step_4_final_conclusion) and all verbatim exact_quotes / source_quotes survive 100% intact.
  9. When an explicit positive evaluation cap (max_synthesis_evaluations > 0) is configured, _prune_and_stratify_evaluations (@[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/synthesis_payload_compressor.py#L109-L196]) includes ExecutionStatus.N_A in deficits, uses synthesis_deficit_stratification_ratio: float = 0.7 from @[backend_v2/settings.py] (replacing hardcoded 0.7 at line 145), and sorts deficits deterministically by topological priority (-int(item.is_inverse_evidence), -item.topological_out_degree, len(item.short_circuit_reason_tda_ids), atom_id).
  10. Centralize all remaining hardcoded module-level clipper and threshold constants into @[backend_v2/settings.py] per strict_configuration_segregation:
    • Add max_citation_span_chars: int = 0 (unbounded default; enforced only when > 0), min_multi_segment_floor_chars: int = 30, and min_entropy_gate_chars: int = 10 to Settings, replacing hardcoded 1000/30/10 constants in @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/two_pass_atomizer.py#L255-L361] (lines 336–342), @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/anchor_validation/lexical_normalizer.py#L79-L150], @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/anchor_validation/lexical_normalizer.py#L153-L169], @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/anchor_validation/lexical_matcher.py#L68-L284], @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/anchor_validation/evidence_validator.py#L23-L65], @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/anchor_validation/evidence_validator.py#L259-L326], and @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/anchor_validation/evidence_validator.py#L329-L368].
    • Add min_synthesis_quote_length: int = 15 to Settings, replacing hardcoded 15 at line 132 of @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/matrix_explanation_service.py#L169-L507].
    • Add web_fetcher_max_extracted_chars: int = 0 (unbounded default; slicing only when > 0) and web_fetcher_min_extracted_chars: int = 150 to Settings, replacing hardcoded _MAX_EXTRACTED_TEXT_CHARS = 5000 and _MIN_EXTRACTED_TEXT_CHARS = 150 in @[backend_v2/services/web_fetcher.py#L81-L102] and @[backend_v2/services/web_fetcher.py#L104-L134].
    • Wire @[backend_v2/hooks/archival.py#L117-L159] (_build_precedent_dto) and @[backend_v2/hooks/archival.py#L162-L240] (retrieve_precedent_hook) to settings.max_precedent_scan_depth and settings.max_precedent_return_count (defined at lines 638–639 of @[backend_v2/settings.py]) and add archival_verdict_part_max_chars: int = 0 and archival_verdict_summary_max_chars: int = 0 (unbounded defaults; slicing only when > 0) in @[backend_v2/settings.py], eradicating the hardcoded _RECENT_EXECUTIONS_SCAN_LIMIT = 5, _MAX_PRECEDENTS_RETURNED = 3, _VERDICT_PART_MAX_CHARS = 50, and _VERDICT_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS = 150 constants at lines 30–33 of @[backend_v2/hooks/archival.py].
  11. Pillar 3 — Transitive Parent-to-Child N_A Short-Circuit Hydration:
  12. Because TopologicalEvaluator.evaluate_graph (@[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/topological_evaluator.py#L56-L175], lines 156–162) leaves evaluation_reasoning = None on ExecutionStatus.N_A atoms, @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/matrix_explanation_service.py#L169-L507] and @[backend_v2/models/dtos/lightweight_matrix.py#L126-L189] transitively bind each N_A atom via short_circuit_reason_tda_ids to its upstream failed parent's localized claim label and the upstream parent's evaluation_reasoning ([Blocked Claim] <-- SHORT-CIRCUITED BY PREREQUISITE FAILURE: [Parent Claim: <parent evaluation_reasoning>]).
  13. Pillar 4 — Full Unbounded Deficit & Quote Retention in MatrixExplanationService (max_synthesis_quotes_per_matrix = 0, max_synthesis_unmet_criteria_per_matrix = 0):
  14. Set max_synthesis_quotes_per_matrix = 0 and max_synthesis_unmet_criteria_per_matrix = 0 (unbounded defaults when OutputProfile.max_quotes_per_matrix and OutputProfile.max_unmet_criteria_per_matrix are None) in @[backend_v2/settings.py] (lines 289–295).
  15. In MatrixExplanationService.assemble_matrices_to_explain (@[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/matrix_explanation_service.py#L169-L507], lines 257–270), when effective_max_quotes <= 0, pass max_items=len(quote_candidates) into ranked_round_robin_select (@[backend_v2/utils/ranked_round_robin.py#L13-L80]), and when effective_max_unmet <= 0, retain all unmet_deficits without slicing [:effective_max_unmet].
  16. Populate MatrixFailureDeficitDTO with full evaluation_reasoning, is_inverse_evidence, transitive short_circuited_by_claims, tda.anti_patterns (@[backend_v2/models/domain/matrix.py#L66-L77]), and tda.contrastive_example (ContrastivePairDTO(rejected, acceptable) from @[backend_v2/models/domain/matrix.py#L94-L129]) across all ExecutionStatus.FAILED and ExecutionStatus.N_A deficits without artificial scale filtering or per-row caps.
  17. Pillar 5 — Cross-Task Unified CausalSynthesisBriefDTO, CognitiveTier.BALANCED Client Parity & Single <section_budget> Sovereignty:
  18. Inject CausalSynthesisBriefDTO (combining human-readable PropositionNode.claim fault chains from @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/dag_executor/causal_tda_fusion.py#L394-L494] and PostgreSQL 19 3-way Toulmin FalsifiedClaimMatch rebuttals from @[backend_v2/database/postgres/graph_adapter.py#L348-L432]) into all four parallel synthesis tasks in @[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_worker.py#L95-L640] (create_executive_summary_task, create_matrix_sections_tasks, create_xai_highlights_task, create_row_explanations_task) as well as Phase 1 in-DAG SynthesisEngine (@[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/engines/synthesis_engine.py#L162-L398]).
  19. Unify create_row_explanations_task (@[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_tasks.py#L351-L439], lines 336–375) to accept and execute with the same shared CognitiveTier.BALANCED client: LLMClient instance created in @[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_worker.py#L95-L640] (lines 328–333 and 463–473) as the other three synthesis tasks, eliminating the downgraded CognitiveTier.FAST instantiation.
  20. Remove the conflicting <global_length_constraint_chars> injection from base_dynamic_parts in @[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_worker.py#L95-L640] (lines 311–314) so that each synthesis task (create_executive_summary_task, create_matrix_sections_tasks, create_xai_highlights_task, create_row_explanations_task) obeys exclusively its own <section_budget> tag when its length constraint is positive (> 0), and applies zero length constraint when its <section_budget> is 0 or None.
  21. Preservation of 1-Atom development Fast-Profile Limits:
  22. All 1-atom development environment clamps in Settings._enforce_environment_limits (@[backend_v2/settings.py#L965-L1026], specifically and exhaustively: max_tool_calls_per_step = 1, max_development_chunks = 1, matrix_sampling_limit = 1, rag_preflight_chunk_size = 4000, schema_max_localized_anchors = 2, schema_max_quotes_target = 1, schema_max_quote_length = 50, schema_max_evaluations = 1, max_precedent_scan_depth = 0, max_precedent_return_count = 0, tda_linker_window_size = 2, tda_linker_overlap = 0, ensemble_parallelism = 1, ensemble_min_consensus = 1, dev_max_thinking_budget = 0) remain 100% untouched.

docs.title: Retained SSOT Invariants (What We Will RETAIN)
docs.text:
• 5-Tier Regression Defense Architecture:
  • DTO & Interface Isolation: Lock all Pydantic V2 (ConfigDict(strict=True, extra="forbid", frozen=True)) and Flutter Freezed boundary schemas before mutating service or worker implementations.
  • Two-Stage Testing Pipeline: Run localized unit tests during iterative steps, followed by the global completion gates (backend_audit_loop.py and flutter_audit_loop.py).
  • Circuit Breaker & Dirty Rollback: Execute git restore . ; git clean -fd immediately upon 3 consecutive test or quality gate failures.
  • Phased Execution Order: Isolate pre-existing technical debt cleanups, zero-truncation settings, and foundational DTO enrichment in Phase 1 before introducing synthesis and SDUI feature logic in Phases 2–3.
  • Atomic Checkpoint Commits: Commit each verified logical step individually with explicit workspace-relative file paths in English.
  • 1-Atom development Mode Fast-Profile Sovereignty: Settings._enforce_environment_limits (@[backend_v2/settings.py#L965-L1026]) is 100% preserved without modification.
  • Tripartite Rendering Boundary (tripartite_rendering_boundary): SDUI adapters (@[backend_v2/services/sdui/adapters/]) remain 100% pure synchronous/deterministic data mappers with zero LLM calls.
  • Alias Engine Isolation (alias_engine_llm_isolation_mandate): All raw Opaque Stripe IDs (tda_..., blk_..., stp_...) are translated into deterministic short aliases via @[backend_v2/utils/alias_engine.py] or resolved to localized claim labels before prompt compilation.
  • Four-Layer Clean Stack Hierarchy (four_layer_clean_stack_hierarchy): Static XML synthesis rules reside strictly in @[backend_v2/models/prompts/synthesis/synthesis_directives.py] (Layer 1), while dynamic CausalSynthesisBriefDTO and MatrixFailureDeficitDTO payloads are injected exclusively at the tail user message (Layer 4).

docs.title: Phase 2: Orchestration, Contrastive Deficit Injection & Synthesis Convergence
docs.text:
• Full Contrastive Deficit Injection, Unbounded Quote/Deficit Retention & Transitive N_A Parent Hydration (MatrixExplanationService):
  • Create [NEW] MatrixFailureDeficitDTO (ConfigDict(strict=True, extra="forbid", frozen=True)) defined in @[backend_v2/models/dtos/synthesis.py] and referenced alongside @[backend_v2/models/dtos/lightweight_matrix.py#L27-L42] and @[backend_v2/models/dtos/lightweight_matrix.py#L126-L189] with fields claim: str, status: Literal["FAILED", "N_A"], scale_score: int, evaluation_reasoning: str | None, is_inverse_evidence: bool, short_circuited_by_claims: list[str], anti_patterns: list[str], contrastive_rejected: str | None, and contrastive_acceptable: str | None.
  • Upgrade MatrixExplanationService.assemble_matrices_to_explain (@[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/matrix_explanation_service.py#L169-L507], lines 86, 133, 198–296, 216–242, and 243–270) to preserve full verbatim quotes without slicing when max_synthesis_quote_length <= 0, pass max_items=effective_max_quotes if effective_max_quotes > 0 else len(quote_candidates) to ranked_round_robin_select (@[backend_v2/utils/ranked_round_robin.py#L13-L80]), retain all unmet_deficits when effective_max_unmet <= 0, capture full evaluation_reasoning and is_inverse_evidence from AtomResultDTO / ReducedAtomDTO, transitively resolve ExecutionStatus.N_A (short_circuit_reason_tda_ids from @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/topological_evaluator.py#L56-L175], lines 156–162) into localized upstream blocker claim names paired with the upstream blocker parent's evaluation_reasoning (short_circuited_by_claims), and attach tda.contrastive_example (ContrastivePairDTO from @[backend_v2/models/domain/matrix.py#L94-L129]) and tda.anti_patterns (@[backend_v2/models/domain/matrix.py#L66-L77]) across all FAILED and N_A deficits.
  • Phase 1 In-DAG SynthesisEngine Convergence:
  • Fix @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/engines/synthesis_engine.py#L162-L398] (lines 78–215, 101–188, and 170–188) so matrix_reducer_output.reduced_atoms is serialized with AliasEngine aliases into user_message_parts alongside raw_extensions and global_atom_blackboard (@[backend_v2/models/domain/blackboard.py#L133-L184] populated in @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/rag_preflight_service.py#L134-L305], lines 276–305).
  • Phase 2 Unified CausalSynthesisBriefDTO Fan-Out, CognitiveTier.BALANCED Client Parity & Single <section_budget> Sovereignty:
  • Create [NEW] CausalSynthesisBriefDTO defined in @[backend_v2/models/dtos/synthesis.py] encapsulating resolved root-cause fault chains (root_cause_claim -> failing_node_claim), FalsifiedClaimMatch Toulmin rebuttals (rebuttal_claim -> invalidated_warrant -> falsified_claim), and post-hoc fidelity penalties.
  • Refactor @[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_worker.py#L95-L640] (lines 311–314, 328–333, 394–473, and 436) and @[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_tasks.py#L58-L139], @[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_tasks.py#L142-L251], @[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_tasks.py#L254-L348], and @[backend_v2/workers/synthesis_tasks.py#L351-L439] (lines 336–413) to:
    • pass the formatted CausalSynthesisBriefDTO into all four tasks (create_executive_summary_task, create_matrix_sections_tasks, create_xai_highlights_task, and create_row_explanations_task),
    • pass the shared CognitiveTier.BALANCED client: LLMClient instance into create_row_explanations_task (eradicating its downgraded CognitiveTier.FAST instantiation), and
    • remove the conflicting <global_length_constraint_chars> injection from base_dynamic_parts so each task obeys exclusively its own <section_budget> tag (and applies zero length constraint if <section_budget> is 0 or None).
  • Add static XML reasoning mandates (<causal_tda_diagnosis_mandate>, <contrastive_frontier_mandate>) in @[backend_v2/models/prompts/synthesis/synthesis_directives.py].

docs.text:

docs.text: [!IMPORTANT] SOVEREIGN 2026 PRODUCTION INFRASTRUCTURE: This Epic defines Cognitive Quorum's production cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (europe-north1 / Finland). It supersedes legacy Firestore, TinyDB, SQLAlchemy 2.0, and Alembic deployment drafts, anchoring directly on All-in-PostgreSQL 19 Sovereign Zero-ORM (@[docs/implementationplans/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_PostgreSQL.md]) and B2B SaaS IAM, Token Exchange & Enterprise Hardening (@[docs/epic/EPIC_160_B2B_SaaS_IAM_and_Enterprise_Hardening.md]).

docs.title: 1. Objective & Architectural Overview
docs.text:
This Epic provisions and hardens Cognitive Quorum's stateless production runtime on Google Cloud Platform (europe-north1) across six architectural pillars:

  1. Stateless Cloud Run Compute (quorum-api & quorum-worker):
  2. FastAPI HTTP/SSE API server (quorum-api) and Arq 2026 background worker daemon (quorum-worker) execute inside hardened Python 3.14 containers (@[backend_v2/Dockerfile]) without development file-watcher flags (--reload).
  3. Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL 19 (Zero-ORM & Private IP):
  4. Managed PostgreSQL 19 instance with native uuidv7(), uuid_extract_timestamp() VIRTUAL, default_toast_compression = lz4, built-in PgBouncer transaction pooling, Private IP VPC isolation (quorum-vpc), and 14-day Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR).
  5. Initialized deterministically via idempotent SQL DDL ([NEW] @[backend_v2/database/migrations/001_pg19_uuidv7_schema.sql]) without Alembic or SQLAlchemy.
  6. Memorystore for Redis 8 (Fail-Closed Kill-Switch, FinOps Rate Limiting & Arq Queue):
  7. Managed Redis instance on Private IP serving sub-millisecond revoked:usr:{id} session revocation checks, per-tenant sliding-window TPM/RPM rate limiting, and Arq job queues.
  8. Global qrum.ai Primary Domain Acquisition, Cloud DNS & Multi-Domain SAN SSL:
  9. Verifies availability and registers the primary global domain qrum.ai (verified available on whois.nic.ai) via Google Cloud Domains or an accredited domain registrar (gcloud domains registrations search-domains qrum.ai), and injects it via PRIMARY_DOMAIN, JWT_ISSUER, JWT_AUDIENCE, and CORS_ORIGINS environment variables with zero source code modifications.

  11. Production CORS origin enforcement and RFC 8693 JWT issuer/audience claims (jwt_issuer = "https://api.qrum.ai", jwt_audience = "https://qrum.ai") centralized in Settings (@[backend_v2/settings.py#L54-L1053]).
  12. GCP Secret Manager & Zero-Plaintext Credential Injection:
  13. Database credentials (DATABASE_URL), JWT signing keys (JWT_SECRET_KEY), and Cloud KMS keys are injected into Cloud Run exclusively from GCP Secret Manager (credential_hardcoding_ban).
  14. Typed Cloud Run & Load Balancer Health Probe (GET /api/v2/system/health):
  15. Exposes a strongly typed [NEW] HealthCheckResponseDTO (class HealthCheckResponseDTO(BaseResponseDTO): in @[backend_v2/models/dtos/system.py#L43-L52]) on GET /api/v2/system/health (@[backend_v2/api/routers/system/health.py#L20-L52]) for Cloud Run startup/liveness probes and Cloud Load Balancer health checks.

docs.title: 🚀 EPIC 89: Dynamic Tool Registry & SRP Hardening (V2)
docs.text: Epic ID: EPIC-89 Tila: Ready for Implementation Prioriteetti: P2 (Arkkitehtuurivelka / Laajennettavuus) Arkkitehtuuri: Python 3.14+, FastAPI, Pydantic V2, MCP

docs.title: 🎯 Tavoite
docs.text: Vapauttaa mcp_tool_loop.py kovakoodatusta Tavily -riippuvuudesta. Tällä hetkellä Quorumin Agentic-luuppi osaa käyttää työkaluja (Tools), mutta koodi on kytketty (Coupled) suoraan tavily_search_client.py -kirjastoon. Tavoitteena on luoda SRP (Single Responsibility Principle) -pohjainen ToolDispatcher ja BaseTool -rajapinta, jolloin uusia työkaluja (kuten sisäiset tietokantahaut, laskimet tai mock-työkalut) voidaan rekisteröidä järjestelmään pelkällä konfiguraatiolla.

docs.title: 🔍 Nykytila (As-Built)
docs.text:
• mcp_tool_loop.py sisältää kovakoodatut vakiot: TAVILY_TOOL_ID = "mcp_tavily_search".
  • Moduuli tekee suoran importin: from backend_v2.services.mcp.tavily_search_client import tavily_search.
  • LLM:n työkaluvalinta on "Fake-Dynamic": Työkalut esitellään OpenAI Schema -muodossa, mutta ajo (Execution) on if/else -spagettia (if TAVILY_TOOL_ID in allowed_tools:).
  • _execute_tavily_search() on osa loop-moottoria, eikä erillinen työkaluluokka.

docs.title: 1. BaseTool (Abstraktio)
docs.text:
Uusi ylätason luokka backend_v2/models/domain/tools.py -tiedostoon:

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from pydantic import BaseModel
from backend_v2.models.v2_core import MCPAuditTrace

class BaseTool(ABC):
    @property
    @abstractmethod
    def tool_id(self) -> str: pass

    @property
    @abstractmethod
    def declaration(self) -> dict: pass # OpenAI schema

    @abstractmethod
    async def execute(self, **kwargs) -> MCPAuditTrace:
        """Suorittaa työkalun ja palauttaa aina standardoidun MCPAuditTracen"""
        pass

docs.title: 2. ToolDispatcher (Rekisteri)
docs.text: Uusi moduuli backend_v2/services/mcp/dispatcher.py: - Pitää sisällään dict-rakenteen rekisteröidyistä työkaluista: {"mcp_tavily_search": TavilyTool()}. - Vastaa oikean työkalun instanssin hakemisesta, kun mcp_tool_loop.py pyytää sitä.

docs.title: 3. Modulaarinen TavilyTool
docs.text: Siirretään nykyinen logiikka uuteen tiedostoon backend_v2/services/mcp/tools/tavily.py: - Perii BaseTool -luokan. - Vastaa käännöksistä (Translation Service) ja MCPAuditTrace -luonnista.

docs.title: 4. mcp_tool_loop.py Puhdistus
docs.text:
• Poistetaan KAIKKI viittaukset Tavilyyn.
  • Kun allowed_tools annetaan loopille, se pyytää ToolDispatcherilta näiden työkalujen deklaratiot (dispatcher.get_declarations(allowed_tools)).
  • Jos LLM haluaa käyttää työkalua, loop kutsuu vain await dispatcher.execute_tool(tool_id, **kwargs).

docs.title: 🛑 Phase 9 - Säännöt & Laatuvaatimukset (Quality Gates)
docs.text:
1. Forensinen Jatkuvuus (Epic 88 Integrity):

  2. Työkalun vaihto ei saa rikkoa MCPAuditTrace tai ScorecardAtomDTO -rakennetta. Työkalun palauttaman datan täytyy pystyä tuottamaan <external_evidence> lohko täydellisesti entiseen malliin.

  3. Fail-Fast (DLQ):

  4. Työkalun suoritus ei saa koskaan kaatua äänettömästi (Silent Drop). AppException tai ErrorCodes.FETCH_FAILED tulee heittää eteenpäin Pydantic-tason käsittelyyn, kuten aiemmin.

  5. Opaque ID Hardening:

  6. Työkalun palauttamat todisteet tulee injektoida AliasEngine:n kautta, jotta käyttöliittymään (Flutter/PDF) päätyy vain turvallisia docN pseudonyymejä (esim. local_id = local_alias_engine.register(real_id)).

docs.title: ✅ Varmistus / Falsifiointisuunnitelma
docs.text:
• [x] Phase 1 (Dynamic Tool ID Validation): Ratkaistu (2026-07-08). AliasEngine puhdistettu työkalulogiikasta. SchemaFactory luo Pydantic Union -tyyppejä (Literal + Regex) MCP-työkaluille dynaamisesti luupissa. Execution Monitor vahvisti (exe_9b35a21d33b54b4dbb359d42fd96fb63), että Vertex AI -kutsut menevät läpi ja MCP-luuppi hakee Tavily-dokumentteja dynaamisilla ID-tunnisteilla ilman validointivirheitä tai Rate Limit 429 -kaatumisia (Pacing Lock -mekanismin suojatessa yli 180 sekunnin Semaphore-jonot).
  • [ ] Phase 2 (ToolDispatcher): Backendin testit menevät läpi uudella dispatcherilla: uv run python scripts/backend_audit_loop.py backend_v2 --test
  • [ ] Phase 2 (ToolDispatcher): Uuden työkalun (esim. MockTool) rekisteröinti onnistuu yhtä koodiriviä muuttamalla.
  • [ ] Phase 2 (ToolDispatcher): Koko koodikannasta (paitsi tools/tavily.py) ei löydy enää sanaa "Tavily".

docs.title: Epic 91.5: The Universal DTO Bridge (Vaihe 1/3)
docs.text: [!IMPORTANT] Tämä on ensimmäinen osa kolmivaiheisesta arkkitehtuurimigraatiosta (Epic 91.5 -> Epic 92 -> Epic 93). Tämän Epicin ainoa tavoite on luoda uusi datakontrakti (Pydantic DTO), pakottaa nykyinen ohjelmisto käyttämään sitä (Anti-Corruption Layerin kautta) ja varmistaa tietokannan yhteensopivuus. Vasta tämän jälkeen aletaan rakentamaan uutta asynkronista DAG-moottoria (Epic 92) tai käyttöliittymän renderöintiä (Epic 93).

docs.title: 1. Yhteenveto ja Tavoite (Objective)
docs.text:
Quorumin järjestelmä kärsii tällä hetkellä epäyhtenäisistä tietorakenteista (Nested Trees, raw Markdown payloadit). Jotta voimme myöhemmin rakentaa deterministisen DAG-moottorin ja aidon Server-Driven UI:n (SDUI), meidän on ensin lukittava yksi absoluuttinen datamuoto.

Epic 91.5 luo Flat Adjacency List -muotoisen DTO-kannan. Se erottaa dynaamisen suoritustilan (results) staattisesta ontologiadatasta (hydrated_references), minimoiden payloadin koon, maksimoiden Pydantic V2:n suorituskyvyn ja taaten O(1) SDUI-haut frontendille ilman rekursiivisia laskutoimituksia.

docs.title: 2. Pydantic V2 DTO -Määrittely (01-python-backend.md Compliance)
docs.text:
Nämä mallit muodostavat uuden, lopullisen sillan Backendin ja Frontendin/PDF-generaattorin välille. Mallit on jäädytetty (frozen=True, strict=True) ja ne pakottavat referentiaalisen eheyden (Fail-Fast).

[!IMPORTANT] Tier 3 Mandaatti (SSOT Decomposition): Tietorakenteesta tulee liian iso yhteen tiedostoon koodattavaksi. Yli 500 rivin God Code -tiedostoja ei sallita. DTO-kanta on jaettava alikansioon backend_v2/models/dtos/report/. * enums.py: (Sijaitsee backend_v2/models/enums.py) Kaikki globaalit tilat kuten ExecutionStatus. * shared.py: Yhteiset rakenteet (esim. virheet, ErrorDetailsDTO). * atoms.py: Solmutason rakenteet (esim. AtomResultDTO, HydratedAtomDTO) * metrics.py: Suorituskykymittarit * root.py: Vain pääluokka ReportDataDto, joka kokoaa muut yhteen.

Kehäriippuvuuksien (Circular Dependency) Esto: DTO-mallit sijaitsevat riippuvuusgraafin ehdottomalla pohjalla (Layer 0). DTO-tiedostot (backend_v2/models/...) eivät saa koskaan importata mitään järjestelmän ylemmiltä tasoilta, kuten services (esim. AliasEngine) tai api. Palvelut (Services) saavat importata malleja, mutta mallit eivät koskaan palveluita. Tämä sääntö estää ImportError: cannot import name -kaatumiset Pydantic-validaattoreissa.

Alla on koko rakenteen looginen sisältö, joka tulee hajauttaa yllä mainitun säännön mukaisesti:

from enum import Enum
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator
from typing import Annotated, Self

# File: backend_v2/models/enums.py (strict_configuration_segregation)
class ExecutionStatus(str, Enum):
    """
    Str-Enum is mandatory for OpenAPI/Swagger generation,
    ensuring Flutter receives type-safe classes instead of Literal strings.
    """
    PASSED = "PASSED"
    FAILED = "FAILED"
    N_A = "N_A"
    SYSTEM_ERROR = "SYSTEM_ERROR"
    BLOCKED = "BLOCKED"
    PENDING = "PENDING"
    RUNNING = "RUNNING"  # DAG macro-orchestration requires runtime states
    QUEUED = "QUEUED"

    @property
    def l10n_key(self) -> str:
        """strict_enum_l10n_mapping: Guarantees Flutter .arb compatibility"""
        return f"status_{self.name.lower()}"

class SDUIComponentType(str, Enum):
    """no_raw_string_enum_mappings: Prevents Magic String crashes in Flutter."""
    BOOLEAN_CARD = "boolean_card"
    EXTRACTED_VALUE_CARD = "extracted_value_card"
    ERROR_CARD = "error_card"
    N_A_CARD = "n_a_card"

    @property
    def l10n_key(self) -> str:
        return f"sdui_{self.name.lower()}"

class ErrorDetailsDTO(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(strict=True, frozen=True, extra='forbid')
    error_code: Annotated[str, Field(description="Standardized error code, e.g., LLM_TIMEOUT")]
    message: Annotated[str, Field(description="Technical error message or stack trace")]

class HydratedAtomDTO(BaseModel):
    """
    Static ontology data. Perfectly cacheable.
    Must not contain any dynamic execution-related data.
    """
    model_config = ConfigDict(strict=True, frozen=True, extra='forbid')
    sdui_component: Annotated[SDUIComponentType, Field(description="Server-Driven UI hint for frontend. Ensures frontend performs no reasoning logic.")]
    resolved_claim: Annotated[str, Field(description="Cleaned claim in human language")]
    source_quote: Annotated[str | None, Field(default=None, description="Verbatim original quote from the document (static forensic evidence)")]

class ExtractedValueDTO(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(strict=True, frozen=True, extra='forbid')
    value: str | float | int | bool
    unit: Annotated[str | None, Field(default=None, description="Unit of measurement, e.g., 'tCO2e' or 'EUR'")]

class AtomResultDTO(BaseModel):
    """
    Dynamic execution data (DAG node).
    """
    model_config = ConfigDict(strict=True, frozen=True, extra='forbid')
    tda_id: Annotated[str, Field(description="Opaque ID pointing to the hydrated_references dictionary key")]
    status: ExecutionStatus
    extracted_data: Annotated[ExtractedValueDTO | None, Field(default=None, description="Quantitative or isolated result")]
    source_quote: Annotated[str | None, Field(default=None, description="Verbatim original quote from the document")]
    contextual_override: Annotated[bool, Field(default=False, description="Allows cognitive override without a verbatim quote")]
    evaluation_reasoning: Annotated[str | None, Field(default=None, description="Strictly AI cognitive reasoning, no infra errors")]
    error_details: Annotated[ErrorDetailsDTO | None, Field(default=None, description="Populated only if status is SYSTEM_ERROR")]

    depends_on_tda_ids: Annotated[list[str], Field(default_factory=list, description="DAG adjacency list")]
    short_circuit_reason_tda_ids: Annotated[list[str], Field(default_factory=list)]

    @model_validator(mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def validate_cognitive_vs_system_state(cls, data: Any) -> Any:
        """Fail-Fast & Graceful Healing: Prevents hallucinations and incomplete data before freeze."""
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            # Null-Hypothesis Override (blind_extraction_null_hypothesis)
            if data.get('contextual_override') is True and data.get('source_quote') is not None:
                # Healing: Jos LLM hallusinoi lainauksen, pyyhitään se turvallisesti mode='before'
                data['source_quote'] = None

            status = data.get('status')
            if status in ("PASSED", "FAILED", ExecutionStatus.PASSED, ExecutionStatus.FAILED):
                if not data.get('evaluation_reasoning'):
                    raise ValueError(f"Reasoning is mandatory for cognitive status {status}")
                if not data.get('contextual_override') and not data.get('source_quote'):
                    raise ValueError("source_quote is mandatory unless contextual_override is True")

            if status in ("SYSTEM_ERROR", ExecutionStatus.SYSTEM_ERROR) and not data.get('error_details'):
                raise ValueError("Error details are mandatory when status is SYSTEM_ERROR")
        return data

class ExecutionMetricsDTO(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(strict=True, frozen=True, extra='forbid')
    total_atoms: int
    evaluated: int
    short_circuited_na: int
    duration_ms: Annotated[int, Field(default=0, description="Execution duration in milliseconds for observability")]

class GlobalSynthesisDTO(BaseModel):
    """
    Data structure for high-level synthesized reports.
    """
    model_config = ConfigDict(strict=True, frozen=True, extra='forbid')
    executive_summary: Annotated[str | None, Field(default=None, description="High-level synthesized summary")]
    urgency_level: Annotated[int | None, Field(default=None)]

class ReportDataDto(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(strict=True, frozen=True, extra='forbid')
    execution_id: str
    workflow_id: Annotated[str, Field(description="For UI correlation")]
    global_metrics: ExecutionMetricsDTO
    global_synthesis: Annotated[GlobalSynthesisDTO | None, Field(
        default=None, 
        description="Stores the final synthesized output of the document."
    )]
    results: Annotated[list[AtomResultDTO], Field(
        description="SDUI-RULE: Backend must return this list strictly topologically sorted. Frontend does not compute the DAG."
    )]
    hydrated_references: Annotated[dict[str, HydratedAtomDTO], Field(
        description="O(1) Dictionary: tda_id -> Static text."
    )]

    @model_validator(mode='after')
    def enforce_referential_integrity(self) -> Self:
        """
        FAIL-FAST ARCHITECTURE INVARIANT:
        Ensures that every tda_id present in the results list and dependencies
        actually exists in the hydrated_references dictionary.
        """
        ref_keys = set(self.hydrated_references.keys())

        # Declarative Set Logic (declarative_set_logic_mandate)
        used_ids = {res.tda_id for res in self.results}
        dep_ids = {dep for res in self.results for dep in res.depends_on_tda_ids}
        sc_ids = {sc for res in self.results for sc in res.short_circuit_reason_tda_ids}

        all_referenced_ids = used_ids | dep_ids | sc_ids
        missing_keys = all_referenced_ids - ref_keys

        if missing_keys:
            raise ValueError(f"Referential Integrity Error: Missing keys in hydrated_references: {missing_keys}")

        return self

docs.title: 3. Pakotettu Migraatio ja No Fallback -politiikka (Hard Cutover)
docs.text:
Järjestelmä on siirrettävä käyttämään tätä uutta DTO:ta välittömästi kokonaisuudessaan.

[!CAUTION] Tier 3 Mandaatti (Hard Cutover / No Proxies): Strangler Fig -malli (vanhan koodin tilapäinen ylläpito adapterien ja @deprecated-proxyjen avulla) on hylätty, koska se jättää koodikantaan vaarallisen "ikuisen teknisen velan" (Hollow Shells). Epic-sarja (91.5, 92, 93) toteutetaan puhtaana "Big Bang" -tyylisenä Hard Cutoverina.

  • Ei Adaptereita: Mitään legacy_dto_mapper.py -kääntäjiä vanhan ja uuden välille ei rakenneta.
  • Delete, don't Deprecate: Vanha moottorikoodi ja rakenteet poistetaan (Delete) koodikannasta suoraan, eikä niitä jätetä kummittelemaan proxy-metodeina.
  • Hyväksytty Katkos: Koodikanta on arkkitehtuurisesti rikki Epicien 91.5 ja 92 implementoinnin ajan. Järjestelmä palautuu täyteen toimintakuntoon vasta Epicin 93 valmistuessa, jolloin se on 100% puhdas, ilman pisaraakaan legacy-koodia.

docs.title: Käyttöliittymä (SDUI) ja PDF
docs.text:
Flutter refaktoroidaan lukemaan dataa olettaen, että Backend on hoitanut topologisen lajittelun. Flutter purkaa UI-komponentit lukemalla results-listaa ja hakemalla tekstit O(1)-operaatioina hydrated_references-sanakirjasta käyttäen sdui_component-vihjettä. Kaikki puiden rekursiivinen parsiminen (Nested Traversing) poistetaan UI-koodista.

[!CAUTION] Main Thread Jank -esto (main_thread_jank_isolate): Massiivisen (jopa tuhansia atomeja sisältävän) DTO-JSON-payloadin synkroninen purkaminen Flutterin pääsäikeessä jäädyttäisi käyttöliittymän (Frame Drop). Payloadin JSON-parsiminen (jsonDecode) ja instanssien muuntaminen on pakotettu suoritettavaksi taustasäikeessä käyttäen Dartin await Isolate.run() -komentoa. Pääsäie vastaa vain renderöinnistä.

docs.title: Tietokannan Historiadatan Käsittely (Atomic Transition)
docs.text:
Koska vanhat DTO-mallit poistetaan, olemassa oleva kanta-data hajoaisi noudettaessa. * Vanhat ajo-objektit (Execution runs): Nämä voidaan poistaa / nollata (Wipe). Tuotantotietokannassa historiallisia ajoja ei yritetä parsia uusiksi graafeiksi. * Tulostusmäärittelyt (Definitions / Prompt Blocks): Näille on tehtävä datamigraatioskripti. Määrittelyt siirretään kerralla tukemaan uutta mallia.

[!IMPORTANT] Tier 3 Mandaatti (Phase 0: Coverage Bootstrap & Zero Behavioral Change): Vaikka tuotannon historialliset ajot voidaan nollata, testien dataa (fixtures/mocks) ei saa koskaan sokeasti tuhota. Jos testidata poistetaan, järjestelmän testikattavuus romahtaa ja uuden moottorin rakentaminen on sokeaa leikkausta.

Ennen yhdenkään Epic 92:n moottoritiedoston refaktorointia on suoritettava Characterization Tests (Golden Master): 1. Olemassa olevien testien testidata ja fixturet on konvertoitava uuteen DTO-muotoon. 2. Testit on saatava vihreiksi uutta DTO-rakennetta vasten, jotta voidaan matemaattisesti taata Zero Behavioral Change (uusi moottori ei vahingossa muuta liiketoimintasääntöjä). 3. Auditoidessa on aggressiivisesti puhdistettava orvot fixturet (Orphaned Fixture Cleanup), jotka eivät enää palvele uutta arkkitehtuuria, jotta 100% testikattavuusvaatimus säilyy aitona.

docs.title: 4. Havaitut Uhat ja Arkkitehtuurilliset Korjaukset
docs.text:
Tämä DTO-silta torjuu seuraavat järjestelmätason uhat ennen Epic 92/93 aloittamista:

  • Orvot viittaukset ja referentiaalisen eheyden romahdus (Fail-Fast): Uusi DTO-malli voisi teoriassa luottaa implisiittisesti siihen, että tda_id-viittaukset täsmäävät hydrated_references -sanakirjan avaimiin. Järjestelmäarkkitehtuurimme kuitenkin kieltää implisiittisen luottamuksen. Korjaus: Estetty lisäämällä @model_validator(mode='after') -validaattori ReportDataDto:hon, joka varmistaa joukko-opilla, että yksikään atomi tai riippuvuus ei viittaa olemattomaan ID:hen. Tämä estää Frontendin Null-Pointer -kaatumiset välittömästi backendissä.
  • SDUI-pariteetin turvaaminen (Frontend Logic Ban): Jos Backend lähettää litteän listan, Frontend ei saa vastata DAG-puun topologisesta järjestämisestä. Korjaus: Backendin on palautettava results-lista valmiiksi topologisesti järjestettynä. Lisättiin sdui_component -tyyppivihje (sidottu SDUIComponentType -enumiin). Frontendin ei tule koskaan "päätellä", miten tieto esitetään, vaan sen on sokeasti toteltava backendin ohjeita.
  • OpenAPI- ja LLM-sopimusten löyhyys: Ratkaistu koodigeneraatiota tukevalla ExecutionStatus(str, Enum) -luokalla, sekä kognitiivisen tilan validaattorilla (validate_cognitive_vs_system_state), joka tekee perusteluista pakollisia onnistuessa.
  • Anti-Corruption Layer ja Kanta-migraatio (Duct-Tape Riski): Täsmennettiin tilapäisen adapterin ehtoja: se ei saa koskaan niellä virheitä (esim. try/except pass -fallbackeilla), vaan sen on kaaduttava deterministisesti (HTTP 500), jos vanha moottori tuottaa rikkonaista tai yhteensopimatonta dataa. Lisäksi vaaditaan tietokantojen migraatio tai tyhjennys, koska vanhojen DTO-mallien poistaminen koodikannasta hajoittaa väistämättä olemassa olevien dokumenttien deserialisoinnin.
  • Pydantic V2 Enum Strict Casing & Raw Database Updates (No-String Mandate Strictness): Pydantic V2:n StrEnum on erittäin tiukka kirjainkoon suhteen (esim. ExecutionStatus.RUNNING eikä "running"). Jos tietokantaa (kuten TinyDB) päivitetään suoraan raw-sanakirjoilla ohittaen Pydantic-validaatio (esim. {"status": "running"}), kirjoitus onnistuu, mutta sitä seuraava luku (model_validate) kaatuu ValidationError-virheeseen. Arkkitehtuurisääntö: Kovakoodattujen status-merkkijonojen käyttö koodikannassa on ehdottomasti kielletty. Tietokantapäivityksissä on aina käytettävä enumin .value -attribuuttia (esim. ExecutionStatus.RUNNING.value) silloin kun päivitetään dict-muodossa.
  • DAG Macro-Orchestration Status -synkronisaatio (Magic Strings -kielto): Aiempi tapa käyttää vapaita merkkijonoja (kuten "completed", "finished", "done") aiheutti synkronointiongelmia backendin, tietokannan ja käyttöliittymän (Frontend) välillä, ja romutti OpenAPI/Swagger-rajapintakuvauksen luotettavuuden. ExecutionStatus toimii nyt järjestelmän Single Source of Truth -luokkana, jonka on tuettava reaaliaikaisia tilasiirtymiä (RUNNING, QUEUED) ja tiukasti määriteltyjä lopputiloja. Arkkitehtuurisääntö: Vanha, epätarkka COMPLETED-tila on poistettu (deprecated). Ohjelmistoarkkitehtuurissa kaatunut ajo (FAILED) on myös "valmis", joten pelkkä "completed" on liian moniselitteinen. Tästä lähtien päättynyt tila ilmaistaan aina yksiselitteisesti joko PASSED (onnistui) tai FAILED (kaatui). Pydanticin Fail-Fast -validointi (strict=True) estää automaattisesti näiden sääntöjen rikkomisen.
