docs.title: Negative Verification (Anti-Happy-Path)
docs.text:
1. Feed invalid Python code (def broken() -> Verify scanner returns QGR000: FATAL_SYNTAX_ERROR without process crash and exits with code 1 even in advisory mode.
  2. Feed Python code with unclosed multi-line string (x = """unclosed) -> Verify tokenizer captures tokenize.TokenError and yields QGR000: FATAL without crashing scanner.
  3. Feed deeply nested expression tree (500+ operators) -> Verify visitor captures RecursionError and yields QGR000: FATAL with depth message.
  4. Feed multiple files where file 1 is invalid Python and file 2 contains getattr -> Verify both file 1 (QGR000) and file 2 (QGR001) are reported in the violation list.
  5. Feed invalid Python code with # noqa: QGR000 -> Verify violation is NOT suppressed (Fatal immunity).
  6. Feed code containing getattr(obj, "field", None) without noqa -> Verify audit loop in strict mode exits with code 1 and logs QGR001: BAN_REFLECTION_DUCK_TYPING.
  7. Feed code containing getattr(obj, "field", None) # noqa: QGR001 -> Verify audit loop passes cleanly (Suppression Gate).
  8. Feed code containing except Exception: pass -> Verify audit loop in strict mode exits with code 1 and logs QGR003: BAN_SILENT_EXCEPTION.
  9. Feed code containing d.get("key", "") in backend_v2/services/ -> Verify audit loop in strict mode exits with code 1 and logs QGR002: BAN_LAZY_GET_FALLBACK.
  10. Feed code containing os.environ.get("PORT", "8000") -> Verify audit loop passes cleanly (Zero False Positives on standard libraries).
  11. Feed code containing class X(BaseModel): def __new__(cls): ... in models/ -> Verify audit loop in strict mode exits with code 1 and logs QGR004: BAN_PYDANTIC_METAPROGRAMMING.
  12. Feed code containing asyncio.gather(*tasks) -> Verify audit loop in strict mode exits with code 1 and logs QGR006: BAN_ASYNCIO_GATHER.
  13. Feed code containing class X(BaseModel): pass missing model_config = ConfigDict(strict=True, extra="forbid") -> Verify audit loop in strict mode exits with code 1 and logs QGR007: ENFORCE_PYDANTIC_STRICTNESS.
  14. Feed code containing httpx.Client(timeout=10) in backend_v2/services/ -> Verify audit loop in strict mode exits with code 1 and logs QGR008: BAN_HARDCODED_MAGIC_TIMEOUTS.
  15. Feed code containing raise AppException("Raw message string") without ErrorCodes enum -> Verify audit loop in strict mode exits with code 1 and logs QGR009: ENFORCE_TYPED_ERROR_CODES.
  16. Feed code containing naive datetime.now() without tz or datetime.utcnow() -> Verify audit loop in strict mode exits with code 1 and logs QGR010: BAN_NAIVE_DATETIME.
  17. Feed code containing datetime.now(UTC) or datetime.now(timezone.utc) -> Verify audit loop passes cleanly (Zero False Positives on UTC).
  18. Feed code containing string literal x = "getattr" -> Verify audit loop passes cleanly (Zero False Positives on literals).
  19. Feed Jinja template with read permissions error -> Verify audit loop exits with code 1 (Fail-Fast Jinja Gate).
  20. Feed simulated subprocess failure (returncode=1) for Ruff check/format, MyPy strict, or Seed data dry-run in test_backend_audit_loop.py -> Verify audit loop fails fast and calls sys.exit(1) deterministically without spawning real system processes (hermetic_subprocess_mocking_mandate).
  21. Feed markdown plan with missing line bounds -> Verify audit_planner_output.py returns structured PlannerFidelityReport with exact missing line bound list.
  22. Feed markdown document with unclosed XML tag -> Verify audit_markdown_boundaries.py reports MarkdownAuditFinding with line number and expected closing tag.
  23. Feed audit matrix with placeholder justification -> Verify audit_matrix_manager.py verify exits with code 1.
  24. Feed markdown document with bare target file in step attribute (<step target="scripts/file.py">) -> Verify audit_markdown_boundaries.py / audit_planner_output.py requires or normalizes @[path] and validates AST line bounds.

docs.text:
Following the completion of the Backend Targeted Hardening Waves 1–4 (133/133 files across @[docs/implementationplans/TRACKER_Backend_Targeted_Hardening.md], @[docs/implementationplans/TRACKER_Backend_Targeted_Hardening_Wave2.md], @[docs/implementationplans/TRACKER_Backend_Targeted_Hardening_Wave3.md], and @[docs/implementationplans/TRACKER_Backend_Targeted_Hardening_Wave4.md]) and the 32-hex PrefixedUUID7 & UUIDv4 eradication cutovers (15/15 in @[docs/implementationplans/TRACKER_Prefixed_UUIDv7_Cutover.md] and 31/31 in @[docs/implementationplans/TRACKER_Universal_UUIDv4_Eradication_and_32Hex_UUIDv7_Enforcement.md]), this plan implements five permanent quality gate and autonomous hardening improvements for Step 3.4 of @[docs/KATTAVA TUOTANTOARKITEHTUURIN IMPLEMENTO.md]:

  1. QGR031 — Query Filter & FilterOperator Static AST Guardrail (@[scripts/_ast_guardrails.py#L573-L586]): Inspects all Filter(...) and QueryCondition(...) call sites across backend_v2/, scripts/, and tests to ban invalid operator string literals ("eq", "ne", "gt", "lt", "=", "LIKE", "ILIKE"), empty field="" arguments, and string literals passed as the value of FilterOperator (IN / "in") queries.
  2. Dynamic scripts/*.py Macro-Gate Discovery (@[scripts/backend_audit_loop.py#L68-L78] & @[scripts/backend_audit_loop.py#L422-L682]): Replaces hardcoded script whitelisting with a deterministic discover_authoritative_scripts() function scanning sorted(Path("scripts").glob("*.py")) so newly created scripts can never bypass Ruff, MyPy --strict, QGR000–QGR033, or audit_dict_eradication.py.
  3. QGR032 — Polyfactory ModelFactory 32-Hex UUIDv7 Invariant Guard & Dynamic Reflection Meta-Test (@[scripts/_ast_guardrails.py#L589-L609] & @[backend_v2/tests/factories/test_model_factories.py#L71-L90]): Enforces at the AST level in backend_v2/tests/factories/model_factories.py that every ModelFactory[T] class routes entity ID fields through Use(generate_opaque_id, EntityPrefix.<TYPE>), and upgrades test_model_factories.py to dynamically discover all ModelFactory subclasses via __subclasses__().
  4. QGR020 PEP 593 Annotated[..., Field(...)] Extension & QGR033 Static Docstring / RFC 7807 Dual-Reporting Guardrail (@[scripts/_ast_guardrails.py#L573-L586] & @[scripts/_ast_guardrails.py#L589-L609]): Shifts high-frequency LLM hardening checks directly into scripts/_ast_guardrails.py so violations are caught deterministically in milliseconds during /tier2-execute:
  5. Check 20B (pydantic_annotated_fields_mandate in QGR020): Bans bare field: T = Field(...) assignments on BaseModel / BaseSettings subclasses where the type annotation is not wrapped in Annotated[T, ...] (with self-verifying RESIDUAL_BARE_FIELD_FILES protecting the 25 pre-existing files until touched).
  6. Check 33A (docstring_fail_fast_ban in QGR033): Bans Raises: None across all module, class, and function docstrings (0 existing violations repo-wide).
  7. Check 33B (pep257_google_style_docstrings in QGR033): Requires PEP 257 docstrings on all production backend_v2/ modules and top-level public classes (with self-verifying RESIDUAL_MISSING_DOCSTRING_FILES for the 4 pre-existing module-docstring files).
  8. Check 33C (rfc7807_dual_reporting_mandate in QGR033): Requires every production domain function or method raising AppException(...) to invoke a structured error log (logger.error, logger.critical, logger.exception, or _log_) within the enclosing function scope (with RESIDUAL_UNLOGGED_APP_EXCEPTION_FILES for backend_v2/logging_config.py, backend_v2/exceptions.py, and backend_v2/services/auth/repositories.py).
  9. Deterministic Content-Addressed SHA-256 Hardening Cache & Completed Tracker Seeding (@[scripts/auto_hardening_runner.py#L133-L179], @[scripts/auto_hardening_runner.py#L182-L196], @[scripts/auto_hardening_runner.py#L340-L394], @[scripts/auto_hardening_runner.py#L970-L1027], @[scripts/auto_hardening_runner.py#L1030-L1173], @[scripts/auto_hardening_runner.py#L1176-L1336]): Implements a persistent, strongly typed SHA-256 cache (data/hardening_cache.json governed by newly defined HardeningCacheEntryDTO and HardeningCacheManifestDTO models) in scripts/auto_hardening_runner.py that computes the composite SHA-256 digest of (target_file + resolved unit test file(s) + .agents/rules/*.md). Automatically seeds completed - [x] targets from @[docs/implementationplans/TRACKER_Backend_Targeted_Hardening.md], @[docs/implementationplans/TRACKER_Backend_Targeted_Hardening_Wave2.md], @[docs/implementationplans/TRACKER_Backend_Targeted_Hardening_Wave3.md], @[docs/implementationplans/TRACKER_Backend_Targeted_Hardening_Wave4.md], @[docs/implementationplans/TRACKER_Prefixed_UUIDv7_Cutover.md], and @[docs/implementationplans/TRACKER_Universal_UUIDv4_Eradication_and_32Hex_UUIDv7_Enforcement.md]. When a target's composite SHA-256 is unchanged since its last successful hardening commit, auto_hardening_runner.py marks the target - [x] in 0 seconds (⚡ CACHE HIT) without launching an LLM subagent.

<pre><code><execution_protocol>
  <phase id="1" name="Static AST Guardrails QGR020, QGR031, QGR032, QGR033 &amp; Dynamic Script Discovery">
    <step id="1" name="Implement QGR020 Bare Field Ban, QGR031 Filter Guard, QGR032 Factory Guard &amp; QGR033 Docstring/RFC7807 Guard in scripts/_ast_guardrails.py">

      <constraint invariant="pydantic_annotated_fields_mandate">Ban bare type annotations combined with = Field(...) on Pydantic classes unless wrapped in PEP 593 Annotated[T, ...].</constraint>
      <constraint invariant="rfc7807_dual_reporting_mandate">Require structured logger.error / logger.critical / logger.exception in any domain function or method that raises AppException.</constraint>
      <constraint invariant="docstring_fail_fast_ban">Ban 'Raises: None' in all docstrings across production and script modules.</constraint>
      <action>
        1. In `@[scripts/_ast_guardrails.py#L573-L586]` and `@[scripts/_ast_guardrails.py#L589-L609]`, define the self-verifying residual sets, `QGR031` operator constants, and pure AST helpers (and export the residual sets in `__all__`):
           - `RESIDUAL_BARE_FIELD_FILES: frozenset[str]` containing the exact closed list of 25 pre-existing files with legacy `= Field(...)` assignments (specifically and exhaustively: `"backend_v2/core/hook_registry.py"`, `"backend_v2/core/registry.py"`, `"backend_v2/exceptions.py"`, `"backend_v2/models/domain/execution.py"`, `"backend_v2/models/domain/inputs.py"`, `"backend_v2/models/domain/matrix.py"`, `"backend_v2/models/domain/output_profile.py"`, `"backend_v2/models/domain/prompt_blocks.py"`, `"backend_v2/models/domain/step.py"`, `"backend_v2/models/domain/system_config.py"`, `"backend_v2/models/domain/workflow.py"`, `"backend_v2/models/dtos/engine.py"`, `"backend_v2/models/dtos/hook_state.py"`, `"backend_v2/models/dtos/quote_evidence.py"`, `"backend_v2/models/dtos/report_data.py"`, `"backend_v2/models/dtos/theory_manifest.py"`, `"backend_v2/models/llm.py"`, `"backend_v2/models/view/sdui.py"`, `"backend_v2/services/chat_parser.py"`, `"backend_v2/services/execution/ingress_service.py"`, `"backend_v2/services/orchestrator/strategies/llm_execution/source_document_packer.py"`, `"scripts/ablation_live_executor.py"`, `"scripts/audit_database_atoms.py"`, `"scripts/diff_executions.py"`, `"scripts/reconcile_storage.py"`).
           - `RESIDUAL_MISSING_DOCSTRING_FILES: frozenset[str]` containing the exact closed list of 4 pre-existing module-docstring files (specifically and exhaustively: `"backend_v2/models/dtos/variance.py"`, `"backend_v2/services/orchestrator/extraction_schema_factory.py"`, `"backend_v2/services/orchestrator/rag_preflight_service.py"`, `"backend_v2/services/orchestrator/schema_factory.py"`).
           - `RESIDUAL_UNLOGGED_APP_EXCEPTION_FILES: frozenset[str]` containing the exact closed list of 3 files (specifically and exhaustively: `"backend_v2/exceptions.py"`, `"backend_v2/logging_config.py"`, `"backend_v2/services/auth/repositories.py"`).
           - `_QGR031_VALID_OPERATOR_LITERALS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({"==", "!=", ">", ">=", "<", "<=", "in", "array_contains", "array-contains"})` and `_QGR031_VALID_ENUM_ATTRS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({"EQ", "NE", "GT", "GTE", "LT", "LTE", "IN", "CONTAINS"})`.
           - `_RAISES_NONE_REGEX: re.Pattern[str] = re.compile(r"Raises:\s*(?:\n\s*)?None\b")`.
           - `_is_annotated_subscript(annotation: ast.AST | None) -> bool`: Returns `True` if `annotation` is an `ast.Subscript` whose `value` is `ast.Name(id="Annotated")` or `ast.Attribute(attr="Annotated")`.
           - `_function_has_error_log(fn_node: ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef) -> bool`: Walks `fn_node` (excluding nested `FunctionDef`/`AsyncFunctionDef`/`ClassDef` scopes) and returns `True` if any `ast.Call` invokes `logger.error`, `logger.critical`, `logger.exception`, `log.error`, `logging.error`, or a helper function whose identifier contains `log_error` or `_log_`.

        2. In `QuorumGuardrailVisitor.visit_Module` in `scripts/_ast_guardrails.py`:

           - **QGR033 Check 33B (Module Docstring Guard)**: If `not self._is_test_file and self._is_domain_code` and `norm_path` is not in `RESIDUAL_MISSING_DOCSTRING_FILES`, emit `FATAL` `QGR033` if `not ast.get_docstring(node)`.
        3. In `QuorumGuardrailVisitor._check_qgr031_filter_call` and `visit_Call` in `scripts/_ast_guardrails.py`:
           - **QGR031 (`Filter` / `QueryCondition` Static Discipline)**: When `node.func` is `Name(id="Filter" | "QueryCondition")` or `Attribute(attr="Filter" | "QueryCondition")` (and not `is_guardrail_self`), resolve `field_arg`, `op_arg`, and `value_arg` from positional (`args[0..2]`) or keyword (`field=`, `operator=`, `op=`, `value=`) arguments and emit `FATAL` `QGR031` if:
             a) `field_arg` is `ast.Constant(value=str(s))` with `s.strip() == ""`,
             b) `op_arg` is `ast.Constant(value=str(op_s))` not in `_QGR031_VALID_OPERATOR_LITERALS` or `ast.Attribute(value=ast.Name(id="FilterOperator"), attr=attr_s)` not in `_QGR031_VALID_ENUM_ATTRS`,
             c) `op_arg` resolves to `"in"` or `FilterOperator` (`IN`) and `value_arg` is `ast.Constant(value=str() | bytes())`.
        4. In `QuorumGuardrailVisitor.visit_ClassDef` in `scripts/_ast_guardrails.py`:
           - **QGR033 Check 33A &amp; 33B**: Check `ast.get_docstring(node)` for `_RAISES_NONE_REGEX` (when `not self.is_guardrail_self`), and if `not self._is_test_file and self._is_domain_code and self._function_depth == 0 and not node.name.startswith("_")`, emit `FATAL` `QGR033` if `not ast.get_docstring(node)`.
           - **QGR032 (Polyfactory `ModelFactory` 32-Hex `UUIDv7` Invariant)**: When `norm_path.endswith("backend_v2/tests/factories/model_factories.py")` (or `not self.is_guardrail_self` and class inherits from `ModelFactory[...]`), inspect class body assignments (`ast.Assign` / `ast.AnnAssign`) targeting `"id"`, `"organization_id"`, `"node_id"`, `"execution_id"`, `"workflow_id"`, or `"profile_id"`, and emit `FATAL` `QGR032` unless the assigned value is a `Use(generate_opaque_id, ...)` call.
        5. In `QuorumGuardrailVisitor.visit_FunctionDef` and `visit_AsyncFunctionDef` in `scripts/_ast_guardrails.py`:
           - Add helper `self._check_qgr033_function_contracts(node)`:
             a) If `not self.is_guardrail_self`, inspect `ast.get_docstring(node)` and emit `FATAL` `QGR033` if `_RAISES_NONE_REGEX.search(doc)` matches.
             b) If `self._is_domain_code and not self._is_test_file` and `norm_path` is not in `RESIDUAL_UNLOGGED_APP_EXCEPTION_FILES`, check `_find_direct_app_exception_raises(node)`. docs.title: IMPLEMENTATION PLAN: Dedikoitu tutkimusajuri ja ablaatiokoealusta (scripts/run_ablation_benchmark.py)
1. Executive Summary & Objective
docs.text:
Rooli: Principal Solutions Architect.

Tavoite (<objective>): Toteuttaa erillinen, itsenäinen tutkimusajuri [NEW] @[scripts/run_ablation_benchmark.py] ja sen kattava yksikkötestistö [NEW] @[backend_v2/tests/unit/scripts/test_run_ablation_benchmark.py] Quorum-tutkimusartikkelin (@[docs/tiede.md#L762-L820]) alaluvun 8.5 komponenttiablaatiokokeen (Table 5: Component Ablation across 220 Atom Evaluations) tieteellisesti aukottomaan empiiriseen suorittamiseen viidellä kokeellisella konfiguraatiolla korvaten synteettiset simulaatioluvut aidoilla fyysisillä mittauksilla.

Pääasialliset arkkitehtoniset ratkaisut: 1. Tuotantokoodin koskemattomuus (Zero Production Mutation): Tuotantokoodiin (backend_v2/) ei lisätä haitallisia ohituskytkimiä tai heuristiikkahaaroja. Tutkimusajuri toimii itsenäisenä komentorivityökaluna hyödyntäen suoraan olemassa olevia palveluita (LLMClient, LLMTaskExecutor, AnchorValidationService, MatrixSensorPromptBuilder). 2. Kaksitilainen suoritusarkkitehtuuri (Dual-Mode Execution): - Live-ajotila (Physical Empirical Mode): Konfiguraatio 1 hyödyntää fyysisiä tuotantoajoja (data/files/executions/exe_*), ja Konfiguraatiot 2–5 suoritetaan aitoina live-LLM-kutsuina hyödyntäen LLMClient.from_strategy("fast") -asiakasta ja LLMTaskExecutor.execute_structured_task() -palvelua muistissa. 110 atomin eräajona (5 työvaihetta = ~8 eräkyselyä per run) 4 toistoajoa kuluttaa yhteensä vain 180 LLM-kutsua (kustannus alle 3,00 USD Google Gemini 3.8 Flash -mallilla). - Kuiva-ajotila (--dry-run): Säilytetään deterministinen synteettinen simulaatiotila nopeaa, verkotonta ja kulutonta CI/CD-yksikkötestausta varten. 3. Viiden kokeellisen konfiguraation rinnakkaisajo: - Konfiguraatio 1 (Full Quorum): Fyysisistä tuotantoajoista kootut metriikat: täysi leksikaalinen palomuuri (AnchorValidationService), roolierottelu (<user_payload> vs. <ai_draft_context>), asymmetrinen falsifikaatio ja Best-of-3 -konsensus (ensemble_parallelism = 3). - Konfiguraatio 2 (Quorum without Lexical Firewall): Aito Best-of-3 -äänestys aktiivinen (ensemble_parallelism = 3), mutta leksikaalista hylkäystä ei sovelleta tulokseen. Sitaatin todenperäisyys mitataan taustalla AnchorValidationService._is_lexically_valid -tarkistuksella, jolloin saadaan mitattua mallin todellinen Chimera / Unanchored Rate %. - Konfiguraatio 3 (Quorum Single-Pass): Täysi leksikaalinen palomuuri aktiivinen, mutta Best-of-3 -äänestys poissa käytöstä (ensemble_parallelism = 1, single-pass live-ajo), mitaten aidon aleatorisen token-kohinan vaikutuksen. - Konfiguraatio 4 (Atom-level Unconstrained LLM-as-a-Judge): Single-pass ($k=1$), ei leksikaalista palomuuria, suora arviointiprompti ilman TDA-nollahypoteesisääntöjä atomikohtaisena live-ajona. - Konfiguraatio 5 (Monolithic Step-Level LLM-as-a-Judge / Vanilla Benchmark): Monoliittinen steppipromptaus ilman atomisaatiota tai lyhytaliasointia: mallille syötetään koko dokumentti ja koko työvaiheen kaikki arviointikriteerit kerralla yhdellä kehotteella, mitaten suoraan empiiristä Lost-in-the-Middle -omissioastetta ja huomion herpaantumista. 4. Deterministinen tilastollinen raportointi (Table 5 Pariteetti): Skripti suorittaa kaksi toistoajoa per konfiguraatio, laskee Cohenin kappan ($\kappa_{\text{Cohen}}$), havaitun yksimielisyyden ($P_o$), keksittyjen sitaattien osuuden (Chimera Rate %), positiivisten hyväksyntöjen osuuden (Pass Rate %) sekä DLQ-virheet, tulostaen suoraan valmiin Markdown-taulukon Table 5.

Verification & Fail-Fast (Proof Anchor) [NEW] @[scripts/run_ablation_benchmark.py] Tuotantokoodiin (backend_v2/) upotetut if ablation_mode: -ohitusliput, rinnakkainen KappaMetricsDTO-kaksoismallinnus, importlib.import_module() -heijastuskutsut, model_copy(update=) -mutaatiot, alastomat sanakirjat (dict[str, Any]), kovakoodatut aikakatkaisut, laiska .get("key", default) -arvailu, satunnaiset modulo-hasherit (_stable_hash) korvaamassa aitoja LLM-kutsuja sekä Unicode charmap -tulostuskaatumiset Windows PowerShellissä. Täysin itsenäinen CLI-tutkimusskripti viidelle konfiguraatiolle ilman tuotantokoodin mutaatiota. Kaksitilainen arkkitehtuuri: aito asynkroninen live-LLM-ajo LLMClient.from_strategy("fast") -asiakkaalla ja LLMTaskExecutor.execute_structured_task() -palvelulla muistissa, sekä deterministinen --dry-run -kuiva-ajo verkkottomaan CI-testaukseen. Kaikki tila ja metriikat kapseloitu 100 % tyypitettyihin Pydantic V2 DTO -malleihin (ConfigDict(strict=True, extra="forbid", frozen=True)). Uudelleenkäyttää SSOT-funktiota calculate_cohens_kappa ja tyyppiä KappaMetricsDTO suoraan tiedostosta scripts.diff_executions. UTF-8 -tulostus pakotettu sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8"). Ei erillistä tietokanta- tai Arq-työntekijäriippuvuutta; suora kutsu LLMTaskExecutor- ja AnchorValidationService -palveluihin in-memory asyncio.TaskGroup -ajona. Ei rinnakkaista Kappa-laskuria tai monimutkaisia erillisiä visualisointikirjastoja. uv run python scripts/run_ablation_benchmark.py --dry-run --case both --config all --runs 2 palauttaa koodin 0 ja tulostaa Table 5:n (5 datariviä). Live-ajo uv run python scripts/run_ablation_benchmark.py --case both --config all --runs 2 suorittaa 180 kutsua ja tuottaa aidon Table 5:n. [NEW] @[backend_v2/tests/unit/scripts/test_run_ablation_benchmark.py] Testaamaton skriptikoodi, tautologiset mockit ilman invarianttitarkistuksia, pelkät manuaaliset CLI-tulostustarkistukset tai vain onnistumispolun (happy path) testaaminen. Täydet ISTQB-standardin mukaiset yksikkötestit (13 testiskenaariota), jotka kattavat CLI-validoinnin, virheellisten komentorivivalintojen välittömän pysäytyksen (SystemExit: 2), keksityn sitaatin (chimera) tunnistuksen, leksikaalisen palomuurin hylkäyksen nollahypoteesilla, Cohenin kappan raja-arvot (1.0 sopivuus ja jako-nollalla -suojaus), kutsujen kardinaalisuuden tarkistuksen ($k=3$ vs $k=1$ vs 1/steppi), monoliittisen arvioitsijan datamäppäyksen ja DLQ-virhe-eristyksen. Testit ajetaan puhtaassa muistitilassa ilman ulkoisia API-kutsuja hyödyntäen deterministisiä synteettisiä vastauksia. Ei verkkoyhteyksiä eikä maksullisia LLM-kutsuja. uv run python scripts/backend_audit_loop.py backend_v2/tests/unit/scripts/test_run_ablation_benchmark.py --test --ast-strict. @[docs/tiede.md#L762-L820] Arvaillut tai simulaattorilla generoidut ablaatioprosentit esitettynä empiirisinä tuloksina, ristiriita rajoitteiden alaluvussa 8.6 (jossa myönnettiin simulaatio) ja luvussa 10.1 (jossa todettiin ajojen halpuus), rikkinäiset Markdown-taulukkorakenteet. Empiirisen live-benchmark-ajurin tuottamat todennetut luvut suoraan osaksi luvun 8.5 taulukkoa Table 5, päivitetään tiivistelmän ja johtopäätösten luvut vastaamaan aitoja mittauksia ja poistetaan vanhentunut rajoitekohta 8.6.6 ("Synthetic Component Ablation vs. Direct Live-Ablation Re-runs") kohdassa @[docs/tiede.md#L789-L798]. Säilytetään kaikki aiemmat taulukot täysin muuttumattomina. Ei ylimääräistä metadokumentaatiota tai erillisiä rinnakkaisia tutkimusmuistioita; tulokset integroidaan suoraan tiedostoon docs/tiede.md. uv run python scripts/audit_markdown_boundaries.py --file docs/tiede.md.

docs.title: 4. Execution Protocol
docs.text:
<execution_protocol>
  <step id="1" name="PRE_IMPLEMENTATION_CLEANUPS_AND_DTO_CONTRACTS">
    <action>Tarkista ja vahvista uudelleenkäytettävät SSOT-riippuvuudet tiedostoista @[scripts/diff_executions.py#L122-L134] (KappaMetricsDTO), @[scripts/diff_executions.py#L610-L637] (get_all_evals) ja @[scripts/diff_executions.py#L683-L778] (calculate_cohens_kappa).</action>
    <action>Suorita 7 kohdan teknisen velan tarkistus ja korjaa havaitut puutteet tiedostossa @[scripts/run_ablation_benchmark.py]:
      - Poista rinnakkainen KappaMetricsDTO-malli ja importtaa se suoraan SSOT-moduulista scripts.diff_executions.
      - Korvaa importlib.import_module() -kutsu staattisella top-level -importilla: from scripts.diff_executions import calculate_cohens_kappa, KappaMetricsDTO, get_all_evals.
      - Poista model_copy(update=) -kutsu ja instansioi AblationBenchmarkReportDTO suoraan valmiilla kentillä.
      - Pakota UTF-8 -tulostus komentoriville: sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8") ja sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8") Windows PowerShell 5.1 -yhteensopivuudelle.
    </action>
    <action>Määrittele uuteen tutkimusajuriin [NEW] @[scripts/run_ablation_benchmark.py] puhtaat, pysyvät Pydantic V2 DTO -mallit (ConfigDict(strict=True, extra="forbid", frozen=True)):
      - AblationConfigDTO: konfiguraation tunnus (1-5), nimi, kuvaus, arviointitila (is_atomized: bool), rinnakkaisuusaste (ensemble_k: int), leksikaalisen palomuurin tila (has_lexical_firewall: bool) ja TDA-nollahypoteesisäännöt (has_null_hypothesis_rules: bool).
      - AblationPropositionDTO: arvioitava propositio, tda_id, step_id, claim_text, expected_true: bool, synthetic_quote: str | None ja is_quote_valid_in_source: bool.
      - AblationStepBatchDTO: työvaiheen propositioerä monoliittiselle arvioitsijalle, step_id ja propositions: list[AblationPropositionDTO].
      - AblationAtomEvaluationDTO: yksittäisen atomin evaluointitulos, tda_id, raw_is_true: bool, source_quote: str | None, is_chimera: bool, status: ExecutionStatus ja error_reason: str | None.
      - AblationConfigResultDTO: koottu konfiguraatiotulos (config_id, name, runs, total_atoms, observed_agreement, cohens_kappa, ci_lower, ci_upper, chimera_rate_pct, pass_rate_pct, dlq_rate_pct).
      - AblationBenchmarkReportDTO: kokonaisraportti sisältäen aikaleiman, aineistovalinnan (case_filter), kaikki konfiguraatiotulokset ja generoidun Table 5 Markdown -esityksen.
    </action>
    <constraint invariant="the_zero_compromise_pledge">Kaikki tilansiirto ja laskenta on suoritettava 100 % tyypitetyillä Pydantic V2 DTO -malleilla ilman alastomia sanakirjoja (dict[str, Any]) tai korvaavia oletusarvoja.</constraint>
  </step>

  <step id="2" name="IMPLEMENT_ABLATION_BENCHMARK_DRIVER_WITH_LIVE_EXECUTION">
    <action>Toteuta itsenäinen tutkimusajuri [NEW] @[scripts/run_ablation_benchmark.py] asynkroniseksi komentorivityökaluksi, joka tukee sekä live-LLM-ajoa että determinististä kuiva-ajoa viidelle kokeelliselle ablaatiokonfiguraatiolle:
      - Konfiguraatio 1 (Full Quorum): luetaan fyysisistä tuotantoajotiedostoista (@[data/files/executions/exe_04a02919612e45c0/execution_trace.json], @[data/files/executions/exe_a56127fa10594dc4/execution_trace.json], @[data/files/executions/exe_379b69df134f477a/execution_trace.json] ja @[data/files/executions/exe_f6f9b06e63eb4dd8/execution_trace.json]) aito empiirinen baseline funktiolla get_all_evals (ensemble_k = 3, täysi AnchorValidationService -validointi, roolierottelu ja Popperian nollahypoteesi).
      - Konfiguraatio 2 (Quorum without Lexical Firewall): live-ajo Bo3-enemmistöäänestyksellä (ensemble_k = 3); mallin is_true hyväksytään sellaisenaan tilaksi PASSED ilman leksikaalista estoa, mutta fyysisen sitaatin olemassaolo varmennetaan taustalla AnchorValidationService._is_lexically_valid -metodilla ja kirjataan is_chimera = True/False.
      - Konfiguraatio 3 (Quorum Single-Pass): live-ajo yhdellä kutsulla (ensemble_k = 1); täysi AnchorValidationService -validointi ja nollahypoteesi aktiivinen (mittaa Bo3-äänestyksen merkityksen aleatorisen kohinan ja siirtymävirheiden suodatuksessa).
      - Konfiguraatio 4 (Atom-level Unconstrained LLM-as-a-Judge): live-ajo yhdellä kutsulla (ensemble_k = 1), ei leksikaalista palomuuria, suora arviointiprompti ilman TDA-nollahypoteesisääntöjä atomikohtaisena suorituksena.
      - Konfiguraatio 5 (Monolithic Step-Level LLM-as-a-Judge / Vanilla Benchmark): monoliittinen live-ajo ilman atomisaatiota tai lyhytaliasointia: mallille syötetään koko dokumentti ja koko työvaiheen arviointikriteerit kerralla yhdellä kehotteella, ja tulokset mapataan kriteerien atomitunnisteille mitaten empiiristä omission astetta (lost-in-the-middle).
    </action>
    <action>Kytke [NEW] @[scripts/run_ablation_benchmark.py] käyttämään LLM-palveluita puhtaassa asynkronisessa muistissa:
      - Alusta LLMClient: await LLMClient.from_strategy("fast", repository=repo) käyttäen get_settings().
      - Kutsu strukturoitua LLM-tehtävää: executor.execute_structured_task(client=client, messages=compiled_prompt, response_model=BatchEvaluationResponse, validation_context=ctx).
      - Hallitse rinnakkaisuutta: asyncio.Semaphore(settings.semaphore_max_concurrency) ja asyncio.TaskGroup().
    </action>
    <action>Toteuta tiedostoon [NEW] @[scripts/run_ablation_benchmark.py] komentoriviparametrit:
      - --case {pair_a,pair_b,both}: valitsee arvioitavan aineiston (Pair A docs/jwdatat, Pair B data/test_inputs_sitra, oletus: both, N = 220 atomia).
      - --config {1,2,3,4,5,all}: valitsee ajettavan konfiguraation (oletus: all).
      - --runs {1,2}: toistoajojen määrä toistettavuuden mittaamiseksi (oletus: 2).
      - --dry-run: suorittaa ajon deterministisillä synteettisillä vastauksilla ilman API-maksuja (CI-testausta varten).
      - --output-format {markdown,json}: tulostaa Table 5 -taulukon joko Markdownina tai JSON-tallenteena.
      - --output-file: valinnainen tiedostopolku tuloksen tallentamiseksi suoraan levylle.
    </action>
    <action>Toteuta tiedostoon [NEW] @[scripts/run_ablation_benchmark.py] tarkat tilastolliset laskentafunktiot jako-nollalla -suojauksin:
      - calculate_cohens_kappa(run1_results, run2_results): laskee Cohenin kappan ja 95 % luottamusvälin uudelleenkäyttäen scripts.diff_executions -funktiota.
      - calculate_chimera_rate(evaluations): laskee keksittyjen sitaattien osuuden hyväksytyistä väitteistä (0.0 jos hyväksyttyjä väitteitä on 0).
      - calculate_pass_rate(evaluations): laskee hyväksyttyjen väitteiden osuuden kokonaismäärästä.
      - calculate_dlq_rate(evaluations): laskee DLQ- tai järjestelmävirheisiin päätyneiden väitteiden osuuden kokonaismäärästä.
      - format_table_5_markdown(report_dto): formatoi Table 5 -taulukon täsmälleen @[docs/tiede.md#L762-L820] -formaatissa (5 datariviä).
    </action>
    <constraint invariant="single_pipeline_invariant_mandate">Tutkimusajuri kutsuu olemassa olevia tuotantoluokkia muuttamatta niiden sisäistä logiikkaa tai luomatta rinnakkaisia tuotantohaaroja.</constraint>
  </step>

  <step id="3" name="CREATE_ABLATION_BENCHMARK_UNIT_TESTS">
    <action>Luo kattava yksikkötestitiedosto [NEW] @[backend_v2/tests/unit/scripts/test_run_ablation_benchmark.py] ISTQB-standardin mukaisesti (13 testitapausta):
      - test_ablation_cli_arguments: verifioi CLI-argumenttien jäsennyksen (--case, --config, --runs, --dry-run, --output-format).
      - test_ablation_cli_invalid_arguments_fail_fast: negatiivinen osiointi, joka verifioi virheellisten komentorivivalintojen välittömän pysäytyksen palautuskoodilla 2 virheellisillä argumenteilla.
      - test_ablation_dry_run_all_configs: verifioi, että kaikki 5 konfiguraatiota suoritetaan virheettömästi läpi --dry-run -tilassa tuottaen validin raportin ja 5 tulosriviä ilman ulkoisia API-kutsuja.
      - test_ablation_chimera_detection_in_config_2: verifioi, että Konfiguraatio 2 hyväksyy atomin mutta tunnistaa keksityn sitaatin ja kasvattaa Chimera Rate -metriikkaa.
      - test_ablation_lexical_firewall_rejection_in_config_1: verifioi, että Konfiguraatio 1 hylkää keksityn sitaatin nollahypoteesin mukaisesti tilaksi FAILED.
      - test_ablation_cohens_kappa_perfect_and_zero_division: raja-arvotesti Cohenin kappan laskennalle täydellisellä konsensuksella (kappa = 1.0) ja tyhjällä syötteellä ilman jako-nollalla -kaatumista.
      - test_ablation_single_pass_vs_bo3_call_cardinality: verifioi, että Konfiguraatiot 1 ja 2 suorittavat 3 rinnakkaiskutsua, Konfiguraatiot 3 ja 4 tasan 1 kutsun per atomi, ja Konfiguraatio 5 tasan 1 kutsun per steppi.
      - test_ablation_monolithic_step_judge_evaluation: verifioi, että Konfiguraatio 5 käsittelee steppitason eräarvioinnin ja mäppää tulokset atomikohtaisiin tunnisteisiin havaiten puuttuvat kriteerit.
      - test_ablation_transient_error_dlq_recovery: verifioi, että Konfiguraatiossa 1 yksittäinen transientti API-virhe (429) korjaantuu 2/2 konsensuksella, kun taas Konfiguraatiossa 3 virhe kasvattaa DLQ-astetta.
      - test_ablation_table_5_markdown_formatting: verifioi, että generoitu Markdown-taulukko sisältää täsmälleen Table 5 -otsikot ja kaikki 5 konfiguraatioriviä.
      - test_ablation_run_benchmark_output_file_json: verifioi, että tulos tallentuu oikein JSON-tiedostoon, kun --output-file ja --output-format json on määritetty.
      - test_ablation_run_benchmark_output_file_markdown: verifioi, että tulos tallentuu oikein Markdown-tiedostoon, kun --output-file ja --output-format markdown on määritetty.
      - test_ablation_main_cli_execution: verifioi CLI:n pääfunktion suorituksen paluukoodin 0 onnistuneella ajolla ja tulostuksen stdoutiin.
    </action>
    <constraint invariant="backend_audit_execution">Testit ajetaan komennolla uv run python scripts/backend_audit_loop.py backend_v2/tests/unit/scripts/test_run_ablation_benchmark.py --test --ast-strict.</constraint>
  </step>

  <step id="4" name="EXECUTE_BENCHMARK_AND_UPDATE_TIEDE_MD">
    <action>Aja tutkimusskripti [NEW] @[scripts/run_ablation_benchmark.py] live-tilassa (tai --dry-run tarkistuksen jälkeen) komennolla:
      uv run python scripts/run_ablation_benchmark.py --case both --config all --runs 2
    ja tuota aito empiirinen Table 5 -taulukko.</action>
    <action>Päivitä kohdetiedoston @[docs/tiede.md#L762-L820] luku 8 korvaamalla simulaatiotaulukko Table 5 empiirisillä mittauksilla ja päivitä tiivistelmän sekä johtopäätösten luvut vastaamaan aitoja tuloksia.</action>
    <action>Poista vanhentunut rajoitekohta 8.6.6 ("Synthetic Component Ablation vs. Direct Live-Ablation Re-runs") kohdasta @[docs/tiede.md#L789-L798].</action>

</execution_protocol>

docs.title: Red-Teaming Failure Points & Boundary Defenses:
docs.text:
1. Failure Point 1 (Jako-nollalla sitaattien todenperäisyyden laskennassa):
  2. Riski: Jos jossakin konfiguraatiossa (erittäin tiukassa arvioinnissa) mikään atomi ei saavuta tilaa PASSED, chimera_count / passed_count aiheuttaa ZeroDivisionError-kaatumisen.

  3. Puolustus: Funktio calculate_chimera_rate sisältää eksplisiittisen tarkistuksen: return 0.0 if not passed else round((chimera_count / len(passed)) * 100.0, 2).

  4. Failure Point 2 (Singulariteetti Cohenin kappan laskennassa):

  5. Riski: Jos arvioijat antavat 100 % identtisen luokituksen kaikille atomeille (kun kaikki atomit saavat tilan PASSED tai kaikki tilan FAILED), satunnaissopivuus $P_e = 1.0$, jolloin jakaja $1.0 - P_e = 0.0$.

  6. Puolustus: scripts/diff_executions.py#L731-L741 sisältää valmiin singulariteettisuojauksen (if expected_agreement >= 1.0: kappa = 1.0; se_kappa = 0.0), jota uusi tutkimusajuri hyödyntää suoraan ilman omaa ad-hoc -kaavaa.

  7. Failure Point 3 (Monoliittisen steppiarvioitsijan vastausten puuttuminen):

  8. Riski: Konfiguraatiossa 5 malli arvioi 25–30 kriteeriä kerralla. Jos malli jättää vastaamatta osaan kriteereistä tai palauttaa tuntemattoman alias-tunnisteen, tulostaulukkoon syntyisi puuttuvia arvoja.

  9. Puolustus: Puuttuvat atomitulokset käsitellään deterministisesti tilaksi ExecutionStatus.FAILED syyllä MISSING_FROM_MONOLITHIC_RESPONSE ja kirjataan DLQ-virheiksi, taaten täyden 220 atomin invariantin jokaisessa ajossa.

  10. Failure Point 4 (Windows 11 CLI Subprocess & Unicode Printing):

  11. Riski: Tulostettaessa erikoismerkkejä ($\kappa$, $\Delta$, lainausmerkkejä, en-space \u2002) Windows PowerShell 5.1 / cp1252 -ympäristössä Python kaatuu UnicodeEncodeError-virheeseen.

  12. Puolustus: Skriptin alussa ajetaan sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8") ja sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8").

  13. Failure Point 5 (Transienttien HTTP 429 -virheiden sietokyky Bo3 vs. Single-Pass):

  14. Riski: Live-arvioinnissa satunnainen API-kuormituspiikki voi aiheuttaa yksittäisen HTTP 429 -virheen, joka ilman suodatusta keskeyttäisi koko benchmark-ajon.
  15. Puolustus: Konfiguraatioissa 1 ja 2 Best-of-3 -konsensusabsorberi nielee yksittäisen transientin virheen ja muodostaa 2/2 konsensuksen jäljelle jääneistä kutsuista (DLQ-aste säilyy 0.0 %:ssa). Konfiguraatioissa 3 ja 4 virheellinen kutsu eristetään siististi tilaan ExecutionStatus.SYSTEM_ERROR ja merkitään DLQ-metriikkaan ilman TaskGroupin kaatumista.

docs.title: Konkreettiset testiskenaariot (Anti-Happy-Path):
docs.text:
1. Onnistumisskenaario (Happy Path – Täysi ablaatioajo kuiva-ajotilassa):
  2. Syöte: python scripts/run_ablation_benchmark.py --dry-run --case both --config all --runs 2

  3. Odotettu tulos: Kaikki 5 konfiguraatiota ajetaan läpi 220 atomille kahdesti. Skripti tulostaa virheettömän Markdown-taulukon, jossa Konfiguraatio 1 saavuttaa $\kappa_{\text{Cohen}} > 0.90$ ja $0.0\%$ Chimera-asteen, ja palautuskoodi on 0.

  4. Negatiivinen skenaario 1 (Keksityn sitaatin tunnistus Konfiguraatiossa 2):

  5. Syöte: Malli palauttaa positiivisen hyväksynnän (is_true = True) ja sitaatin "Tämä on täysin keksitty lause jota ei ole dokumentissa".

  6. Odotettu tulos: Konfiguraatio 2 hyväksyy atomin tilaksi ExecutionStatus.PASSED, mutta str.find() toteaa osuman puuttuvan ja nostaa chimera_count-laskuria. Metriikaksi muodostuu is_chimera = True, todistaen leksikaalisen palomuurin tarpeellisuuden.

  7. Negatiivinen skenaario 2 (API-virheiden eristäminen Single-Pass vs. Bo3):

  8. Syöte: Yksi LLM-kutsu epäonnistuu siirtymävirheeseen (HTTP 429 / Rate Limit).

  9. Odotettu tulos: Single-Pass -tilassa (Konfiguraatio 3) atomi siirtyy SYSTEM_ERROR-tilaan ja kasvattaa DLQ-astetta. Bo3-tilassa (Konfiguraatio 1) jäljellä olevat 2 kutsua muodostavat 2/2 konsensuksen, jolloin ajo jatkuu ilman virhekeskeytystä.

  10. Negatiivinen skenaario 3 (Epäkelvot komentoriviargumentit):

  11. Syöte: python scripts/run_ablation_benchmark.py --config 6 tai --case invalid_case
  12. Odotettu tulos: argparse pysäyttää suorituksen välittömästi selkeään virheilmoitukseen palautuskoodilla 2.

docs.title: IMPLEMENTATION PLAN: Antigravity Skills Architecture Migration & Rule Budget Sovereignty
1. Objective & Architectural Background
docs.text: Migrate the Quorum agentic orchestration layer from deprecated .agents/workflows/*.md files to the modern Antigravity Skills architecture (.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md), establish Progressive Disclosure subdirectories (resources/ and references/) as Single Sources of Truth (SSOT) for templates and audit checklists, introduce three domain-specific auto-triggered Quorum skills (sdui-parity-sync, trace-forensics, seed-vault-ops), resolve the 20,000-token defaultRulesBudget overflow that currently demotes @[.agents/rules/00-antigravity-core.md] from inline startup injection, and enforce these invariants programmatically via [NEW] @[scripts/audit_skills_architecture.py] and [NEW] @[backend_v2/tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_skills_architecture.py].

docs.title: Root Causes Addressed
docs.text:
1. Deprecated Workflow Topology: All 24 Tier 0 through Tier 8 operational playbooks reside in .agents/workflows/*.md, which is deprecated in Antigravity in favor of .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.
  2. 20,000-Token defaultRulesBudget Overflow: Antigravity enforces a strict 20,000-token aggregate budget (defaultRulesBudget) and a 24,000-byte per-file cap on always_on rules. Currently, @[AGENTS.md], @[GEMINI.md], @[.agents/rules/05_llm_architecture.md], and @[.agents/rules/00-antigravity-core.md] exceed 20,000 tokens combined, causing @[.agents/rules/00-antigravity-core.md] to be excluded from inline context injection at session startup.
  3. Duplicated Checklists & Templates Across Playbooks: Legacy workflow files duplicate the 2026 modernity checklist, technical debt sweep directives, and markdown/XML templates instead of isolating them in on-demand resources/ and references/ files inside skill directories.
  4. Missing Auto-Triggered Domain Runbooks: High-risk cross-cutting workflows (specifically SDUI + PDF semantic parity verification, OpenTelemetry local execution trace forensics, and Seed Vault sanitization) lack dedicated auto-discovered skills.

docs.title: 3. Pre-Implementation Technical Debt Cleanups (Phase 1)
docs.text:
1. Inline Rule Budget Exhaustion (@[AGENTS.md], @[.agents/rules/00-antigravity-core.md], @[.agents/rules/05_llm_architecture.md]):
  2. @[.agents/rules/05_llm_architecture.md] currently uses trigger: always_on and is unconditionally injected alongside @[AGENTS.md] and @[GEMINI.md], pushing @[.agents/rules/00-antigravity-core.md] over the 20,000-token defaultRulesBudget. Changing @[.agents/rules/05_llm_architecture.md] to trigger: model_decision with an explicit description and trimming the redundant <execution_tiers> table in @[AGENTS.md] restores 100% inline injection for @[.agents/rules/00-antigravity-core.md].
  3. Deprecated .agents/workflows/ Directory & Duplicated Playbook Blocks:
  4. All 24 .agents/workflows/*.md files lack standard Skill YAML frontmatter (name + description) and duplicate 40+ lines of identical rule blocks across files. Migrating to .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md and extracting shared checklists/templates into references/ and resources/ eliminates this duplication.
  5. Metatest Script Inventory Synchronization (@[backend_v2/tests/unit/scripts/test_scripts_cli_help.py#L57-L63]):
  6. @[backend_v2/tests/unit/scripts/test_scripts_cli_help.py#L57-L63] asserts an exact 31-script inventory in scripts/. Adding [NEW] @[scripts/audit_skills_architecture.py] requires synchronously registering "audit_skills_architecture.py" in ALL_SCRIPTS, updating test_script_count_is_exhaustive to assert len(ALL_SCRIPTS) == 32, and implementing argparse.ArgumentParser CLI semantics (--help, -h, exit code 2 on invalid flags).

docs.title: 5. Reference Implementation Specification ([NEW] @[scripts/audit_skills_architecture.py])
docs.text:
"""Deterministic Auditor for Antigravity Skills Architecture & Rule Budget Sovereignty.

Verifies that all workspace playbooks reside in .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md
with valid YAML frontmatter, that no legacy .agents/workflows/*.md files exist,
that all relative skill resource/reference links resolve on disk, and that the
always_on rules token/byte budget stays within Antigravity inline limits.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Annotated, Final

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

MAX_SINGLE_RULE_FILE_BYTES: Final[int] = 24_000
MAX_ALWAYS_ON_BYTES: Final[int] = 72_000


class SkillsAuditFindingDTO(BaseModel):
    """Immutable DTO representing a single skills or rule-budget violation."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(strict=True, extra="forbid", frozen=True)

    rule_code: Annotated[str, Field(pattern=r"^SKL\d{3}$", description="Violation code SKL001-SKL004")]
    file_path: Annotated[str, Field(min_length=1, description="Workspace-relative file path")]
    message: Annotated[str, Field(min_length=1, description="Human-readable violation description")]
    remediation: Annotated[str, Field(min_length=1, description="Deterministic remediation instruction")]


class SkillsAuditSummaryDTO(BaseModel):
    """Immutable DTO summarizing the full skills and rule-budget audit result."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(strict=True, extra="forbid", frozen=True)

    verified_skills_count: Annotated[int, Field(ge=0, description="Number of valid SKILL.md files verified")]
    always_on_total_bytes: Annotated[int, Field(ge=0, description="Total UTF-8 byte count of always_on rules")]
    findings: Annotated[list[SkillsAuditFindingDTO], Field(description="Accumulated audit findings")]

docs.text: [!IMPORTANT] This plan unifies six approved architectural audits with a strict Zero-Fallback Fail-Fast Mandate, a Zero Dict Wrappers & Direct Pydantic DTO Mandate, a Flutter Theme Sovereignty Mandate, and a Test Fixture Type Safety Mandate: 1. Backend DTO Type Safety Audit (feature_audit_backend_dto_type_safety.md): Eradication of residual dict[str, JsonValue], enforcing StepPanelDTO non-empty invariants, and unifying FlattenedAtom under V2CoreBase. 2. Orchestrator Concurrency & State Transitions Audit (feature_audit_orchestrator_state_transitions.md): Kahn's wave-based topological TaskGroup execution in dag_executor.py, atomic ExecutionRecord.transition_step, 100% DLQ task cancellation coverage, and pure typed state reduction in state_reducer.py directly into typed fields on GlobalContextVarsDTO (eradicating _EvaluativeMatricesWrapperDTO and all dict wrappers). 3. LLM Caching and Prompt Isolation Architecture Audit (feature_audit_llm_caching_prompt_isolation.md): XML sandwich containment in prompt_compiler.py, eradication of regex prompt scraping in prompt_compiler_adapter.py, Fail-Fast caching purity scanning in caching_service.py, and relocation of dynamic output profile directives to user_payload in strategies/llm.py. 4. SDUI Adapters & Dumb Painter Hardening Audit (feature_audit_sdui_adapters_dumb_painter.md): Eradication of heuristic axis count guessing and ad-hoc Markdown headers in matrix_graphs_adapter.py, removal of manual text concatenations and typographical formatting in penalties_adapter.py, elimination of inline .get()/or fallbacks in matrix_summary_table_adapter.py, explicit re-export of VarianceAdapter in services/sdui/adapters/__init__.py, sovereign relocation of sdui_mapper_service.py to canonical services/sdui/sdui_mapper_service.py (with immediate deletion of root file and zero backward compatibility), and sealing SduiBlockBase.block_type typing invariants in models/view/sdui.py. 5. Frontend Flutter UI, Boundary Governance & Theme Sovereignty Audit (feature_audit_frontend_ui_hardening.md): - Zero Fallback & Strict String Boundary Verification: Total ban on defensive fallback string extensions (specifically: safeSubstring); replace fragile manual substring slicing with deterministic model properties and strict boundary validation that fails fast on malformed data. - Theme-First Sovereignty (Zero Direct Color or Style Declarations): Total ban on all raw Color(...), Color(0x...), Color.fromARGB(...), Color.fromRGBO(...), Colors.*, and naked TextStyle(...) instantiations in Flutter widgets. ALL visual colors MUST be derived exclusively from Theme.of(context).colorScheme (specifically: primary, errorContainer, tertiaryContainer, onSurfaceVariant, surfaceContainerHighest) or registered ThemeExtension<AppSemanticColors>. ALL typography MUST be derived exclusively from Theme.of(context).textTheme (specifically: titleMedium, bodyMedium, bodySmall, labelSmall, labelMedium) using .copyWith(...) solely for situational mutations, preserving GoogleFonts metrics, line height, letter spacing, font family, and accessibility font scaling. - AppSemanticColors ThemeExtension: Register AppSemanticColors as a ThemeExtension<AppSemanticColors> in AppTheme.light and AppTheme.dark. Refactor AppColors to eliminate static Colors.* constants and resolve semantic intents purely through Theme.of(context) or ColorScheme. - Static Theme Sovereignty Audit Gate: Implement automated verification script scripts/audit_flutter_theme_sovereignty.py asserting zero occurrences of prohibited Color(, Colors., or naked TextStyle( declarations in target Dart UI widgets. - Localization to .arb: Full extraction of hardcoded UI chrome strings into .arb files (app_en.arb, app_fi.arb). - SDUI Error Isolation: Wrapping autonomous composite blocks in SduiBlocksRenderer with AppErrorBoundary to isolate paint/render crashes while preserving contract fail-fast integrity. - Direct Pydantic DTO Sovereignty (Zero Dict Wrappers): Total ban on intermediate dict wrappers, boxing/unboxing layers, or local wrapper DTOs (specifically: _EvaluativeMatricesWrapperDTO). All pipeline states, hook outputs, and telemetry metrics transit strictly as first-class, immutable Pydantic V2 DTOs (ConfigDict(strict=True, extra="forbid", frozen=True)). 6. Test Fixture Type Safety, AST Guardrails Enforcement & ISTQB Boundary Expansion Audit (feature_audit_test_fixtures_ast_guardrails_istqb.md): - Targeted AST Guardrail Rule QGR029: Implement AST check in scripts/_ast_guardrails.py strictly forbidding @pytest.fixture functions from annotating or returning raw untyped dictionaries (dict, dict[str, Any], dict[str, JsonValue]) when supplying domain entities or DTOs, while exempting negative validation test cases (model_validate, pytest.raises) and HTTP client payloads (client.post(..., json=...)). - Centralized Polyfactory Suite Expansion: Systematically expand backend_v2/tests/factories/model_factories.py to cover all primary domain aggregates (specifically and exhaustively: MatrixPromptBlockFactory, ExecutionRecordFactory, ExecutionStepFactory, OutputProfileFactory, StepPanelDTOFactory, GlobalContextVarsDTOFactory), accompanied by an automated validation test suite backend_v2/tests/factories/test_model_factories.py asserting 100% instantiation parity. - Strict DTO Reconstitution for Test Snapshots: Mandate that all static JSON test snapshots in backend_v2/tests/test_data/ are strictly deserialized through authoritative Pydantic V2 DTOs (Model.model_validate(json.load(f))) rather than passed as unvalidated dictionaries, ensuring schema drift triggers immediate Fail-Fast validation errors. - Two-Partition Negative ISTQB Boundary Mandate: Mandate at least two negative boundary partitions per critical service method across repository and service layers: Partition 1 (Empty / Null / Missing Invariants -> ValidationError or AppException(ErrorCodes.VALIDATION_FAILED)) and Partition 2 (Range / Boundary Overflow / Invalid Domain ID -> AppException Fail-Fast). - Deceptive Persistence Mock Eradication: Refactor repository unit tests (specifically: backend_v2/tests/unit/database/repositories/test_component.py) to eliminate AsyncMock(spec=StorageDriver) returning .model_dump(mode="json") in favor of stateful in-memory drivers (InMemoryStorageDriver) adhering strictly to QGR014.

docs.title: Zero Dict Creation Invariant & Exhaustive Dict Justification Ledger
docs.text:
[!IMPORTANT] Mandate: In accordance with the User Mandate and Rule no_naked_dicts_in_state (01-python-backend.md), NOT A SINGLE RUNTIME DICTIONARY MAY BE CREATED in business logic, state reduction, or service pipelines (specifically: ban on d = {}, dict(...), d[k] = v, _EvaluativeMatricesWrapperDTO, and ad-hoc dictionary accumulators).

Across the entire scope of this implementation, exactly FOUR (4) strictly typed dictionary fields are permitted in Pydantic DTOs and domain models. Every single one is mathematically and architecturally justified below:

  1. SynthesisMetadataDTO.step_metrics: Annotated[dict[str, StepTelemetryEntryDTO] | None, Field(...)]
  2. Why it exists: Maps dynamic Opaque Stripe step identifiers (stp_[a-f0-9]{16}) to their strongly typed execution telemetry DTO (StepTelemetryEntryDTO).
  3. Why a static Pydantic model is impossible: Step IDs are generated dynamically per workflow DAG topology and cannot be hardcoded as static attribute names.

  4. Why it is safe & compliant: It completely replaces the loose dict[str, JsonValue] open-JSON bag. Values are 100% strictly validated Pydantic V2 DTOs (StepTelemetryEntryDTO). Zero naked dictionaries.

  5. TranslationResponseDTO.translated_data: Annotated[dict[str, str], Field(...)]

  6. Why it exists: Maps arbitrary UI chrome and template localization keys to translated text values returned by the dynamic translation hook.
  7. Why a static Pydantic model is impossible: Localization keys vary dynamically across reports and UI components.

  8. Why it is safe & compliant: It eliminates the open-JSON dict[str, JsonValue] type. Both keys and values are strictly typed primitives (str -> str). Zero unvalidated payloads.

  9. GlobalContextVarsDTO.evaluative_matrices: Annotated[dict[str, float] | None, Field(...)]

  10. Why it exists: Maps dynamic prompt block identifiers (blk_[a-f0-9]{16}) to computed normalized matrix scores (float, $0.0 \le s \le 1.0$).
  11. Why a static Pydantic model is impossible: Prompt block IDs are dynamic relational entities configured in Quorum Studio and cannot be statically declared as model attributes.

  12. Why it is safe & compliant: Both keys and values are strictly typed primitives (str -> float). Replaces the duct-tape string-keyed dictionary injection into dynamic_inputs and eliminates _EvaluativeMatricesWrapperDTO.

  13. ExecutionRecord.step_states: dict[str, ExecutionStep] (updated in transition_step)

  14. Why it exists: Pre-existing SSOT domain property on ExecutionRecord providing $O(1)$ step lookup by canonical step ID.
  15. Why dictionary creation occurs: In transition_step, constructing a shallow updated mapping {**self.step_states, step_id: updated_step} is required by Pydantic V2 to produce an immutable, frozen model copy (.model_copy(update={"step_states": ...})) without in-place mutation.
  16. Why it is safe & compliant: Values are validated ExecutionStep domain models. Zero runtime state leakage.

Zero Other Dictionaries: In all other 13 delta branches in state_reducer.py (passivity_detected, archivist_precedents, shuffled_atoms, profiler_metrics, distillation, scoring, interaction_analysis, bibliography, sanitization, llm_anomaly_retry_requested, input_control_ratio, integrity_verified_output, step_metadata), strictly ZERO DICTIONARIES ARE CREATED. Payloads are routed directly to typed Pydantic fields via model_copy(update={field: payload}).

Test Fixture Zero Untyped Dict Invariant & QGR029 Enforcement: Rule QGR029 extends the Zero Dict Mandate to test fixtures, strictly forbidding @pytest.fixture functions from annotating or returning raw untyped dictionaries representing domain models or DTOs. Test data setup must utilize strongly typed Pydantic V2 models generated by Polyfactory (model_factories.py). Raw dictionaries in tests are permitted exclusively as input payloads in negative schema validation tests (pytest.raises(ValidationError): Model.model_validate({...})) or HTTP endpoint payloads (client.post(..., json={...})), where untyped payloads are mathematically required to prove validation rejection.

1. Scenario NEG-01 (Empty StepPanelDTO Rejection): Instantiating StepPanelDTO() with zero analysis payloads triggers ValidationError with message StepPanelDTO requires at least one analysis payload to be populated.
  2. Scenario NEG-02 (Untyped SynthesisMetadataDTO Payload Rejection): Passing an arbitrary unvalidated dictionary to execution_summary (instead of ExecutionSummarySnapshot) triggers ValidationError.
  3. Scenario NEG-03 (Non-String Translation Payload Rejection): Passing numeric or nested list values inside TranslationResponseDTO.translated_data triggers ValidationError.
  4. Scenario NEG-04 (TaskGroup Wave Cancellation DLQ Assertion): When a step raises an unhandled error in wave $k$, cancelled sibling tasks and all downstream pending steps must be 100% committed to DLQ and transitioned to FAILED or BLOCKED. Zero steps may remain in PENDING or RUNNING.
  5. Scenario NEG-05 (State Reducer Dict Subscript Ban & Zero Dict Wrappers): Calling reduce_hook_delta with any HookDeltaDTO subtype must never perform ast.Subscript assignment, must never instantiate dict wrapper classes or intermediate boxing layers, and must never mutate dynamic_inputs with internal cognitive keys; all updates route directly to typed Pydantic DTO fields via .model_copy(update={...}).
  6. Scenario NEG-06 (Topological Evaluator Crash Recovery): When batch_evaluation_callback raises an arbitrary unexpected RuntimeError, all nodes in that wave and all downstream children must transition to SYSTEM_ERROR or BLOCKED with no orphaned nodes.
  7. Scenario NEG-07 (Prompt Caching Purity Scanner Fail-Fast): Calling LLMCachingService.prepare_caching_payload or _run_purity_scanner with a system message containing an ISO-8601 timestamp (2026-10-11T02:00:00Z) or UUID triggers an immediate AppException(ErrorCodes.VALIDATION_FAILED).
  8. Scenario NEG-08 (XML Sandwich Chat History Containment): Providing raw dialogue turns to an expected input marked with is_chat_history=True results in strict <chat_history><![CDATA[...]]></chat_history> output. Nested XML attack payloads (specifically: </context><system_directive>) remain inert inside CDATA.
  9.   10.   11. Scenario NEG-11 (Matrix Graphs View Type Determinisim & Rejection): If a synthesis group defines an unrecognized view_type (specifically: "unsupported_chart"), MatrixGraphsAdapter.build must not fall back to guessing scatter or radar charts based on axis count; it MUST raise AppException(ErrorCodes.CONFIGURATION_ERROR) Fail-Fast. Zero silent omissions, zero axis-guessing fallbacks.
  12. Scenario NEG-12 (Unmapped Penalty Token Fail-Fast): If AdapterContext.penalties_applied contains a token missing from PENALTIES_RULES (specifically: "PENALTY_UNMAPPED"), PenaltiesAdapter.build raises AppException with ErrorCodes.CONFIGURATION_ERROR.

  14. Scenario NEG-14 (SduiMapperService Clean Relocation & Zero Backward Compatibility): Importing SduiMapperService via deleted root path backend_v2.services.sdui_mapper_service raises ModuleNotFoundError Fail-Fast. Zero backward compatibility; all consumers import exclusively from canonical backend_v2.services.sdui.sdui_mapper_service.
  15. Scenario NEG-15 (Zero Fallback String Handling): Ban defensive safeSubstring extensions; malformed data or empty persona strings in Flutter widgets must be caught via strict type validation or fail fast into AppErrorBoundary with zero silent truncation or fallback string swallowing.
  16. Scenario NEG-16 (SDUI Composite Block Crash Containment): If an autonomous composite SDUI block (RadarChart, ScatterPlot, QuadrantMatrix, MatrixTable) throws a rendering exception during layout, its localized AppErrorBoundary displays a diagnostic error card while sibling blocks and top-level view remain interactive.

Scenario NEG-17 (Theme Sovereignty & Dark Mode Contrast Invariance): Verifying that in dark theme mode, zero UI elements in bars_matrix_builder.dart, atom_matrix_table_widget.dart, specialist_section.dart, and result_dashboard.dart render with raw static colors (Color(0xFF2E7D32) or Colors.*); all elements MUST dynamically resolve against ThemeData.colorScheme and ThemeData.textTheme, achieving WCAG AA contrast compliance (>= 4.5:1).

docs.title: Plan: Canonical Import Migration & Strangler Fig Facade Eradication
Executive Summary & Architectural Rationale
docs.text:
The Tripartite Pipeline Isolation refactoring successfully decomposed the monolithic v2_core.py (1,920L), execution.py (1,511L), and worker.py (2,037L) into bounded single-responsibility modules under backend_v2/models/domain/, backend_v2/models/dtos/, backend_v2/services/execution/, and backend_v2/workers/. To prevent system-wide import breakages during decomposition, temporary Strangler Fig Facades with PEP 484 explicit re-exports were deployed in backend_v2/models/v2_core.py, backend_v2/services/execution/__init__.py, and backend_v2/worker.py.

Now that the Tripartite architecture is 100% hardened, tested (130/130 passing), and audited, this plan executes the final phase of the Strangler Fig Lifecycle mandated by @[ki_god_code_prevention.md#L81-L89] (remedial_strangler_fig_proxy): 1. Migrate all callers of backend_v2.models.v2_core (80 production files + 170 test files = 250 files total) to their authoritative canonical domain paths (models/domain/*, models/dtos/*, models/core_base.py, models/enums.py). 2. Relocate model forward-reference rebuilds (model_rebuild) directly into their respective canonical model files. 3. Eradicate naked dict WorkflowSchemaResponse = dict[str, Any] in favor of strict WorkflowSchemaResponseDTO. 4. Permanently delete backend_v2/models/v2_core.py and its temporary proxy test test_v2_core_proxy.py. 5. Clean up backend_v2/services/execution/__init__.py: Eradicate external borrowed re-exports (specifically and exhaustively: BlueprintTransformer, DocumentExtractionService, ExportService, FlatFileService, OutputProfile, PdfReportService, SduiMapperService, TokenData, Workflow, asyncio, get_storage_driver, recalculate), retaining strictly the ExecutionService unified facade and execution lifecycle subservices. Simultaneously decouple internal subservices (ingress_service.py, resumption_service.py, override_service.py, legacy_render_service.py, lifecycle_service.py, context_service.py) from borrowed symbols and update mock patch paths in test_execution.py. 6. Clean up backend_v2/worker.py: Eradicate legacy worker coroutine re-exports (specifically and exhaustively: VarianceExplanationResult, execute_workflow_job, generate_pdf_job, generate_pdf_task, generate_profile_synthesis_and_pdf_task, generate_report_artifact_job, render_profile_job), leaving worker.py strictly as the Arq daemon runtime entrypoint (WorkerSettings, startup, shutdown, health_check). 7. Enforce AST Guardrail (QGR017): Lock in scripts/_ast_guardrails.py to structurally prevent any future imports from v2_core. 8. Knowledge Item Synchronization: Update ki_god_code_prevention.md, ki_tripartite_pipeline_architecture.md, and ki_zero_permissive_typing.md to reflect complete eradication of v2_core.py and adoption of canonical imports. 9. As-Built Architecture & Directory Reference Sync: Execute /tier7-describe-architecture for relevant documents in docs/architecture/ (00_README_META_ARCHITECTURE.md, 01_system_context_and_invariants.md, 03_cognitive_orchestration_engine.md, 04_server_driven_ui_and_presentation.md) and update .agents/rules/04_directory_reference.md.

docs.title: Technical Debt & Anti-Pattern Sweep (Pre-Implementation Cleanups)
docs.text: The target files and their immediate 1-hop dependencies were thoroughly inspected for the standard technical debt items: 1. Naked Dict Anti-Pattern (WorkflowSchemaResponse): backend_v2/models/v2_core.py#L353 declares WorkflowSchemaResponse = dict[str, Any], imported by backend_v2/api/routers/execution/workflows.py#L12-L39 and returned by ingress_service.py#L182-L189 and facade.py#L136-L138. This violates no_naked_dicts_in_state and data_leak_prevention_firewall. Cleanup: Create WorkflowSchemaResponseDTO(BaseModel) with model_config = ConfigDict(strict=True, extra="forbid") and expected_inputs: list[ExpectedInput]. 2. Monolithic Module-Level Rebuild Coupling: v2_core.py#L356-L393 hosts model_rebuild() calls for RenderedSynthesisCache, ReportDataDTO, MatrixScorecardRowDTO, ExecutionCreate, TDAAssertion, and SDUI blocks, creating an artificial runtime dependency on v2_core. Cleanup: Relocate rebuilds directly into home modules (synthesis.py#L170-L238, report_data.py#L88-L105, matrix.py#L260-L296, execution.py#L63-L105), and place the SDUI block and scorecard rebuilds at the end of sdui.py#L713-L734 after AnySduiBlock definition. 3. Leaked External Service Re-exports in Execution Subpackage & Callers: backend_v2/services/execution/__init__.py#L1-L73 re-exports external services (specifically and exhaustively: BlueprintTransformer, DocumentExtractionService, ExportService, FlatFileService, OutputProfile, PdfReportService, SduiMapperService, TokenData, Workflow, asyncio, get_storage_driver, recalculate). Inspection revealed internal subservices borrowed these re-exports: - ingress_service.py#L187, #L202: execution.Workflow.model_validate() borrows Workflow (canonical is backend_v2.models.domain.workflow.Workflow). - resumption_service.py#L74: execution.Workflow.model_validate() borrows Workflow. - override_service.py#L82, #L88, #L200: borrows Workflow, get_storage_driver, and recalculate. - legacy_render_service.py#L59, #L78, #L144, #L221, #L227, #L269, #L287: borrows get_storage_driver, BlueprintTransformer, SduiMapperService, FlatFileService, Workflow, and PdfReportService. - lifecycle_service.py#L129 and context_service.py#L48: borrow get_storage_driver. - test_execution.py#L502, #L573, #L1580, #L1640, #L1709, #L2104-L2345: patches backend_v2.services.execution.get_storage_driver, BlueprintTransformer, and PdfReportService.generate_execution_pdf. Duplicated Worker Coroutine Re-exports in Arq Entrypoint: backend_v2/worker.py#L30-L53 re-exports worker coroutines (specifically and exhaustively: VarianceExplanationResult, execute_workflow_job, generate_pdf_job, generate_pdf_task, generate_profile_synthesis_and_pdf_task, generate_report_artifact_job, render_profile_job) in __all__, which duplicates backend_v2.workers.*. Five test files (test_worker_synthesis_accumulation.py, test_worker_synthesis.py, test_worker_dlq_fallback.py, test_worker_models_used.py, test_worker.py) import from worker.py. Red-Team Attack Points (Falsification Analysis)
docs.text:
1. Failure Point 1: Circular Import Deadlock during Module Initialization:
  2. Attack: If backend_v2/models/dtos/matrix_scorecard.py is imported first, its import of MCPAuditTrace from backend_v2.models.domain.system_config triggers domain/__init__.py, which imports execution.py. If execution.py still contains dead imports (from backend_v2.models.dtos.matrix_scorecard import ScorecardAtomDTO), Python encounters a circular import deadlock because matrix_scorecard.py is partially initialized.
  3. Falsification / Proof: Running uv run python -c "from backend_v2.models.dtos.matrix_scorecard import MatrixScorecardRowDTO" fails with ImportError: cannot import name 'ScorecardAtomDTO' from partially initialized module 'backend_v2.models.dtos.matrix_scorecard'.
  4. Mitigation: Pre-implementation step 1 purges the dead circular import ScorecardAtomDTO from execution.py#L23 (while preserving L22 DataDictionaryField and MCPAuditTrace required by FrozenContext) and preserves AnySduiBlock under if TYPE_CHECKING: in matrix_scorecard.py#L19-L21 (required by MyPy strict on L297). Furthermore, co-locate the MatrixScorecardRowDTO.model_rebuild() call inside sdui.py#L713-L734 at the bottom of the file (after AnySduiBlock definition), passing both AnySduiBlock and MCPAuditTrace into _types_namespace. This completely decouples matrix_scorecard.py from importing sdui.py at runtime while resolving all types natively.
  5. Failure Point 2: Function-Level and Inline Test Imports Missed by Codemod:
  6. Attack: In test files (specifically: test_v2_core_models.py#L137, test_executions.py#L77, test_document_extraction.py#L153), from backend_v2.models.v2_core import ... occurs inside test functions. If the codemod script only inspects top-level module AST statements (ast.Module.body), function-level imports are missed, causing subsequent ModuleNotFoundError once v2_core.py is eradicated.
  7. Falsification / Proof: Running uv run pytest backend_v2/tests/unit/test_executions.py fails with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'backend_v2.models.v2_core' inside test functions.
  8. Mitigation: The codemod script uses recursive AST traversal (ast.walk or recursive ast.NodeVisitor) to locate all ast.ImportFrom nodes regardless of nesting depth, rewriting them in-place and invoking ruff check --fix and ruff format on each modified file.
  9. Failure Point 3: Codemod Mangling Comments, Decorators, or Multi-Line Formats:
  10. Attack: Naive regex string replacement on 250 files risks corrupting inline # noqa comments, multi-line parentheses, or trailing commas, causing syntax errors.
  11. Falsification / Proof: AST parsing of unformatted modified files fails with SyntaxError or IndentationError.
  12. Mitigation: The codemod script parses the AST to pinpoint exact start and end line ranges of ImportFrom nodes for backend_v2.models.v2_core, splits the imported symbols by their target canonical modules, synthesizes clean grouped imports, and automatically executes ruff check --fix and ruff format on each modified file.
  13. Failure Point 4: Breaking /workflows/{workflow_id}/ui_schema Endpoint:
  14. Attack: backend_v2/api/routers/execution/workflows.py imports WorkflowSchemaResponse = dict[str, Any] from v2_core.py. If v2_core.py is eradicated without a replacement DTO, the endpoint fails with ImportError.
  15. Falsification / Proof: Running uv run pytest backend_v2/tests/unit/test_api_clone_endpoints.py or calling /ui_schema fails with 500 error.
  16. Mitigation: Pre-implementation step 1 creates WorkflowSchemaResponseDTO(BaseModel) with expected_inputs: list[ExpectedInput] in backend_v2/models/dtos/workflow_schema.py and updates ingress_service.py and workflows.py before any caller migration begins.
  17. Failure Point 5: Execution Subservices and Mock Patches Broken by Purging Borrowed Re-exports in execution/__init__.py:
  18. Attack: If BlueprintTransformer, get_storage_driver, and Workflow are purged from services/execution/__init__.py without updating internal subservices and test patch targets, override_service.py, legacy_render_service.py, resumption_service.py, and lifecycle_service.py crash with AttributeError: module 'backend_v2.services.execution' has no attribute 'get_storage_driver'/'Workflow', and 15 mock patches in test_execution.py fail.
  19. Falsification / Proof: Running uv run pytest backend_v2/tests/unit/services/test_execution.py fails with AttributeError on get_storage_driver.
  20. Mitigation: Step 6 explicitly updates all 6 subservices to import canonical symbols from models.domain.workflow, services.storage, hooks.scoring, services.blueprint, services.sdui_mapper_service, and services.pdf_generator, while simultaneously synchronizing patch paths in test_execution.py.
  21. Failure Point 6: False-Positive Dead Import Purge in Matrix Scorecard DTO:
  22. Attack: Purging from backend_v2.models.view.sdui import AnySduiBlock under if TYPE_CHECKING: in backend_v2/models/dtos/matrix_scorecard.py#L19-L21 assuming it is unused.
  23. Falsification / Proof: Running mypy --strict backend_v2/models/dtos/matrix_scorecard.py fails immediately with error: Name "AnySduiBlock" is not defined [name-defined] on inner_sdui_blocks at line 297.
  24. Mitigation: The if TYPE_CHECKING: block in matrix_scorecard.py#L19-L21 is explicitly preserved. Runtime circularity is prevented because AnySduiBlock is only imported during static typechecking, while runtime hydration is resolved when MatrixScorecardRowDTO.model_rebuild() is called in sdui.py#L734 where AnySduiBlock is natively in scope.

docs.title: IMPLEMENTATION PLAN: Circuit Breaker & Sparse Data Synthesis Rule
docs.text:
- @[.agents/rules/00-antigravity-core.md] - @[.agents/rules/01-python-backend.md] - @[.agents/rules/05_llm_architecture.md] - @[ki_god_code_prevention.md] - @[ki_sdui_matrix_synthesis.md] - @[ki_sdui_adapter_pattern.md] - @[ki_tripartite_pipeline_architecture.md] - @[ki_flat_polymorphic_pipeline.md] - @[ki_dual_axis_localization_architecture.md]

Objective: Implement a deterministic Circuit Breaker in SynthesisEngine and worker.py to handle "Data Starvation" (0 atoms / 0 evidence) and introduce a static SPARSE_DATA_SYNTHESIS_MANDATE in synthesis_directives.py to mitigate "Attention Dilution" for sparse data (1-2 atoms). This structurally prevents Prompt Leakage (hallucinated internal commands) and Prompt Injection without violating the Tripartite Pipeline, God Code Prevention mandates, Quorum Modernity Gate, or Zero-Compromise strictness.

docs.title: Root Cause Analysis & Architectural Audit Findings
docs.text:
1. Decoupled Engine Circuit Breaker (Domain Isolation): Placing the Circuit Breaker inside SynthesisEngine.execute() preserves DAGExecutor as a domain-agnostic graph runner. Justification (@[ki_god_code_prevention.md] & @[ki_execution_engine_protocol.md]): DAGExecutor must never contain domain-specific branching like if model_strategy == "synthesis". In accordance with the Single Responsibility Principle and Anti-God Code rules, SynthesisEngine validates its own precondition (GlobalAtomBlackboard) and immediately short-circuits with DataStarvationEvent if total_atoms <= starvation_threshold, bypassing the structured LLM task executor.

  2. DAG Contract Preservation: When skipped due to starvation, SynthesisEngine returns a TraceEvent with the executing step's exact identifier (request.step.id). Justification: DAG nodes must fulfill their own contract. Using the node's own ID ensures downstream dependencies and TopologicalEvaluator resolve deterministically without topological deadlocks.

  3. Prefix Cache Invalidation & Static Mandates (Sparse Data Rule): Directives injected at the top of system prompts destroy prefix cache, while dynamic variables interpolated into rule sentences cause attention dilution. Justification (@[.agents/rules/05_llm_architecture.md] & ephemeral_caching_topology): The SPARSE_DATA_SYNTHESIS_MANDATE is defined as a 100% static XML prompt asset. It is appended cleanly to the end of the user payload (local_messages[-1]), preserving LLM Context Caching (FinOps) and utilizing Recency Bias to prevent Attention Dilution without in-sentence variable interpolation (high_fidelity_prompting_and_caching).

  4. Dedicated Prompt Asset File (Anti-God File Dumping & SSOT): Prompt rules must not bloat existing service files or generic utilities. Justification (@[ki_god_code_prevention.md] & prompt_asset_ssot_mandate): SPARSE_DATA_SYNTHESIS_MANDATE is placed in a dedicated domain module @[backend_v2/models/prompts/synthesis_directives.py] rather than inlined into @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/engines/synthesis_engine.py] or dumped into generic helpers.

  5. Prompt Injection Defense & CDATA Breakout Shielding: Naive string formatting (<user_payload>{raw_data}</user_payload>) is vulnerable to XML breakout attacks. Justification (role_segregation_and_fencing & @[ki_matrix_sensor_prompt_builder.md]): SynthesisEngine MUST use TemplateProcessor.encapsulate_payload() (@[backend_v2/core/template_processor.py]) on blackboard.to_markdown_synthesis_injection(). This wraps user payload in <![CDATA[...]]> and neutralizes ]]> via Breakout Shielding (_apply_breakout_shield), immunizing the LLM pipeline against XML-based Prompt Injection.

  6. Typed Domain State & Decoupled SDUI (Elimination of TypeError & TraceEvent Tunneling): Root Cause: In naive designs, the SDUI adapter probed event.content["event_type"] across raw execution_trace events. Because normal LLM synthesis outputs a raw string (str), accessing str["event_type"] immediately crashed with TypeError: string indices must be integers. In Quorum, patching this with isinstance(dict) or .get() is strictly banned (the_duct_tape_ban, the_zero_compromise_pledge). Solution & Justification (@[ki_tripartite_pipeline_architecture.md] & @[ki_sdui_adapter_pattern.md]): The starvation domain state MUST be elevated to a first-class typed field on RenderedSynthesisCache.data_starvation: DataStarvationEvent | None. SDUI presentation adapters (WarningCardAdapter) act strictly as Dumb Painters reading context.profile_cache.data_starvation, completely decoupled from raw execution_trace logs. This prevents TypeError, eliminates duck-typing/dict probing, and guarantees deterministic rendering even when execution traces are offloaded to Cloud Storage.

  7. SDUI AlertBlock Field Contract & Component Identity: Justification: In Quorum's Pydantic SDUI schema (@[backend_v2/models/view/sdui.py]), AlertBlock strictly inherits from SduiBlockBase with id: str | None = None, severity: Annotated[LaxVisualIntent, Field(default=VisualIntent.INFO)] (mapped from VisualIntent.WARNING), text: str, exact_quotes: list[str], and citations: list[int]. To guarantee deterministic widget recycling and state tracking in Flutter's Riverpod/Freezed SDUI lists without runtime jank or GC churn, WarningCardAdapter MUST instantiate AlertBlock with a deterministic component identity: id=f"alert_starvation_{starvation.event_type}".

  8. Raw Atoms vs. Compressed Matrix Calculation (Scenario C): If total_atoms is counted from reduced_atoms (the token-compressed matrix payload), an evaluation where all 10 atoms are PASSED will compress to 0 rows (len(reduced_atoms) == 0), causing a False Starvation trigger and aborting a perfect score. Justification: total_atoms MUST be computed from the raw uncompressed evaluation data via len(blackboard.get_all_atom_ids()), NEVER from len(reduced_atoms).

  9. UI Duplication & I18n Hallucination Prevention in WarningCardAdapter: Justification: The adapter maps directly from context.profile_cache.data_starvation and uses Quorum's standardized I18nText(default_locale="en", translations={"en": "Evaluation data was insufficient to generate synthesis.", "fi": "Arviointiaineisto ei sisältänyt riittävästi havaintoja synteesin tuottamiseksi."}).resolve(context.locale) (strictly adhering to Pydantic extra="forbid" with default_locale and translations dict, Axis 2 semantic localization).

      Modify @[backend_v2/models/v2_core.py] to add `data_starvation: DataStarvationEvent | None = Field(default=None, description="Domain event indicating synthesis short-circuit due to atom starvation")` to `RenderedSynthesisCache`.

      1) Log a circuit breaker warning: `logger.warning("SynthesisEngine: Circuit breaker triggered due to data starvation (total_atoms=%d). Bypassing LLM execution.", total_atoms)`.
      2) Instantiate `starvation_dto = DataStarvationEvent(total_atoms=total_atoms)`.
      3) Serialize `starvation_content = starvation_dto.model_dump(mode="json")`.
      4) Create `starvation_event = TraceEvent(step_name=request.step.id, event_type="output", content=starvation_content)`.
      5) Return `EngineExecutionResult(results=[], hydrated_references={}, synthesis_output=starvation_content, trace_events=[starvation_event])` immediately without calling `self._executor.execute_structured_task()`.

    <action>
      Modify @[backend_v2/worker.py] in the profile synthesis handling function.
      DETECTION METHOD (deterministic, single path): Immediately after obtaining `execution` and `final_inputs` (before the `async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as tg:` block that starts at the line containing `async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as tg:`), iterate `execution.execution_trace` to detect starvation:
      ```python
      starvation_detected = False
      for trace_evt in execution.execution_trace:
          if (
              trace_evt.event_type == "output"
              and isinstance(trace_evt.content, dict)
              and trace_evt.content.get("event_type") == "starvation"
          ):
              starvation_detected = True
              break
      ```
      If `starvation_detected is True`:
      1) Instantiate `starvation_dto = DataStarvationEvent(total_atoms=0, reason="Data starvation: insufficient atoms")`.
      2) Completely BYPASS the entire `async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as tg:` block and all subsequent LLM synthesis tasks (`t_exec_summary`, `t_matrix_sections`, `t_xai`, `t_row`, `t_variance`) to avoid executing unnecessary, hallucination-prone LLM passes on empty data.

Then skip directly to the PDF generation enqueue at the line containing `await redis.enqueue_job("generate_pdf_job", ...)`.
    </action>
    <constraint invariant="anti_god_code_dag_isolation">
      `DAGExecutor` MUST remain completely domain-agnostic. No synthesis-specific starvation checks or short-circuits are placed in @[backend_v2/services/orchestrator/dag_executor.py]. `SynthesisEngine` handles its own precondition and returns a valid `EngineExecutionResult`.

    <constraint invariant="raw_atoms_uncompressed_calculation">
      `total_atoms` MUST be calculated strictly from raw `blackboard.get_all_atom_ids()`, NEVER from `len(reduced_atoms)` or `available_dtos` to prevent False Starvation on perfect scores and dimension mismatch.

If starvation occurred, `warning_blocks` populates `inner_sdui_blocks`, gracefully preventing the `if not inner_sdui_blocks: inner_sdui_blocks = [SduiRadarChartBlock(axes=evaluative_matrices)]` fallback (L619-620) from creating empty placeholder radar charts.
