docs.title: System 2 Red-Team Falsification & Proactive Hardening Matrix
docs.text: Falsification ID Discovered Vulnerability / Flawed Assumption Root Cause Analysis Proactive Architectural Hardening RT-01: Binary jsonb \x01 Wire Header & Uninstalled orjson/asyncpg Original plan specified top-level import orjson / import asyncpg and raw orjson.dumps / orjson.loads on format="binary". Neither orjson nor asyncpg is installed in uv.lock, so top-level imports crash scripts/audit_clean_imports.py (ModuleNotFoundError) and violate dependency_hallucination_firewall. Furthermore, PostgreSQL's jsonb_send/jsonb_recv binary wire format prepends a 1-byte version header (\x01); omitting b"\x01" raises DataError: unsupported jsonb version number 123. Use Pydantic V2's installed Rust pydantic_core (to_json, from_json) with explicit b"\x01" binary header framing (encode_jsonb_binary, decode_jsonb_binary). Define @runtime_checkable AsyncPgPoolProtocol / AsyncPgConnectionProtocol in pool.py and lazily import asyncpg inside PostgresPoolManager.connect(). RT-02: Hardcoded Credentials in Default DSN Original Step 3 proposed default="postgresql://quorum:quorum@127.0.0.1:5432/quorum". Embedding quorum:quorum credentials and a hardcoded URL in source code violates credential_hardcoding_ban and localhost_endpoint_hardcoding_ban. Split configuration into postgres_host, postgres_port, postgres_user, postgres_password: str | None = None, postgres_db, and postgres_dsn: str | None = None on Settings, resolving credentials strictly from environment injection. RT-03: QGR007 AST Failure on V2CoreBase Subclasses Original Step 2 omitted explicit model_config = ConfigDict(...) on 6 of the 7 models in proposition_graph.py. QuorumGuardrailVisitor.visit_ClassDef (QGR007 in scripts/_ast_guardrails.py) checks has_local_base only within the same file; inheriting V2CoreBase from core_base.py without an explicit class-level model_config triggers a FATAL QGR007 violation. Mandate explicit model_config = ConfigDict(strict=True, extra="forbid", frozen=True) inside the class body of every Pydantic model in proposition_graph.py and adapter row DTOs. RT-04: QGR014 Test Double Location Ban Defining fake asyncpg or port classes inside test_uow_contract.py or using AsyncMock. scripts/_ast_guardrails.py populates INTERFACE_REPOSITORY_METHODS from interfaces.py and fatally bans (QGR014) any class outside backend_v2/tests/fakes/ from implementing interface method names or mocking repository protocols. Encapsulate InMemoryUnitOfWork, InMemoryGraphAdapter, InMemoryEntityAdapter, and stateful InMemoryAsyncPgPool / InMemoryAsyncPgConnection strictly inside [NEW] @[backend_v2/tests/fakes/in_memory_uow.py]. RT-05: Monotonic Sub-Millisecond UUIDv7 Ordering Generating multiple UUIDv7 IDs within the same millisecond in InMemoryUnitOfWork can collide or sort out of order. Without RFC 9562 Section 6.2 monotonic counter incrementation (rand_a) within the same millisecond tick, in-memory ORDER BY node_id ASC diverges from PostgreSQL 19 uuidv7(). Implement thread-safe 12-bit monotonic rand_a counter state + secrets.randbits(62) inside generate_uuid7_opaque_id in backend_v2/models/core_base.py. RT-06: test_scripts_cli_help.py Inventory Gate & audit_warning_baseline.py Census P Regex Trap Creating scripts/audit_zero_orm_strictness.py without registering it in test_scripts_cli_help.py, or writing contiguous dict[str, Any] tokens inside scripts/ or tests/. test_script_count_is_exhaustive() in test_scripts_cli_help.py asserts ALL_SCRIPTS == physical_scripts and len(ALL_SCRIPTS) == 36. Additionally, Stage 9/10 of backend_audit_loop.py (audit_warning_baseline.py --verify-zero) runs re.findall(r"\b[Dd]ict\[\s*str\s*,\s*(?:Any|object)\s*\]", text) on raw file text across scripts/ and backend_v2/tests/ against CURRENT_RESIDUAL_CEILINGS.p = 0. Add @[backend_v2/tests/unit/scripts/test_scripts_cli_help.py#L61-L67] to Step 1 <targets> (36 -> 37), inspect ast.Subscript nodes structurally without writing contiguous dict[str, ...] tokens in docstrings/comments, and concatenate "dict" + "[str, Any]" in synthetic test strings. RT-07: Step-by-Step 90% TDD Coverage Gate Alignment (backend_audit_loop.py --test) Deferring unit tests for core_base.py, enums.py, proposition_graph.py, interfaces.py, settings.py, and factory.py until Step 5 (test_postgres.py). backend_audit_loop.py <target> --test maps each source file to its dedicated unit test (test_core_base.py, test_proposition_graph.py, test_settings.py, test_factory.py) and enforces --fail-under=90 immediately at the end of Steps 1–4. Include @[backend_v2/tests/unit/models/test_enums.py#L253-L266], @[backend_v2/tests/unit/models/test_core_base.py#L125-L140], [NEW] @[backend_v2/tests/unit/models/domain/test_proposition_graph.py], @[backend_v2/tests/unit/test_interfaces.py#L7-L21], @[backend_v2/tests/unit/test_settings.py#L136-L158], and @[backend_v2/tests/unit/test_factory.py#L28-L32] in their respective steps. RT-08: QGR002 .get() Lookup Ban & QGR009 AppException Contract Calling row.get(...) on records/dicts or raising AppException(ErrorCodes.XXX) without details={"error_code": ...}. QGR002 fatally bans .get() on variables outside LEGITIMATE_GET_CALLERS, and AppException.error_code (backend_v2/exceptions.py) reads self.details["error_code"] while QGR009 enforces typed ErrorCodes in details. Mandate direct subscript indexing (row["col"]) and positive membership checks (if key in store:) instead of .get(), and instantiate AppException(message=..., status_code=..., details={"error_code": ErrorCodes.<CODE>.value}). RT-09: backend_audit_loop.py Package Test Discovery Crash on backend_v2/database/postgres/ --test Naming the Step 5 contract test suite test_uow_contract.py instead of test_postgres.py. run_tests_with_strict_coverage("backend_v2/database/postgres/") in scripts/backend_audit_loop.py checks test_postgres.py, test_postgres*.py, and exact submodule stems (test_pool.py, test_uow.py). test_uow_contract.py matches none of these, causing backend_audit_loop.py backend_v2/database/postgres/ --test to fall back to non-existent backend_v2/tests/unit/database/postgres and fail with Pytest Exit Code 4. Name the contract test suite [NEW] @[backend_v2/tests/unit/database/test_postgres.py] so backend_audit_loop.py --test automatically discovers it for backend_v2/database/postgres/, backend_v2/database/, and every individual module inside backend_v2/database/postgres/. RT-10: Dedicated Unit Test Suite for scripts/audit_zero_orm_strictness.py (test_audit_zero_orm_strictness.py) Creating scripts/audit_zero_orm_strictness.py in Step 1 without its corresponding backend_v2/tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_zero_orm_strictness.py unit test file. Running uv run python scripts/backend_audit_loop.py scripts/audit_zero_orm_strictness.py --test --ast-strict per backend_audit_execution resolves backend_v2/tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_zero_orm_strictness.py and enforces --fail-under=90 coverage on scripts.audit_zero_orm_strictness. Add [NEW] @[backend_v2/tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_zero_orm_strictness.py] to Step 1 <targets> and <action> with positive and ISTQB negative tests for ZORM001–ZORM005. RT-11: Non-Exempt primitive_obsession_nested_dicts & QGR023 Tuple Ban in backend_v2/database/postgres/ Annotating variables or parameters in backend_v2/database/postgres/ with list[dict[...]], Sequence[Mapping[...]], or 3+ element tuples (tuple[uuid.UUID, str, float]). backend_v2/database/postgres/ is not in BOUNDARY_EXEMPTION_FILES. _find_nested_dict_subscript (audit_dict_eradication.py) fatally rejects any collection of dict/Mapping, and QGR023 (_ast_guardrails.py) fatally rejects 3+ element tuples or identical-primitive 2-tuples. Define AsyncPgRecordProtocol as a standalone Protocol (def __getitem__(self, key: str) -> object: ...) without inheriting Mapping, serialize Sequence[NodeDraft] / Sequence[EdgeDraft] directly via pydantic_core.to_json(list(drafts)) without list[dict[...]] annotations, and type executemany parameter batches as Sequence[Sequence[object]]. RT-12: Schema vs. Domain DTO Column Naming Drift Renaming or adding SQL DDL columns without corresponding Pydantic DTO fields (or vice versa), silently breaking direct row projection or triggering ValidationError: extra fields not permitted under ConfigDict(extra="forbid"). Zero-ORM persistence relies directly on row["col"] subscripting into model_validate(...). Without compile-time ORM reflection, column/field mismatches fail at runtime. Mandate automated Schema vs. Domain DTO Column Naming Parity Gate (test_schema_dto_naming_parity in test_postgres.py and ZORM006 in audit_zero_orm_strictness.py) asserting 1:1 bi-directional column-field parity across all 12 closed tables.

    <objective>Execute Phase 1 Pre-Implementation Cleanups, create the static AST guardrail verifier for Zero-ORM strictness, and extend EntityPrefix, StorageBackend, and PrefixedUUID7 utilities with full unit test coverage.</objective>
    <constraint invariant="ast_guardrail_mandate">Build AST Guardrail tests first to statically enforce Zero-ORM, zero naked dicts in database adapters, and closed table topology before writing adapter implementations.</constraint>
    <constraint invariant="opaque_stripe_id_ssot_constant_mandate">Bind all entity prefixes in EntityPrefix and validate against OPAQUE_STRIPE_ID_REGEX.</constraint>
    <targets>
      <target action="NEW">[NEW] @[scripts/audit_zero_orm_strictness.py]</target>
      <target action="NEW">[NEW] @[backend_v2/tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_zero_orm_strictness.py]</target>

      <target action="MODIFY">[MODIFY] @[backend_v2/tests/unit/models/test_core_base.py#L125-L140]</target>
    </targets>
    <action>
      1. Create `[NEW] @[scripts/audit_zero_orm_strictness.py]` with a standardized CLI (`argparse.ArgumentParser`, `RawDescriptionHelpFormatter`, PowerShell epilog examples) using Python's `ast` module (zero reflection, and zero contiguous `dict[str, ...]` literal substrings in docstrings/comments/messages to preserve `audit_warning_baseline.py` Census `P == 0`) to scan `backend_v2/database/postgres/`, `backend_v2/models/domain/proposition_graph.py`, and `backend_v2/database/migrations/001_pg19_uuidv7_schema.sql` for six fatal rules:
         - `ZORM001`: Ban imports of `sqlalchemy`, `alembic`, or `orjson` inside `backend_v2/database/postgres/`.
         - `ZORM002`: Ban `ast.Subscript` untyped `dict` annotations targeting `Any`/`object` and `dict(r)` call unpacking inside `backend_v2/database/postgres/` and `proposition_graph.py`.
         - `ZORM003`: Ban `except Exception:` without explicit typed `AppException` re-raise in `backend_v2/database/postgres/`.
         - `ZORM004`: Enforce that SQL `CREATE TABLE` identifiers in `001_pg19_uuidv7_schema.sql` belong strictly to the closed 12-table set (`users`, `organizations`, `workflows`, `steps`, `prompt_blocks`, `output_profiles`, `system_configs`, `executions`, `report_artifacts`, `report_binaries`, `quorum_nodes`, `quorum_edges`).
         - `ZORM005`: Ban calling `llm_client` or `execute_structured_task` inside `PostgresUnitOfWork` or `backend_v2/database/postgres/`.
         - `ZORM006`: Enforce that all column names projected in SQL queries in `graph_adapter.py` and `entity_adapter.py` map 1:1 to declared fields on the target Pydantic V2 domain model.
      2. Create `[NEW] @[backend_v2/tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_zero_orm_strictness.py]` testing positive clean modules and >=2 ISTQB negative partitions (`ZORM001`–`ZORM006` violations using concatenated `"dict" + "[str, Any]"`, syntax errors, and CLI exit codes), and update `@[backend_v2/tests/unit/scripts/test_scripts_cli_help.py#L61-L67]` to include `"audit_zero_orm_strictness.py"` in `ALL_SCRIPTS` and update `assert len(ALL_SCRIPTS) == 37`.
      3. In `@[backend_v2/models/enums.py#L222-L235]`, execute Phase 1 cleanup by defining `StorageBackend(StrEnum)` (`FIRESTORE = "FIRESTORE"`, `LOCAL = "LOCAL"`, `POSTGRES = "POSTGRES"`), extending `EntityPrefix` with `NODE = "nod"` and `EDGE = "edg"`, and adding `PropositionNodeType(StrEnum)` (`CLAIM = "claim"`, `GROUND = "ground"`, `WARRANT = "warrant"`, `REBUTTAL = "rebuttal"`, `SCM_VAR = "scm_var"`) and `DependencyRelationType(StrEnum)` (`SUPPORTS = "supports"`, `WARRANTS = "warrants"`, `REBUTS = "rebuts"`, `CAUSES = "causes"`). Export all new symbols in `__all__`.

           * `quorum_nodes` <-> `PropositionNode` (`node_id`, `run_id`, `node_type`, `confidence`, `payload`, `created_at`).
           * `quorum_edges` <-> `DependencyEdge` (`edge_id`, `run_id`, `source_id`, `target_id`, `relation_type`, `causal_weight`, `created_at`).
           * `report_binaries` <-> `ReportBinaryPayloadDTO` (`report_id`, `pdf_bytes`, `size_bytes`, `created_at`).
           * The 9 core system collections (`executions`, `report_artifacts`, `workflows`, `steps`, `prompt_blocks`, `output_profiles`, `system_configs`, `users`, `organizations`) against their canonical Pydantic V2 models in `backend_v2/models/domain/` (specifically asserting that `Step.mcp_tool_params`, `SystemConfigMCPGateways.tools` with `AllowedMCPTool.execution` / `input_schema`, and `MCPAuditTrace` telemetry inside `executions.trace_events` roundtrip with 100% field parity), ensuring zero column/field name divergence, zero untyped column drift, and strict adherence to `anti_semantic_drift_renaming`.
         - **Negative Case 1 (DAG Cycle Detection Fail-Fast)**: Introducing a 3-node cycle (`A -> B -> C -> A`) and calling `assert_acyclic(run_id)` raises `CycleDetectedError` (`ErrorCodes.VALIDATION_FAILED`).
         - **Negative Case 2 (Transactional Rollback on Dangling Edge Reference & Mid-Wave Fault)**: Calling `materialize_wave` with an `EdgeDraft` referencing an unknown `target_key="nonexistent_node"` or raising an exception inside `async with uow:` rolls back the entire UoW transaction, leaving 0 orphan nodes persisted.
         - **Negative Case 3 (ISTQB Boundary Value Analysis on Draft Models, Binary JSONB Header & PrefixedUUID7)**:
           * `NodeDraft` with `confidence = -0.001` (min - 0.001) and `confidence = 1.001` (max + 0.001) raises `ValidationError`.
           * `EdgeDraft` with `causal_weight = -1.001` and `1.001` or self-loop (`source_key == target_key`) raises `ValidationError`.
           * `parse_prefixed_uuid7` with wrong prefix (`wf_...` when `nod` expected) or UUIDv4 string raises `AppException` with `ErrorCodes.VALIDATION_FAILED`.
           * `decode_jsonb_binary(b"\x02{}")` or `decode_jsonb_binary(b"")` raises `AppException` with `ErrorCodes.STORAGE_ACCESS_FAILED`.
         - **Negative Case 4 (AST Guardrail & Codebase Verification)**: Verify that `audit_zero_orm_strictness.py` passes with exit code 0 on the real `backend_v2/database/postgres/` package and detects synthetic `import sqlalchemy`, `import orjson`, `"dict" + "[str, Any]"` (concatenated so `audit_warning_baseline.py` Census `P` remains `0`), broad `except Exception: pass`, `llm_client` calls, and unknown table names with exit code 1.
      2. Execute localized test gate: `uv run pytest backend_v2/tests/unit/database/test_postgres.py`.
      3. Execute global completion gates:
         - `uv run python scripts/audit_zero_orm_strictness.py`
         - `uv run python scripts/audit_dict_eradication.py backend_v2/database/postgres/ backend_v2/models/domain/proposition_graph.py`
         - `uv run python scripts/backend_audit_loop.py backend_v2/database/postgres/ --test --ast-strict`
         - `uv run python scripts/backend_audit_loop.py backend_v2/database/ --test --ast-strict`
         - `uv run python scripts/backend_audit_loop.py backend_v2/models/ --test --ast-strict`
    </action>
  </step>
</execution_protocol>
</code></pre>

docs.title: Executive Summary (Johdon Yhteenveto)
docs.text:
This document defines the strict, non-negotiable architectural requirements for executing the Final Cutover (Lopullinen Cutover) from the legacy file-locked TinyDB database (data/db_v2.json) to the sovereign All-in-PostgreSQL 19 Zero-ORM Architecture (@[docs/epic/EPIC_151_PostgreSQL_Clean_Slate_Migration_and_TinyDB_Eradication.md]).

Upon completion of Phase 1 (@[docs/implementationplans/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_PostgreSQL.md]), the core PostgreSQL 19 database infrastructure, 12-table DDL schema (@[backend_v2/database/migrations/001_pg19_uuidv7_schema.sql]), asyncpg + pydantic_core binary \x01 JSONB connection pool (@[backend_v2/database/postgres/pool.py]), CQRS ports (@[backend_v2/database/interfaces.py#L393-L400], @[backend_v2/database/interfaces.py#L403-L443]), and Unit of Work (@[backend_v2/database/postgres/uow.py]) are 100% operational and verified.

The Cutover phase completes the migration by: 1. Re-pointing local development and production startup (@[run_local.bat]) exclusively to PostgreSQL 19. 2. Ingesting the authoritative seed vault (@[backend_v2/seed/seed_data.json]) directly into PostgreSQL 19 via @[backend_v2/seed/run_seed.py#L429-L459], @[backend_v2/seed/run_seed.py#L462-L504], @[backend_v2/database/postgres/entity_adapter.py#L306-L627], and [NEW] @[backend_v2/database/postgres/storage_driver.py]. 3. Physically deleting legacy TinyDB drivers, OS file-locking code, legacy TinyDB utility scripts, and database JSON files. 4. Purging the tinydb package from @[pyproject.toml], adding asyncpg>=0.30.0, and locking the codebase with AST guardrail QGR017 in @[scripts/_ast_guardrails.py#L523-L2455].

FastAPI DriverDep (backend_v2/api/dependencies.py) and Arq background workers (worker.py, report_worker.py, synthesis_worker.py) call await get_driver(settings) to instantiate all 16 repositories in backend_v2/database/repositories/. RT-02 PostgresEntityAdapter already supports seeding all 10 PostgreSQL 19 tables. @[backend_v2/database/postgres/entity_adapter.py#L306-L627] currently implements only save_report_binary, get_report_binary, save_execution, and get_execution. Also, seed_data.json uses key "system_config" whereas 001_pg19_uuidv7_schema.sql defines table "system_configs". Add seed_collection_batch and verify_seed_table_counts to EntityPersistencePort, PostgresEntityAdapter, and InMemoryEntityAdapter, mapping "system_config" to "system_configs" and enforcing SELECT count(*) FROM ... verification. RT-03 Defaulting settings.storage_backend to StorageBackend.POSTGRES preserves local auth and file storage automatically. @[backend_v2/settings.py#L986-L1001] (allow_mock_tokens) checks self.active_backend != StorageBackend.LOCAL, and @[backend_v2/services/storage.py#L19-L66] (get_storage_driver) rejects StorageBackend.POSTGRES. Update allow_mock_tokens in @[backend_v2/settings.py#L986-L1001] and get_storage_driver in @[backend_v2/services/storage.py#L19-L66] to support StorageBackend.POSTGRES. RT-04 Deleting tinydb from pyproject.toml only affects backend_v2/database/. @[backend_v2/main.py#L57-L112] and @[backend_v2/main.py#L115-L160] import from tinydb import TinyDB at top level and open data/db_v2.json during FastAPI lifespan (@[backend_v2/main.py#L163-L218]) startup. Replace TinyDB imports and db_v2.json file checks in @[backend_v2/main.py#L57-L112], @[backend_v2/main.py#L115-L160], and @[backend_v2/main.py#L163-L218] with asynchronous PostgreSQL 19 preflight verification. RT-05 asyncpg is already declared in pyproject.toml. @[pyproject.toml] still lists "tinydb" at line 10 and omits "asyncpg>=0.30.0". Remove "tinydb" and add "asyncpg>=0.30.0" in @[pyproject.toml], then synchronize uv.lock. RT-06 QGR017 is an unused rule code in scripts/_ast_guardrails.py. @[scripts/_ast_guardrails.py#L621-L689] already uses QGR017 to ban resurrected legacy modules (v2_core.py, report_service.py, auth.py, export_service.py, llm/provider.py). REQ-01: Container & Launch Orchestration (run_local.bat)
docs.text:
• Mandate: Running .\run_local.bat MUST start both Redis and PostgreSQL containers: cmd docker compose up -d redis postgres
  • Mandate: @[run_local.bat] MUST set set STORAGE_BACKEND=POSTGRES for both FastAPI backend (uvicorn) and background worker (run_worker).
  • Banned: set STORAGE_BACKEND=LOCAL is strictly prohibited.
  • Banned: Any deletion, cleaning, or verification of data\db_v2.json in @[run_local.bat] is strictly prohibited.

docs.title: REQ-02: Authoritative Database Seeding (backend_v2/seed/run_seed.py)
docs.text:
• Mandate: uv run python backend_v2/seed/run_seed.py MUST populate the 10 core tables in PostgreSQL 19:
  • users
  • organizations
  • workflows
  • steps
  • prompt_blocks
  • output_profiles
  • system_configs
  • executions (clean-slate, 0 rows)
  • report_artifacts (clean-slate, 0 rows)
  • report_binaries (clean-slate, 0 rows)
  • Prompt Preservation Mandate: 100% of human-authored prompt texts, coaching philosophy, bilingual I18nText translations, and criteria configurations in @[backend_v2/seed/seed_data.json] MUST be preserved verbatim without modification.
  • Fail-Fast Assertion: @[backend_v2/seed/run_seed.py#L429-L459] MUST verify with SELECT count(*) FROM ... that all 7 seeded collections (organizations, users, system_configs, prompt_blocks, steps, workflows, output_profiles) have non-zero record counts and crash with AppException (ErrorCodes.STORAGE_ACCESS_FAILED or ErrorCodes.VALIDATION_FAILED) if any collection fails to materialize.

docs.title: REQ-03: Zero-Fallback Service & Factory Layer (factory.py & settings.py)
docs.text:
• Mandate: settings.storage_backend in @[backend_v2/settings.py#L47-L1088] MUST default to StorageBackend.POSTGRES.
  • Zero Backward Compatibility: In accordance with zero_backward_compatibility_planning_ban, @[backend_v2/database/factory.py#L33-L110] (get_driver) and @[backend_v2/database/factory.py#L113-L147] (create_unit_of_work) MUST NOT provide fallback chains to TinyDB or local JSON files if PostgreSQL fails.
  • Fail-Fast Error: Requesting StorageBackend.LOCAL, TINYDB, StorageBackend.FIRESTORE, or an invalid backend MUST immediately log a structured error and raise ConfigurationError("STORAGE_BACKEND 'LOCAL' has been permanently decommissioned. Quorum requires PostgreSQL 19.").

docs.title: REQ-04: Physical Eradication of TinyDB and OS File Locks
docs.text:
• Mandate: Physically delete [DELETE] @[backend_v2/database/tinydb_driver.py], [DELETE] @[backend_v2/database/wrapper.py], [DELETE] @[backend_v2/database/firestore_driver.py], [DELETE] @[backend_v2/database/exporter.py], and [DELETE] @[backend_v2/seed/wipe_user_data.py].
  • Mandate: Delete [DELETE] @[data/db_v2.json], [DELETE] @[data/db_v2.json.lock], and [DELETE] @[data/app.db].
  • Prohibition: Keeping deprecated adapter classes, hollow proxy shells, or @deprecated shims is strictly banned per the_no_legacy_mandate.

docs.title: REQ-05: Dependency Purge
docs.text:

  • Mandate: Run uv lock to synchronize uv.lock.

docs.title: REQ-06: Permanent AST Guardrail Lockdown (QGR017)
docs.text:
• Mandate: In @[scripts/_ast_guardrails.py#L523-L2455], codify rule QGR017 (Severity: FATAL):
  • Prohibits AST Import (#L1905-L2016) or ImportFrom (#L2018-L2265) referencing tinydb, tinydb_driver, firestore_driver, or backend_v2.database.wrapper.
  • Prohibits AST string constants or variable/class names referencing db_v2.json or TinyDBClient, and bans physical resurrection of tinydb_driver.py, firestore_driver.py, or wrapper.py in visit_Module (#L621-L689).
  • Verification: Running uv run python scripts/_ast_guardrails.py MUST pass with 0 fatal violations across the entire codebase.

docs.title: 4. Verification & Quality Gates (Laatuportit & Todennus)
docs.text:
The Cutover is declared mathematically verified and complete ONLY when all of the following commands exit with code 0:

# 1. Container healthcheck: verify PostgreSQL 19 is healthy and listening on port 5432
docker compose exec postgres pg_isready -U quorum -d quorum

# 2. Database seeding: ingest authoritative seed vault into PostgreSQL 19
uv run python backend_v2/seed/run_seed.py

# 3. Database atom count audit: verify all seed collections exist in PostgreSQL
uv run python scripts/audit_database_atoms.py --strict

# 4. AST Guardrail audit: assert zero tinydb imports or db_v2.json references
uv run python scripts/_ast_guardrails.py

# 5. Zero-ORM strictness audit: assert 100% adherence to Zero-ORM invariants (ZORM001-ZORM006)
uv run python scripts/audit_zero_orm_strictness.py

# 6. Full backend audit loop: format, typing, clean imports, and test suite pass 100%
uv run python scripts/backend_audit_loop.py backend_v2/ --test --ast-strict

# 7. Local Launcher dry-run: start run_local.bat and verify zero TinyDB logs
.\run_local.bat --no-client

# 8. Full Live E2E Workflow Execution & Parity Verification (Gate 8):
# Execute a full live end-to-end production workflow run against PostgreSQL 19 to assert 100% parity
# against the pre-PostgreSQL verified baseline (exe_2af2f7665e7c477b):
# - DAG Heavy LLM execution, asynchronous synthesis, and multi-channel artifact exports.
# - Zero healing cost events (healing_cost_events = 0) and zero transient HTTP errors.
# - Materialize verified physical artifacts: report.pdf, report.sdui.json, report.xlsx, and report.csv.
# - Validate append-only audit trail in PostgreSQL table trace_events.
# - Validate Flutter Desktop and Web HTTP 200 responses on /reports/{id}/sdui and /rows.

docs.text:
• Scenario 1 (Happy Path — Universal 32-Hex PrefixedUUID7 & Connected Argument Graph):
  • Calling generate_opaque_id(prefix) for every member of EntityPrefix returns a 32-hex RFC 9562 version-7 string matching r"^([a-z]{2,5})_[a-f0-9]{32}$" that roundtrips through parse_prefixed_uuid7 and format_prefixed_uuid7.
  • A connected 15-node acyclic deliverable graph with $r_{\text{iso}} = 0.0$, $r_{\text{LCC}} = 1.0$, and $r_{\text{conv}} = 0.20$ passes BARS Levels 1 through 5 (score = 5.0), and simulate_counterfactual_retraction accurately reports downstream collapsed and surviving node sets in both conjunctive ($\bigwedge$) and disjunctive ($\bigvee$) modes.
  • Scenario 2 (Negative Path 1 — Prefix Mismatch, Non-UUIDv7 & Missing Studio Draft Blocks):

  • Calling StudioWorkflowService.create_step_draft when no MATRIX/CRITERIA block exists in prompt_block_repo raises AppException with ErrorCodes.STATE_INTEGRITY_ERROR.
  • Scenario 3 (Negative Path 2 — ISTQB Boundary Value Analysis on Dyad Fragmentation & Node Cardinality):

docs.title: Objective
docs.text: Harmonize the prompt architecture across backend_v2/models/prompts/, caller modules, and the Flutter Studio UI (client_app_v2) according to Option B (Tripartite Domain Partitioning) with Zero-Fallback Database Sovereignty, 1:1 Studio UI Section Parity, Two-Tier SSOT Length Budgeting, and Matrix Synthesis Group Cardinality & Intra-Block Reordering Invariants. Specifically: 1. Centralize prompt assets into dedicated subpackages (common/, execution/, synthesis/), eradicating prompt repetition and tone leakage. 2. Decouple static linguistic protocols from dynamic parameters for maximum prefix context caching (95%+ hit rate). 3. Establish the database (OutputProfile) as the sole authoritative SSOT for substantive coaching directives and persona tones, permanently deleting code-level fallback registries (synthesis_registry.py), and enforcing strict Fail-Fast validation on missing directives. 4. Segregate Studio UI editing: Directives that map 1:1 to a specific report output section (specifically: Executive Summary, Matrix Summary Table, XAI Extensions, Variance Validation) reside strictly within their dedicated section detail cards on Tab 3 (ProfileSectionConfigTab), and are permanently pruned from Tab 1 (ProfileGeneralTab). Reusable multi-instance view type directives (specifically: 1D, 2D, 3D, and Text) remain in Tab 1 alongside general persona tone (tone_instruction), user role label (user_role_label), custom preface (custom_preface), and target locale (target_locale). 5. Mandate English-Only Plain Strings (str) for All 9 Prompt Directives and Tone Instructions: In accordance with Rule native_language_system_prompts and Rule cross_language_mapping_mandate, all LLM synthesis directives and persona tone instructions (tone_instruction, executive_summary_directive, matrix_1d_synthesis_directive, matrix_2d_synthesis_directive, matrix_3d_synthesis_directive, matrix_text_synthesis_directive, row_explanation_directive, xai_synthesis_directive, variance_synthesis_directive) MUST be defined strictly and exclusively in English (str | None). Eliminate bilingual I18nText wrappers and I18nTextField language-switching tabs from Studio UI prompt inputs, replacing them with clean single-language English text inputs (TextFormField). True report presentation headers (name, description, user_role_label, custom_preface) remain bilingual I18nText for human reader presentation. Target language report generation is instructed exclusively via Layer 4 dynamic parameter <required_output_language>{target_locale}</required_output_language>. 6. Implement Two-Tier SSOT character length budgeting across all 4 1:1 section blocks (executiveSummaryBlock, matrixSummaryTableBlock, groupedExtensionsBlock, varianceValidationBlock). Enforce length constraints via dynamic Layer 4 prompt budgets (<section_budget>) with sentence-boundary post-processing (enforce_sentence_boundary_budget), guaranteeing zero mid-sentence truncation and 100% prefix context caching preservation. 7. Reject user-facing UI checkboxes toggling "- Structure your findings directly as SDUI blocks." to prevent Pydantic validation crashes on non-SDUI string outputs (row_explanation, xai_highlights, variance_explanation). Purge technical formatting directives from substantive prompt fields, locking structural formatting strictly inside Layer 2 assets for polymorphic block tasks. 8. Enforce dimensional cardinality validation on matrix synthesis groups (specifically: 1D metrics == 1 block, 2D compare == 2 blocks, 3D radar == 3 blocks, and Text-only >= 1 block) via an explicit backend @model_validator(mode="after") on MatrixSynthesisGroup in backend_v2/models/v2_core.py and enforce unique synthesis group IDs via @model_validator(mode="after") on OutputProfile. In backend_v2/services/studio/output_profile_service.py, bind create_output_profile_draft directly to output_profile_factory.py so newly drafted profiles created headlessly via REST API are 100% valid and runnable out-of-the-box without requiring UI interaction. Persist the intra-block sequence of matrix synthesis groups directly into the MongoDB document array as the authoritative Single Source of Truth (SSOT). Eradicate the seen_axes bug in backend_v2/services/sdui/adapters/matrix_graphs_adapter.py so each visual group independently accesses its configured target blocks. Upgrade MatrixGraphsBlockCard in Studio UI (client_app_v2) to a dumb reordering list utilizing ReorderableListView (with dedicated drag handles and Up/Down IconButton controls), and enforce single-selection radio replacement and quota-based chip disabling in MatrixGraphItemEditor (completely eliminating client-side auto-clamping in favor of strict backend validation).

docs.title: Technical Debt & Anti-Pattern Pre-Flight Audit (Feature Audit & Database SDUI Alignment)
docs.text: Per the System 2 Feature Audit findings in feature_audit_sdui_directives_and_database.md and feature_audit_section_length_and_sdui_toggle.md, the following concrete technical debt, contract fractures, and architectural violations are identified across target files and scheduled for resolution:

docs.title: 1. Python Backend Technical Debt (backend_v2/models/prompts/ and backend_v2/worker.py)
docs.text:
• Single Responsibility Principle (SRP) Violation in sdui_directives.py: Lines 26-27 (USER_ROLE_EXTRACTION and ROLE TRANSLATION) embed user interaction role classification inside structural Server-Driven UI layout mandates. User role deduction belongs strictly to @[backend_v2/hooks/interaction_hook.py] and schema docstrings.
  • Dual-Prompt Contradiction & Instruction Clashing in worker.py: worker.py (Line 1045) injects SYNTHESIS_SDUI_MANDATES (mandating literal discriminators 'paragraph', 'bullet_list', 'alert_box', 'quote_card', 'warning_card') into the static system prompt prefix, but then injects active_profile_dto.executive_summary_directive (mandating "using SDUI ParagraphBlocks.") into the user message dynamic context. This creates direct cognitive dissonance for LLM decoders and risks Pydantic validation failures.
  • Dual SSOT & Silent Fallback Anti-Pattern: Substantive prompts exist in two competing places (database OutputProfile vs code constants in synthesis_directives.py and the shadow dictionary synthesis_registry.py). In worker.py (lines 1210, 1251-1254, 1382-1384), unconfigured profile fields silently execute fallback chains using direct constant imports (if not directive: fallback), violating zero_service_layer_fallbacks and universal_ssot_and_normalization_mandate. Note that worker.py uses direct constant imports (VARIANCE_EXPLANATION_DIRECTIVE, XAI_EXPLANATIONS_DIRECTIVE), NOT SynthesisPromptRegistry.
  • Linguistic Mandate Pollution in Schema Models (backend_v2/models/dtos/synthesis.py): Forensic Tier 0 inspection verified that synthesis.py (Line 12) imports DESC_TRANSLATION_MANDATE and injects it into 8 field descriptions across schema models: XaiHighlightItem.content (Line 60), SynthesisRowExplanationDTO.row_explanation (Line 101), ExecutiveSummarySectionResult.user_role, user_role_justification, cited_sources (Lines 143, 147, 151), and SynthesisOutputDTO.user_role, user_role_justification, cited_sources (Lines 217, 221, 226). This violates linguistic_mandate_centralization_ssot and prompt_asset_ssot_mandate. It must be permanently purged across all 8 field descriptions and the import removed, returning all schema field descriptions to pure semantic explanations without prompt translation directives.

docs.title: 2. Database Seed Vault Technical Debt (@[backend_v2/seed/seed_data.json])
docs.text:
• Literal Class Names in output_profiles (prf_5d6e7f8091a2b3c4): Line 18200 (executive_summary_directive) instructs the LLM to structure paragraphs "using SDUI ParagraphBlocks.". This violates @[backend_v2/tests/unit/test_sdui_prompt_alignment.py] which strictly asserts assert "ParagraphBlock" not in SYNTHESIS_SDUI_MANDATES.
  • De-Generator Architecture Breach in output_profiles (prf_5d6e7f8091a2b3c4): Lines 18206, 18212, 18218, 18224, 18236 (English) and 18237 (Finnish) repeatedly hardcode technical UI rendering directives: "- Structure your findings directly as SDUI blocks." and "- Muotoile löydökset suoraan SDUI-lohkoina.". Substantive coaching directives authored in Studio UI must contain zero technical formatting instructions; structural presentation rules belong exclusively to static Layer 2 code assets (backend_v2/models/prompts/synthesis/sdui_directives.py and backend_v2/models/prompts/synthesis/style_directives.py).
  • Legacy Orphan Prompt Block (blk_eeea566da4ab45f9): Line 16756 (blk_synthesis_global_rules) contains a monolithic prompt text with legacy V1 class names ('ParagraphBlock', 'BulletListBlock', 'AlertBlock', 'QuoteBlock') and corrupted XML tags (If is provided... current .). It is referenced exclusively by orphan step sp_9c6a85edc29347b9 (sp_synthesis_llm), which is not part of any active workflow in workflows.

docs.title: 3. Flutter Studio UI Technical Debt & Dual-Location Editing (client_app_v2)
docs.text:
• Cognitive Dissonance & Dual-Location Editing in Tab 1 vs Tab 3: Card 3 of ProfileGeneralTab (client_app_v2/lib/features/studio/views/widgets/profile/tabs/profile_general_tab.dart, lines 279-398) duplicates input fields for all 8 directives. Specifically, executiveSummaryDirective, rowExplanationDirective, xaiSynthesisDirective, and varianceSynthesisDirective already possess dedicated I18nTextField editors in their respective section detail cards in Tab 3 (ExecutiveSummaryBlockCard, MatrixSummaryTableCard, XaiExtensionsBlockCard, VarianceBlockCard). This dual-entry anti-pattern causes UI confusion, breaks single-responsibility editing, and creates cognitive dissonance.
  • Conflation of 1:1 Section Directives with Multi-Instance Graph Directives: Unlike 1:1 section blocks, 1D, 2D, 3D, and text matrix visualizations (matrix_synthesis_groups) can appear multiple times sequentially in a report (for instance: three 2D comparisons in a row). Tab 1 is the logical home for defining these 4 reusable view type directives, but Tab 1 mistakenly also hosts the 1:1 section directives.

docs.title: 4. Length Budgeting Technical Debt & Mid-Sentence Truncation Hazards
docs.text:
• Missing Section Length Controls: Only executiveSummaryBlock currently exposes synthesis_length_constraint. The other three 1:1 sections (matrixSummaryTableBlock, groupedExtensionsBlock, varianceValidationBlock) lack configurable length budgets, preventing fine-tuned executive layout balancing.
  • Brutal Slicing Hazard: Naive character slicing (text[:limit]) produces malformed sentences ending mid-word, destroying executive credibility. A sentence-boundary aware budgeting engine is required.
  • Schema Collision Hazard: Introducing a UI toggle to instruct the LLM to format outputs as SDUI blocks for non-block sections (row_explanation, xai_highlights, variance_explanation) clashes with Pydantic string validation contracts, causing fatal pipeline crashes.

docs.title: 5. Matrix Synthesis Group Cardinality, Seed Data Incoherence & Seen Axes Anti-Pattern
docs.text:
• Absolute Ban on Client-Side "Auto-Clamping on Load": Attempting to "auto-clamp on load" (specifically: silently slicing or discarding invalid matrix block selections during Flutter widget initialization, initState, or build in matrix_graph_item_editor.dart) is a catastrophic duct-tape anti-pattern. It masks corrupted database records, introduces unprompted client-side mutations, violates CQRS and Dumb Screen invariants, and leaves external REST API callers completely unprotected. Quality assurance and data integrity MUST be locked 100% into the backend via @model_validator(mode="after") and database seed sanitization. The frontend UI remains strictly a dumb interactive reflection of backend state.
  • Missing Group ID Uniqueness Validation on OutputProfile: OutputProfile in @[backend_v2/models/v2_core.py] previously lacked validation asserting that all MatrixSynthesisGroup.id entries in matrix_synthesis_groups are distinct. If an external API client or cloned draft payload submits duplicate group IDs (specifically: grp_440a5fef9331451b duplicated), client-side Flutter widgets (ReorderableListView, Key, state tracking) and backend adapters suffer key collisions, race conditions, and silent data corruption. An explicit @model_validator(mode="after") must enforce unique group IDs.
  • Headless Incomplete Draft Anti-Pattern in output_profile_service.py: In @[backend_v2/services/studio/output_profile_service.py], create_output_profile_draft previously instantiated an empty skeleton OutputProfile with null substantive directives. When an external API client (or CLI script) invokes POST /api/v2/studio/profiles/draft and attempts runtime synthesis, execution immediately crashes with AppException(ErrorCodes.OUTPUT_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE). The draft service MUST bind output_profile_factory.py (build_draft_output_profile) to pre-populate all 8 substantive directives (English str), valid default length constraints, a valid target_block_order, and an initial valid MatrixSynthesisGroup, guaranteeing that draft profiles created headlessly via REST API are 100% complete, valid, and runnable out-of-the-box without requiring UI interaction.
  • Missing Backend Model Validation on MatrixSynthesisGroup: MatrixSynthesisGroup in @[backend_v2/models/v2_core.py] only asserts target_blocks: list[str] = Field(min_length=1). It lacks an explicit @model_validator(mode="after") asserting that len(target_blocks) strictly satisfies the dimensional requirements of view_type. Backend validation must enforce: 1D == 1, 2D == 2, 3D == 3, Text >= 1.
  • Seed Data Incoherence in seed_data.json: Lines of output_profiles (prf_5d6e7f8091a2b3c4) in @[backend_v2/seed/seed_data.json] define 3 matrix groups with "view_type": "1d_metrics" while assigning 2 target blocks to each group (specifically: Toulmin and Bloom in Group 1, Causal Inference and Falsification in Group 2, XAI and Explainability in Group 3). This is the direct root cause of the visual glitch 2 / 1 valittu in the Studio editor. The seed file must be sanitized by setting view_type: "2d_compare" for these 3 comparative groups.
  • seen_axes Cross-Group Drop Bug in matrix_graphs_adapter.py: Forensic Tier 0 inspection verified that seen_axes: set[str] = set() in @[backend_v2/services/sdui/adapters/matrix_graphs_adapter.py] was declared outside the context.profile.matrix_synthesis_groups iteration loop. When multiple matrix synthesis groups target overlapping prompt blocks, downstream groups are starved of axes and silently fail to emit graphs. The seen_axes set must be eliminated or scoped locally within each group so each visual group independently accesses its configured target blocks.
  • Missing Reorder Functionality in MatrixGraphsBlockCard: MatrixGraphsBlockCard maps groups to a static Column. Users cannot change the display order of matrix groups within the card. Furthermore, line 83 executes newGroups.indexOf(group), which relies on referential identity on @Freezed(equal: false) models.
  • Unselected Chip Lockout & Missing Radio Behavior in MatrixGraphItemEditor: In 1D mode, selecting a block does not replace the active selection if existing data exceeded 1 block. When targetBlocks.length >= maxSlots, unselected chips remain enabled but unresponsive on click, causing user confusion.

docs.title: 6. Bilingual Prompt Directive Anti-Pattern & Seed Data Contamination
docs.text:
• Bilingual System Prompts & Active resolve_i18n in worker.py: In OutputProfile (models/v2_core.py, models/dtos/output_profile.py, and output_profile.dart), all 9 prompt directives (tone_instruction, executive_summary_directive, matrix_1d_synthesis_directive, matrix_2d_synthesis_directive, matrix_3d_synthesis_directive, matrix_text_synthesis_directive, row_explanation_directive, xai_synthesis_directive, variance_synthesis_directive) are still mistakenly typed as I18nText | None. Furthermore, forensic Tier 0 inspection verified that backend_v2/worker.py contains 6 active calls to compiler.resolve_i18n on prompt directives (lines 1067, 1081, 1139, 1206, 1248, 1379). This directly violates Rule native_language_system_prompts ("ALL system prompts MUST be strictly in English for maximum model instruction adherence") and Rule cross_language_mapping_mandate ("LLM rules MUST ALWAYS be defined in English and dynamically instructed to map against Localized Target Language source documents"). All 9 directives must be converted to plain English strings (str | None), and worker.py must access them directly via dot notation with zero resolve_i18n calls.
  • Seed Data Contamination (seed_data.json lines 18192–18245): In profile prf_5d6e7f8091a2b3c4, five directives (executive_summary_directive, matrix_1d_synthesis_directive, matrix_2d_synthesis_directive, matrix_3d_synthesis_directive, matrix_text_synthesis_directive) have duplicate English text copied into the "fi" key, while the remaining four (tone_instruction, row_explanation_directive, xai_synthesis_directive, variance_synthesis_directive) contain Finnish-translated prompt instructions. All 9 directives must be converted deterministically to clean English plain strings (str), completely purging the bilingual dictionary structure.
  • Studio UI Cognitive Clutter: In Flutter Studio UI (client_app_v2), prompt directives were edited using I18nTextField widgets with language toggle tabs (FI / EN). This confuses coaches into believing they must author translated prompt instructions for the LLM. All prompt directives must be edited as clean, single-language English TextFormField inputs.

docs.title: 7. Discovered 7-Item Technical Debt & Negative Boundary Gaps (Scope & 1-Hop Caller Sweep)
docs.text:
• Hardcoded Hint in executive_summary_block_card.dart#L72: The input field hardcodes 'esim. 1000 merkkiä' instead of binding l10n.profileSynthesisLengthHint, violating Rule no_magic_strings_l10n.
  • Fragile Referential Identity in matrix_graphs_block_card.dart#L83,L95: indexOf(group) and remove(group) operate on @Freezed(equal: false) instances where Dart pointer equality can desynchronize or fail during rebuilds. They must be refactored to lookups by unique entity ID: indexWhere((g) => g.id == group.id) and removeWhere((g) => g.id == group.id).
  • Unselected FilterChip Lockout in matrix_graph_item_editor.dart#L215-L235: When targetBlocks.length >= maxSlots, unselected chips provide an active onSelected callback that silently discards user clicks. Unselected chips must have onSelected: null when quota is reached, providing native visual disabled cues while 1D mode provides instant single-select radio replacement.
  • Hardcoded Workflow ID Fallback in output_profile_service.py#L182: create_output_profile_draft falls back to 'wf_9d68c573802341db' if no workflows are returned, masking missing tenant setup. Must raise AppException(ErrorCodes.RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND) instead of papering over empty state.
  • Missing SSOT Constants for Length Constraints: Default limits (1000, 250, 300, 500) are scattered as magic numbers across models. They must be anchored in SSOT constants (SystemUiConstraints in Flutter and settings.py / output_profile_factory.py in Python).
  • Missing ISTQB Negative Partitions for Length Budgeting & Cardinality:
  • length_budget_enforcer: tests must explicitly verify: 1) inputs below limit (pass-through), 2) inputs at exact limit (pass-through), 3) inputs exceeding limit with terminal punctuation within 60% window (clean sentence trim), 4) inputs exceeding limit without terminal punctuation (first sentence preserved), 5) empty or whitespace-only strings (AppException(ErrorCodes.VALIDATION_FAILED)).
  • MatrixSynthesisGroup cardinality: negative test cases for 1D (0 and 2 blocks), 2D (1 and 3 blocks), 3D (2 and 4 blocks), and Text (0 blocks).
  • OutputProfile group ID uniqueness: negative test case with duplicate MatrixSynthesisGroup.id entries asserting ValidationError.

docs.title: 8. Acknowledged Technical Debt (Out-of-Scope for This Plan)
docs.text:
• worker.py God File (1655 lines): worker.py exceeds the 300-line God File threshold per ki_god_code_prevention.md. This plan modifies it heavily (caller harmonization, Fail-Fast injection, budget injection) but does NOT decompose it. Decomposition is deferred to a dedicated future Epic.
  • Multi-Session Execution Budget: This plan contains 9 execution steps × 5-15 sub-actions (60-90 discrete operations), exceeding the context_amnesia_prevention threshold. Mandatory /tier5-session-handover checkpoints are required between step batches: Steps 1-3, Steps 4-5, Steps 6-7, and Steps 8-9.

docs.title: 1. Option B Partitioning (Subpackage Sovereignty)
docs.text:
All prompt definitions reside exclusively within backend_v2/models/prompts/ (SSOT), fulfilling the prompt_asset_ssot_mandate. They are physically separated into common/, execution/, and synthesis/ subpackages according to the Tripartite Pipeline Architecture. The root __init__.py re-exports all public symbols so existing external imports remain operational without circular dependencies.

backend_v2/models/prompts/
├── __init__.py                     # Root barrel re-exporting all subpackages
├── common/                         # Cross-cutting foundational invariants
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── global_mandates.py          # Layer 1: Universal epistemic rules
│   ├── linguistic_directives.py    # Layer 4: Dynamic language context
│   └── field_prompts.py            # Layer 1/3: Pydantic field description strings
├── execution/                      # Phase 1: Heavy Execution, Sensors & Tools
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── matrix_evaluation.py        # Sensor Decision Engine & Contextual Override
│   ├── hook_prompts.py             # Execution hook directives (interaction detection)
│   └── mcp_prompts.py              # External evidence extraction & verification
└── synthesis/                      # Phase 2: Synthesis & Reporting
    ├── __init__.py
    ├── synthesis_directives.py     # Static system identity prompts & structural constants
    ├── style_directives.py         # Coaching tone & presentation posture
    └── sdui_directives.py          # SDUI block generation directives

docs.title: 2. Deduplication & Pure Epistemic Invariants
docs.text:
• GLOBAL_MANDATES_XML in common/global_mandates.py contains strictly Layer 1 epistemic invariants: Epistemic Glossary, Null Hypothesis, Verbatim Extraction, Semantic Bleed, Schema Purity, Anti-Score, Anti-ID, Context Segregation. LANGUAGE_MANDATE and TONE_MANDATE are permanently purged. It contains zero references to specific schema field names (row_explanation, reasoning), zero locale strings, and zero tone directives.
  • hook_prompts.py is split along phase boundaries:
  • Lines 1-32 (INTERACTION_OBJECTIVE, INTERACTION_RULES) remain in execution/hook_prompts.py.
  • Lines 34-43 (SYNTHESIS_XAI_CURATION) and lines 45-52 (SYNTHESIS_SECTION_RULES_PREFIX) are relocated to synthesis/synthesis_directives.py.
  • Line 41 of SYNTHESIS_XAI_CURATION ("CRITICAL LANGUAGE MANDATE: All synthesized items MUST be generated in the . Do NOT use English unless explicitly requested.") is stripped to eliminate duplicate language mandates.
  • In sdui_directives.py, lines 26-27 (USER_ROLE_EXTRACTION and ROLE TRANSLATION) are purged, as role deduction belongs solely to InteractionHook.

docs.title: 3. Static Protocol Decoupling & FinOps Context Caching (static_first_dynamic_last_topology)
docs.text: To maximize prefix-matching prompt cache hit rates (95%+ on Vertex AI Gemini 2.5, Anthropic Claude 3.5, and OpenAI) and prevent cache invalidation on multilingual requests: - Static Protocol Decoupling (STATIC_LINGUISTIC_PROTOCOL): The complex linguistic behavioral mandate distinguishing hidden reasoning_trace from user-facing reasoning/content fields is 100% language-agnostic and contains zero f-strings: python STATIC_LINGUISTIC_PROTOCOL: str = ( "<linguistic_mandate> " "- REASONING VS. OUTPUT LANGUAGE ISOLATION: " " * The `<required_reasoning_language>` directive applies strictly to hidden internal thought traces (specifically `reasoning_trace`). " " * ALL user-facing JSON string fields (specifically content blocks, xai_highlights, row_explanation, and atom evaluation `reasoning` / `semantic_reasoning` explanations) MUST be generated strictly in the language specified in `<required_output_language>`. " " * Even when internal reasoning is conducted in English, NEVER emit English in user-facing fields unless `<required_output_language>` is 'en'. " "</linguistic_mandate>" ) - Lightweight Dynamic Parameter Tail (build_linguistic_parameters): Only dynamic parameter values (~10-15 tokens) are injected at the dynamic tail (Layer 4), decorated with @functools.lru_cache(maxsize=32) for token string determinism: python @functools.lru_cache(maxsize=32) def build_linguistic_parameters( target_locale: str, source_language: str = "Unknown/Original", ) -> str: """Return strictly the lightweight dynamic XML parameter block.""" return ( "<linguistic_parameters> " f" <source_data_language>{source_language.strip()}</source_data_language> " f" <required_output_language>{target_locale.strip().lower()}</required_output_language> " " <required_reasoning_language>English</required_reasoning_language> " "</linguistic_parameters>" ) - Heavy Source Document Cache Preservation: Placing dynamic linguistic parameters strictly at the tail of the message payload (after <context>{context_text}</context>) ensures a massive 30,000-token source document remains 100% cached across executions even when generating multilingual reports. - Legacy Cleanup: The legacy include_mandate: bool = False argument is eradicated across all callers.

docs.title: 4. Zero-Fallback Database Sovereignty & Factory Template Isolation
docs.text:
The database OutputProfile (seed_data.json / db_v2.json) is the sole authoritative Single Source of Truth (SSOT) for all 8 substantive directives, personas, and tones editable in Studio UI. - In live runtime execution, worker.py derives prompt directives 100% dynamically from active_profile_dto via direct dot notation. - backend_v2/models/prompts/synthesis/synthesis_directives.py contains strictly Layer 1 system prompt identities (DEFAULT_SYNTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT, DEFAULT_ROW_EXPLANATION_SYSTEM_PROMPT, DEFAULT_VARIANCE_SYSTEM_PROMPT) and structural constants (EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY_SECTION_ID, SYNTHESIS_SECTION_RULES_PREFIX, SYNTHESIS_XAI_CURATION). It does NOT maintain duplicate substantive constants or runtime fallback lookups. - synthesis_registry.py is permanently deleted. Zero code-level fallback dictionaries. - Baseline templates for seeding and Studio "New Profile" creation are isolated in backend_v2/services/factories/output_profile_factory.py. They are used exclusively during profile initialization and are never invoked during runtime synthesis.

docs.title: 6. Strict Fail-Fast Ingress Validation (Zero Compromise Mandate)
docs.text: In accordance with zero_service_layer_fallbacks and the_zero_compromise_pledge: 1. Model Validation: OutputProfile (backend_v2/models/v2_core.py) enforces cross-field completeness via @model_validator(mode="after"). If a block type is declared in target_block_order, its corresponding directive field must be populated and non-empty. 2. Worker Pipeline Fail-Fast: When worker.py compiles synthesis tasks, it accesses directives directly from active_profile_dto. If a required directive is missing or empty, it logs a structured error and immediately raises AppException(ErrorCodes.OUTPUT_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE, f"Directive for active block '{block_type}' is missing in OutputProfile '{profile_id}'"). 3. Zero Fallback Chains: Code never guesses, falls back, or substitutes degraded prompts silently.

│       sentence intact and emit a structured warning. NEVER slice words mid-sentence.   │

The LLM attempts to generate block dictionaries into plain-string Pydantic fields, causing instant ValidationError crashes.

docs.title: 13.1 Backend Cardinality & Group ID Uniqueness Validation (@model_validator SSOT)
docs.text:
In accordance with the_zero_compromise_pledge and universal_fail_fast, all structural guarantees for matrix synthesis groups are enforced strictly on the backend domain models in backend_v2/models/v2_core.py:

  1. Dimensional Cardinality Enforcement (MatrixSynthesisGroup): MatrixSynthesisGroup enforces strict mathematical coupling between view_type and target_blocks: python @model_validator(mode="after") def validate_dimensional_cardinality(self) -> Self: """Enforce strict dimensional cardinality coupling between view_type and target_blocks.""" num_blocks = len(self.target_blocks) # LaxPresetView coerces strings to PresetView before @model_validator runs. if self.view_type == PresetView.METRICS_1D: if num_blocks != 1: msg = ( f"MatrixSynthesisGroup '{self.id}': view_type '1d_metrics' requires exactly 1 target block, " f"but received {num_blocks} ({self.target_blocks})." ) logger.error("[V2Core] %s: %s", ErrorCodes.VALIDATION_FAILED.name, msg, exc_info=True) raise ValueError(msg) elif self.view_type == PresetView.COMPARE_2D: if num_blocks != 2: msg = ( f"MatrixSynthesisGroup '{self.id}': view_type '2d_compare' requires exactly 2 target block, " f"but received {num_blocks} ({self.target_blocks})." ) logger.error("[V2Core] %s: %s", ErrorCodes.VALIDATION_FAILED.name, msg, exc_info=True) raise ValueError(msg) elif self.view_type == PresetView.MATRIX_3D: if num_blocks != 3: msg = ( f"MatrixSynthesisGroup '{self.id}': view_type '3d_matrix' requires exactly 3 target block, " f"but received {num_blocks} ({self.target_blocks})." ) logger.error("[V2Core] %s: %s", ErrorCodes.VALIDATION_FAILED.name, msg, exc_info=True) raise ValueError(msg) elif self.view_type == PresetView.TEXT_ONLY: if num_blocks < 1: msg = ( f"MatrixSynthesisGroup '{self.id}': view_type 'text_only' requires at least 1 target block, " f"but received {num_blocks}." ) logger.error("[V2Core] %s: %s", ErrorCodes.VALIDATION_FAILED.name, msg, exc_info=True) raise ValueError(msg) return self

  2. Group ID Uniqueness Enforcement (OutputProfile): OutputProfile enforces that all group IDs within matrix_synthesis_groups are strictly distinct, preventing headless API callers from introducing duplicate IDs: python @model_validator(mode="after") def validate_matrix_group_ids_unique(self) -> Self: """Enforce that all MatrixSynthesisGroup IDs in matrix_synthesis_groups are strictly unique.""" seen_ids: set[str] = set() duplicate_ids: list[str] = [] for grp in self.matrix_synthesis_groups: if grp.id in seen_ids: duplicate_ids.append(grp.id) seen_ids.add(grp.id) if duplicate_ids: msg = ( f"OutputProfile '{self.id}': Duplicate synthesis group IDs detected in " f"matrix_synthesis_groups: {duplicate_ids}. All group IDs must be strictly unique." ) logger.error("[V2Core] %s: %s", ErrorCodes.VALIDATION_FAILED.name, msg, exc_info=True) raise ValueError(msg) return self

docs.title: 13.2 Headless API Sovereignty & Factory Draft Binding (create_output_profile_draft)
docs.text:
To guarantee that profiles created headlessly via REST API (or automation scripts) are 100% valid and runnable out-of-the-box without requiring any interaction in the Flutter UI: - backend_v2/services/factories/output_profile_factory.py provides build_draft_output_profile(...): python def build_draft_output_profile( profile_id: str, workflow_id: str, organization_id: str | None = None, ) -> OutputProfile: """Build a fully populated, runnable OutputProfile draft for headless API and Studio creation.""" ... - In backend_v2/services/studio/output_profile_service.py, create_output_profile_draft is updated from instantiating an incomplete skeleton to directly binding output_profile_factory.build_draft_output_profile: ```python async def create_output_profile_draft(self, initiator: TokenData) -> OutputProfile: workflows = await self.workflow_service.list_workflows(initiator) if not workflows: msg = f"No workflows available to associate with new OutputProfile for organization '{initiator.organization_id}'." logger.error("[StudioOutputProfileService] %s: %s", ErrorCodes.RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.name, msg) raise ResourceNotFoundError(resource_type="workflow", resource_id="primary_default") target_wf_id = workflows[0].id new_id = generate_opaque_id(EntityPrefix.OUTPUT_PROFILE) if initiator.role == UserRole.ROOT: target_org = SystemOrganizations.ROOT_SYSTEM else: target_org = initiator.organization_id

  draft = build_draft_output_profile(
      profile_id=new_id,
      workflow_id=target_wf_id,
      organization_id=target_org,
  )
  return await self.save_output_profile(initiator, new_id, draft)

`` - **Guaranteed Draft Contents**: - All 8 substantive directives populated with valid default Englishstrstrings. - All 4 section length constraints populated with default integer values (synthesis_length_constraint=1000,row_explanation_length_constraint=250,xai_length_constraint=300,variance_length_constraint=500). - An initial validMatrixSynthesisGroupwith unique opaque ID conforming to dimensional cardinality. - Completetarget_block_ordercovering standard executive reporting sections. - **Headless Runnable Contract**: Any profile created viaPOST /api/v2/studio/profiles/draftis instantly ready for runtime synthesis; calling synthesis immediately succeeds withoutOUTPUT_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE`.

docs.title: 13.3 Absolute Ban on Client-Side "Auto-Clamping on Load" & Dumb Screen Protocol
docs.text:
• The Ban: Flutter widgets (matrix_graph_item_editor.dart, matrix_graphs_block_card.dart) are STRICTLY FORBIDDEN from performing any "auto-clamp on load", silent truncation, or heuristic data scrubbing in initState, didChangeDependencies, didUpdateWidget, or build.
  • Architectural Rationale: Auto-clamping papers over database corruption, causes unexpected state divergence between client and server, violates CQRS, and fails to protect headless API clients.
  • Strict Separation of Concerns:
  • Quality Assurance (Backend): Locked exclusively in backend @model_validator(mode="after") and database seed sanitization (seed_data.json). If invalid data exists, backend fails fast with AppException(ErrorCodes.VALIDATION_FAILED).
  • Dumb Display (Frontend): The UI renders the exact target blocks delivered by the DTO.
  • Interactive Affordances (Frontend):
    • In 1D Metrics mode, selecting a new block replaces the previous single selection (radio button behavior).
    • In 2D Compare / 3D Radar modes, when the exact quota is reached (targetBlocks.length >= maxSlots), unselected FilterChips are disabled (onSelected: null), preventing invalid additions before deselection.
    • Zero client-side data scrubbing on load.

docs.title: 13.4 Database Array Order SSOT & Intra-Block Reordering UI (ReorderableListView + Up/Down Controls)
docs.text:
• Database Sequence as SSOT: In MongoDB and Pydantic V2, the JSON array sequence of OutputProfile.matrix_synthesis_groups ([grp_0, grp_1, grp_2, ...]) is the authoritative Single Source of Truth for display order. No redundant order: int integer field is maintained, upholding the universal_ssot_and_normalization_mandate.
  • Dumb Painter SDUI Execution: MatrixGraphsAdapter.build() iterates matrix_synthesis_groups strictly in document array order, emitting corresponding AnySduiBlock items sequentially. The client ReportView paints them in delivered order with zero business logic.
  • Dumb Studio Editor Reordering:
  • MatrixGraphsBlockCard replaces static Column with ReorderableListView(buildDefaultDragHandles: false, shrinkWrap: true, physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics()).
  • Provides two redundant UX mechanisms for executive coaches:
    1. Drag Handles: ReorderableDragStartListener on card header.
    2. Up/Down Buttons: IconButton(icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_upward)) and IconButton(icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_downward)) for precise single-click movement without mouse dragging.
  • On reorder, the list is mutated in memory (newGroups.insert(newIndex, newGroups.removeAt(oldIndex))) and dispatched via onChanged(payload.copyWith(matrixSynthesisGroups: newGroups)).

docs.title: Falsification & Red-Teaming (Failure Point Analysis)
docs.text: In accordance with Tier 0 Red-Team audit protocols, the implementation plan is cross-examined against four realistic adversarial failure modes:

docs.title: Failure Point 1: Database Migration Deserialization Crash on Legacy I18nText Records
docs.text:
• Vulnerability: Existing MongoDB and local db_v2.json documents store prompt directives as bilingual I18nText dictionaries ({"translations": {"en": "...", "fi": "..."}}). Switching Pydantic models in backend_v2/models/v2_core.py and models/dtos/output_profile.py strictly to str | None with ConfigDict(strict=True, extra="forbid") will cause immediate ValidationError crashes upon hydrating un-sanitized records from the database.
  • Root Cause: Pydantic strict mode forbids implicit coercion of dictionaries into strings.
  • Proof-Anchor Mitigation: Enforce the 03_seed_vault.md protocol:
  • Automated pre-flight sanitization script converts all 9 directive fields in seed_data.json from I18nText to clean English str BEFORE model validation is enforced.
  • Local database wipe and re-seed (uv run python backend_v2/seed/run_seed.py local) is executed as part of Phase 1 before running synthesis tasks.
  • Pre-flight schema validation gate (run_seed.py local --dry-run) validates all documents 100% in-memory with strict schemas.

docs.title: Failure Point 2: Headless API Draft Creation Incompleteness (OUTPUT_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE)
docs.text:
• Vulnerability: Removing SynthesisPromptRegistry and fallback lookups (if not directive: fallback) in worker.py means any OutputProfile missing a directive for an active block type triggers an instant Fail-Fast crash: AppException(ErrorCodes.OUTPUT_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE). If POST /api/v2/studio/profiles/draft instantiates an empty skeleton with None directives, calling synthesis on that profile immediately crashes without giving API consumers a runnable draft.
  • Root Cause: Pure headless callers never interact with Flutter UI forms to populate empty text fields.
  • Proof-Anchor Mitigation:
  • StudioOutputProfileService.create_output_profile_draft directly binds output_profile_factory.build_draft_output_profile(...).
  • Factory pre-populates all 8 substantive directives with clean English str defaults, all 4 section length constraints with defaults, and an initial valid MatrixSynthesisGroup.
  • Unit test test_output_profile_service.py asserts that newly drafted profiles are 100% complete and runnable immediately out-of-the-box.

docs.title: Failure Point 3: Sentence-Boundary Trimming Truncation Anomaly on Unpunctuated Text
docs.text:
• Vulnerability: If an LLM emits a single massive, unbroken sentence exceeding max_chars (or outputs raw text without terminal punctuation '.', '!', '?'), a naive backward scan looking for punctuation could fail to find any terminal boundary, either returning un-truncated text or slicing into an empty string.
  • Root Cause: Heuristic sentence-boundary matching assuming standard punctuation.
  • Proof-Anchor Mitigation:
  • enforce_sentence_boundary_budget scans backwards within the window [max_chars * 0.6, max_chars].
  • If a terminal sentence boundary exists within that window, it trims at that boundary.
  • If no terminal boundary exists, it retains the first sentence intact up to max_chars or trims cleanly at the last complete word boundary, emitting a structured warning. It NEVER returns an empty string or slices words mid-character.
  • Covered by 5 ISTQB equivalence partition unit tests in test_length_budget_enforcer.py.

docs.title: Failure Point 4: Flutter Serialization Deserialization White Screen of Death
docs.text:
• Vulnerability: If Flutter Freezed models in client_app_v2/lib/features/studio/models/output_profile.dart are updated from I18nText? to String? without running dart run build_runner build, runtime deserialization will attempt to parse plain JSON strings into I18nText structures, triggering CheckedFromJsonException and crashing the profile editor into AppErrorBoundary.
  • Root Cause: Out-of-sync Freezed .g.dart generated files.
  • Proof-Anchor Mitigation:
  • Execution step mandates running uv run python scripts/flutter_audit_loop.py client_app_v2/lib/features/studio/models/output_profile.dart --build.
  • The flutter audit script automatically runs build_runner with --delete-conflicting-outputs.
  • Automated test profile_general_tab_test.dart and profile_section_config_tab_test.dart verify clean JSON roundtrip serialization.

docs.title: Objective
docs.text: Establish complete Single Source of Truth (SSOT) parity, causal completeness, tabular transparency, machine learning readiness, and mathematical rigor across Quorum report tables and tabular exports by: 1. Eliminating naming divergence between ReportMatrixColumn.LABEL ("Logiikkamatriisi") and ReportAtomColumn.MATRIX ("Matriisi" -> "Logiikkamatriisi") in backend localization files (fi.json, en.json). 2. Streaming dynamic causal graph propositions (CausalNodeDTO from CausalDiscoveryEngine) into ExportForensicAtomDTO and ExportDenormalizedFlatRowDTO under matrix_label = "Kausaalipäättely", populating causal_status, blame_parent_id, and dependent_count in Excel Tab 2 (Raakadata) and rectangular CSV. 3. Hardening the mathematical representation of claim evaluations for machine learning: ensuring that criteria hit ratios (specifically 1 passed claim out of 2 evaluated claims) are explicitly paired with clean numeric columns (hits: int, total_atoms: int, hit_ratio: float, raw_score: float, scale_max: float, normalized_score: float) in Excel and CSV. 4. Hardening Tab 2 (Raakadata) and CSV exports for machine learning batch analytics: enriching ReportAtomColumn, ExportForensicAtomDTO, and ExportDenormalizedFlatRowDTO with language-agnostic numerical columns (is_inverse: int [0/1] and points_awarded: float [1.0/0.0]), ensuring ML pipelines aggregate affirmative capability hits without parsing localized text strings or confounding clean anti-pattern tests with positive points. 5. Decoupling affirmative capability scores from inverse negative evidence findings in the UI "Rividata & Taulukot" (Row Data & Tables) view: enriching ReportRowItemDTO and ReportRowItem with is_inverse_evidence: bool = False, propagating this flag from report_dto.results in ReportService.get_report_rows, and replacing the naked integer score in execution_reports_view.dart with semantic status badges (+1 p / 0 p for affirmative capabilities vs Puhdas / ⚠️ Negatiivinen löydös for anti-pattern detectors). 6. Locking the canonical 5-column default baseline (["label", "distribution", "row_explanation", "criteria", "normalized_score"]) in Studio Output Profile domain models, DTOs, and synchronizing specifically and exhaustively all 6 output profiles in seed_data.json. 7. Safeguarding execution artifact continuity for exe_c50e968fc9c04906 prior to executing the local database hard reset and reseeding protocol via uv run python backend_v2/seed/run_seed.py local to wipe local persistence, purge orphaned artifacts, and re-hydrate the database from seed_data.json.

docs.title: User Review Required
docs.text: [!IMPORTANT] - Execution Artifact Continuity Preservation: run_seed.py local drops TinyDB tables and executes shutil.rmtree on data/files/executions/. To prevent the deletion of exe_c50e968fc9c04906 (which is needed for Step 6.3 forensic validation), Phase 5 backs up exe_c50e968fc9c04906 to scratch/ before the seeder runs, and restores it immediately after re-seeding. - Causal Row Placement: Dynamic causal propositions (specifically the 28 propositions extracted in exe_c50e968fc9c04906) will be appended to Excel Tab 2 (Raakadata) and CSV rows under Logiikkamatriisi = "Kausaalipäättely". This prevents empty causal columns without creating parallel schemas or a third tab. - Machine Learning (ML) Readability in Tabular Exports: In Excel Tab 2 and rectangular CSV, two dedicated numerical columns are added: 1. is_inverse: int (0 = affirmative capability, 1 = inverse/anti-pattern detector). 2. points_awarded: float (1.0 for passed affirmative capability, 0.0 for failed capability OR clean anti-pattern). This guarantees that ML pipelines compute genuine capability score hits via df['points_awarded'].sum() == hits and total defects via (df['is_inverse'] * (1 - df['result_status'])).sum(), eliminating reliance on localized text matching (claim_type). - Single Source of Truth (SSOT) Header Parity: All column headers across Tab 1, Tab 2, and CSV are resolved strictly through ReportHeaderResolver in backend_v2/services/localization.py using typed enums (ReportMatrixColumn and ReportAtomColumn) mapped to fi.json and en.json. No ad-hoc header dictionaries exist in the codebase. - Decoupling Affirmative Points from Negative Evidence in UI Row Data: In the UI "Rividata & Taulukot" tab, anti-pattern detectors display semantic badges (Puhdas when clean, ⚠️ Negatiivinen löydös when defect detected) instead of naked integer points (1 / 0), eliminating confusion where anti-patterns appeared as points scored. - Dumb Painter Invariant (Zero Presentation Math & Inference): Across all four presentation targets (Flutter UI, PDF Jinja2 templates, Excel workbooks, and CSV streams), zero calculation, scoring math, or semantic inference takes place. The backend pre-computes all metrics (points_awarded, is_inverse, result_status, hit_ratio, normalized_score) and delivers them via immutable Pydantic V2 DTOs. Presentation targets act exclusively as "Dumb Painters" rendering pre-resolved data without local computation.

docs.title: IMPLEMENTATION PLAN: Router SSOT Consolidation & Universal CRUD+Clone Enforcement (reports.py, workflows.py, system_configs.py)
1. Objective & Architectural Background
docs.text:
Enforce 100% compliance with single_router_ssot_mandate, crud_and_clone_lifecycle_standard_mandate, opaque_stripe_id_ssot_constant_mandate, slug_data_relation_ban, the_no_legacy_mandate, and @[ki_router_ssot_and_crud_clone_lifecycle.md] across all non-IAM FastAPI routers in backend_v2/api/routers/ and their corresponding Flutter Dio API clients in client_app_v2/lib/core/api/.

Forensic audit and CRUD + Delete dry runs across backend_v2/api/routers/, backend_v2/services/studio/, and backend_v2/database/repositories/ identified five non-IAM router Single Source of Truth (SSOT) and gold-standard lifecycle anomalies alongside missing delete-protection and OpenAPI CI guardrails: 1. Empty Dead Router (system_configs.py): @[backend_v2/api/routers/studio/system_configs.py] defines an empty APIRouter(prefix="/system-configs", tags=["Studio - System Configs"]) with zero route handlers, creating a deceptive shadow module alongside @[backend_v2/api/routers/system/configs.py], @[backend_v2/api/routers/studio/model_registry.py], and @[backend_v2/api/routers/studio/mcp_gateways.py]. 2. Duplicate /system/system/hooks Prefix (system/health.py): @[backend_v2/api/routers/system/health.py] defines APIRouter(prefix="/system") while mounted inside @[backend_v2/api/routers/system/__init__.py] (APIRouter(prefix="/system")), producing a doubled /api/v2/system/system/hooks path instead of /api/v2/system/hooks. 3. Split Workflow Entity Router (execution/workflows.py vs. studio/workflows.py): Workflow CRUD, clone (POST /{id}/clone), simulation, and extension discovery live in @[backend_v2/api/routers/studio/workflows.py] (/api/v2/studio/workflows), whereas GET /{workflow_id}/ui_schema is isolated in a separate single-endpoint router @[backend_v2/api/routers/execution/workflows.py]. Furthermore, @[client_app_v2/lib/core/api/workflow_client.dart] calls _dio.get('/api/v2/workflows/$workflowId/ui_schema') on an apiClient whose baseUrl already terminates with /api/v2/. 4. Triple-Router & Dual-Decorated ReportArtifact Module (execution/reports.py & main.py): @[backend_v2/api/routers/execution/reports.py] defines three separate APIRouter instances (router, external_router, and execution_reports_subrouter), attaches duplicate @router.<method>("/execution/...", include_in_schema=False) shadow decorators on every endpoint, mounts execution_reports_subrouter inside @[backend_v2/api/routers/execution/executions.py], mounts reports_router in both @[backend_v2/api/routers/execution/__init__.py] and @[backend_v2/main.py], and mounts external_reports_router under both /api/v1 and /api/v2 in @[backend_v2/main.py]. 5. Legacy Studio Routers & Services Missing HTTP-Boundary OPAQUE_STRIPE_ID_REGEX, ID_MISMATCH, Dynamic Matrix Draft Creation (category_id=matrix), Clone Unlocking (is_system_core=False), and 3-Layer Delete Protection (workflows.py, steps.py, prompt_blocks.py, model_registry.py, mcp_gateways.py): - Only @[backend_v2/api/routers/output_profiles.py] currently enforces Annotated[str, Path(pattern=OPAQUE_STRIPE_ID_REGEX)] on path parameters and Fail-Fast ErrorCodes.ID_MISMATCH validation on PUT /{id} at the router boundary;
